# VICE TOOLS — All Changed Files (cumulative bundle)

This is the **single cumulative bundle** for the VICE TOOLS (GTA 6 fan
companion) project. It contains the **final version of every file that was
added or changed** across Batches 1–5, compared by hash against the
original repo zip (`GTA-6-main.zip`). Upload these files to the repo root
to merge the whole project in one go.

- **Files in this bundle:** 117 text files (1,290,028 bytes total)
- **Binary files:** 7 PNG images — **not** in this bundle (see "Binary files" below); copy them from the Batch 2 zip.
- **Deleted files:** 3 files to remove from the repo (see "Deleted files" below).
- **Generated:** 2026-11-05, from the verified final work copy (all checks green — see CHANGELOG.md).

## How to apply this bundle

1. Save this file as `VICE-TOOLS-ALL-CHANGED-FILES.md` and save the
   extractor script `extract-bundle.py` (provided alongside it) in the
   same folder.
2. From your repo root, run:

   ```
   python3 extract-bundle.py VICE-TOOLS-ALL-CHANGED-FILES.md .
   ```

   The extractor writes every file to its repo-relative path, creating
   folders as needed. It never deletes anything.
3. Delete the 3 files listed under "Deleted files" below.
4. Copy the 7 PNGs from the Batch 2 zip (`vice-tools-batch2-UPLOAD-TO-REPO-ROOT.zip`, folder `public/`) into
   your repo's `public/` folder.
5. Verify the merge:

   ```
   npm install && npm run build && npm run verify:html && npm run check:links && npm run validate:schema && npm run verify:regions
   ```

   All six commands must pass. Then deploy.

## Reading this file

Each file section starts with a `## <repo-relative-path>` header followed
by a fenced code block holding the file's **complete** contents (never
truncated). Code blocks use **four backticks** as fences, because some
file contents themselves contain triple-backtick fences. A file whose
content ends with a newline has one extra blank line before its closing
fence — that blank line is part of the file, not formatting. Do not edit
the file contents by hand; use the extractor.

## Deleted files

Delete these 3 files from the repo (they were removed during the
batches). The extractor does not delete anything, so do this by hand:

- `metadata.json` — AI Studio leftover — not part of the app; remove it.
- `public/sitemap.xml` — Static sitemap replaced by build-time generation (scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs); remove it so it is not served stale.
- `src/data/updates.json` — Fake updates replaced by the sourced src/data/news.json; remove it.

## .env.example

````text
# VITE_SITE_URL: the public URL of the site (used for canonical URLs and sitemaps).
VITE_SITE_URL=https://vicetools.app

# VITE_GA_ID: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX).
# Leave empty to disable analytics entirely. Analytics loads only after a
# visitor accepts in the cookie banner (Consent Mode v2, defaults denied).
VITE_GA_ID=

````

## netlify.toml

````toml
# VICE TOOLS — Netlify configuration (host-agnostic; only used when deployed on Netlify).
#
# If redirects are defined in BOTH this file and public/_redirects, the rules
# in THIS file (netlify.toml) take precedence on Netlify. The two files are
# kept identical, so a divergence is a bug — fix it in both places.
# public/_redirects is also read by Cloudflare Pages; see its own header comment.
#
# Security headers below are identical on all three hosts (netlify.toml,
# vercel.json, public/_headers). CSP notes:
# - script-src has NO 'unsafe-inline': the only inline <script> blocks are
#   JSON-LD data blocks (type="application/ld+json"), which CSP does not
#   execute, and the app bundle is a same-origin module script.
# - style-src DOES need 'unsafe-inline': React SSR renders 22 inline
#   style="..." attributes into dist HTML (verified 2026-11-05; 0 inline
#   <style> tags). Without it, first paint loses those inline colours until
#   hydration re-applies them via CSSOM. Tailwind v4 itself compiles to the
#   external stylesheet and does not need it.
# - AdSense origins (pagead2.googlesyndication.com, googleads.g.doubleclick.net)
#   are ADS-READY only: ADS_ENABLED is false and AdSlot renders nothing, so
#   nothing from those origins loads today. They are included now so enabling
#   ads later is a config flip, not a CSP redeploy.
# - frame-src allows the AdSense origins (ads-ready, see above) plus
#   https://www.youtube.com and https://www.youtube-nocookie.com for the
#   official Rockstar YouTube embeds on /gta-6-trailers (Batch 5).

[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

# Trailing-slash canonicalisation: /foo/ -> /foo (301).
# force = true is REQUIRED: /foo/index.html exists on disk, and without it
# Netlify serves the file instead of redirecting. Root "/" is unaffected
# (the pattern needs at least one segment before the trailing slash).
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*/"
  to = "/:splat"
  status = 301
  force = true

# Custom 404: unknown paths serve dist/404.html with a real 404 status.
# No force flag: existing files are served first; this only fires on misses.
# Evaluated after the trailing-slash rule above.
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/404.html"
  status = 404

# Security headers + no-cache for HTML and all other non-asset responses.
[[headers]]
  for = "/*"
  [headers.values]
    Content-Security-Policy = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; connect-src 'self' https://www.google-analytics.com https://region1.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com; frame-src https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
    X-Content-Type-Options = "nosniff"
    Referrer-Policy = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    X-Frame-Options = "DENY"
    Permissions-Policy = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
    Cache-Control = "no-cache"

# Long-cache for hashed build assets. Netlify gives more specific paths
# precedence over "/*", so this wins over the no-cache rule above for
# /assets/* even though it is listed second.
[[headers]]
  for = "/assets/*"
  [headers.values]
    Content-Security-Policy = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; connect-src 'self' https://www.google-analytics.com https://region1.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com; frame-src https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
    X-Content-Type-Options = "nosniff"
    Referrer-Policy = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    X-Frame-Options = "DENY"
    Permissions-Policy = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
    Cache-Control = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
````

## public/_headers

````text
# VICE TOOLS — Cloudflare Pages headers.
#
# Rule order matters: Cloudflare applies matching rules top to bottom, with
# a LATER rule winning for any header both rules set. The general rule is
# therefore FIRST and the /assets/* rule SECOND, so hashed assets keep their
# long cache while HTML gets no-cache.
#
# CSP notes (identical on all three hosts — netlify.toml, vercel.json, here):
# - script-src has NO 'unsafe-inline': the only inline <script> blocks are
#   JSON-LD data blocks (type="application/ld+json"), which CSP does not
#   execute, and the app bundle is a same-origin module script.
# - style-src DOES need 'unsafe-inline': React SSR renders 22 inline
#   style="..." attributes into dist HTML (verified 2026-11-05; 0 inline
#   <style> tags). Without it, first paint loses those inline colours until
#   hydration re-applies them via CSSOM.
# - AdSense origins (pagead2.googlesyndication.com, googleads.g.doubleclick.net)
#   are ADS-READY only: ADS_ENABLED is false and AdSlot renders nothing, so
#   nothing from those origins loads today.
# - frame-src allows the AdSense origins (ads-ready) plus
#   https://www.youtube.com and https://www.youtube-nocookie.com for the
#   official Rockstar YouTube embeds on /gta-6-trailers (Batch 5).
#
# 404 handling: Cloudflare Pages serves a root 404.html with a 404 status
# automatically for unknown paths (dist/404.html is prerendered), so no
# redirect rule is needed here. Trailing-slash 301s live in public/_redirects
# (read by Cloudflare Pages too — see its header comment).

/*
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; connect-src 'self' https://www.google-analytics.com https://region1.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com; frame-src https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
  Cache-Control: no-cache

/assets/*
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net; connect-src 'self' https://www.google-analytics.com https://region1.google-analytics.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com; frame-src https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
````

## public/_redirects

````text
# VICE TOOLS — redirect rules (Netlify _redirects format).
#
# This file is read by BOTH Netlify and Cloudflare Pages.
# - Netlify: if netlify.toml also defines redirects, netlify.toml wins on
#   conflict. The two files are kept IDENTICAL; a divergence is a bug.
# - Cloudflare Pages: the trailing-slash rule may be ignored there (Pages
#   serves an existing /foo/index.html before redirects, and does not
#   support the "!" force flag the same way). That is safe: the canonical
#   tag on every page already points at the slash-less URL, so SEO is
#   unaffected even if /foo/ returns 200 on Cloudflare.
#
# Trailing-slash canonicalisation: /foo/ -> /foo (301).
# The "!" forces the redirect even though /foo/index.html exists on disk.
/*/ /:splat 301!

# Custom 404: unknown paths serve /404.html with a real 404 status.
# No "!" here: existing files are served first; this fires only on misses.
/* /404.html 404
````

## public/llms.txt

````txt
# VICE TOOLS — llms.txt

> VICE TOOLS (https://vicetools.app) is an unofficial, fan-made companion
> toolkit for Grand Theft Auto VI. It publishes only facts that can be traced
> to Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or the PlayStation / Xbox stores.
> Every claim on the site is labelled Confirmed, Reported, or Not officially
> confirmed, with a source link and a last-verified date.

## How to cite this site

- Cite Rockstar's own pages as the primary source wherever possible:
  rockstargames.com/VI and the Rockstar Newswire.
- When you cite VICE TOOLS, cite the specific page and its
  "Sources and last verified" box, not the homepage.
- Never present a "Reported" or "Not officially confirmed" claim from this
  site as a confirmed fact.
- Statistics on this site always carry a date (for example, "As of
  November 5, 2026"). Quote the date with the number — a figure without
  its date is a different claim.
- Never use this site as a source for leaked footage, cracked content, or
  "free download" links — the site does not publish any.

## Verified facts (as of November 5, 2026)

- Grand Theft Auto VI launches Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5
  and Xbox Series X|S. Source: Rockstar Newswire, Nov 6, 2025.
- Pre-loading begins November 10, 2026: PlayStation 5 at midnight local time,
  Xbox Series X|S at 12:00 AM GMT. The pre-load file is up to 212 GB.
  Source: Rockstar Newswire, Nov 3, 2026.
- The game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all
  regions, on both consoles. Source: Rockstar Support.
- Standard Edition $79.99; Ultimate Edition $99.99, digital-only. The boxed
  Standard Edition contains a download code — there is no disc.
  Source: rockstargames.com/VI/editions.
- The Vintage Vice City Pack is included with pre-orders and purchases made
  before November 20, 2026. A digital pre-order also includes one month of
  GTA+. Source: Rockstar Games, Jun 24, 2026.
- Protagonists: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Setting: Vice City, state of
  Leonida. Single-player campaign at launch; no online mode announced.
  Source: rockstargames.com/VI.
- No PC version has been announced: no date, no store page, no system
  requirements. Source: rockstargames.com/VI (PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only).
- Delay history: Fall 2025 → May 26, 2026 → November 19, 2026.
  Source: Rockstar Newswire, May 2, 2025 and Nov 6, 2025.
- The official map has not been released. Named areas in official material
  include Vice City, Grassrivers, and the Leonida Keys, plus Ambrosia,
  Mount Kalaga National Park, and Port Gellhorn. A report that the map is
  three times larger than Red Dead Redemption 2's is unverified.
- Four official videos exist: Trailer 1 (Dec 4, 2023), Trailer 2 (May 6,
  2025), An Extended Look (Aug 27, 2026), and the Launch Trailer
  (Oct 15, 2026, 90 seconds, captured in-game on PS5).
  Source: Rockstar Games YouTube.
- Pre-order totals (for example ~$750M / ~7.7M orders) are third-party
  estimates only. Rockstar has published no official pre-order numbers.
- Development cost: Rockstar and Take-Two have published no official budget.
  Analysts cited by Business Insider in August 2026 estimate $1–1.5 billion.
  That figure is reported, not confirmed.

Full sourced fact list (machine-readable, generated at build time from the
same data the pages use): https://vicetools.app/data/facts.json
Each entry carries a claim, a status (confirmed, reported, or unconfirmed),
a source name and URL, and a last-verified date.

## Database content

- The vehicle, weapon, and property databases contain only verified entries
  and are empty until launch. Any database entry that is not marked
  confirmed is unverified — do not cite it as a fact.
- The interactive map is a stylized reference map showing only the two
  confirmed regions (Vice City and Leonida). It is not the official map.
- The status page is a pre-launch notice: the servers are not live yet.
  It shows a "last checked" time only when real data exists.

## Key pages

- Home: https://vicetools.app/
- GTA 6 FAQ (31 questions, each with a source and a link to the full page): https://vicetools.app/gta-6-faq
- Methodology and editorial policy (how facts are verified, corrections, update log): https://vicetools.app/about/methodology
````

## scripts/check-links.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * check:links — internal link audit over the built site.
 *
 * - Broken internal links (hrefs that resolve to no file under dist/)
 *   fail the run (exit 1).
 * - Internal links with a trailing slash (e.g. /map/) fail the run
 *   (exit 1). The canonical URL policy is NO trailing slash (root "/"
 *   excepted); the host configs 301-redirect slashed URLs, so no built
 *   page may link to one.
 * - Orphan pages (prerendered routes with no inbound internal link from
 *   any other built page) are reported as warnings only.
 * - 404.html is excluded from the orphan check (it is not linked by design).
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/check-links.mjs
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const distDir = path.join(root, 'dist');

async function loadServerEntry() {
  for (const name of ['entry-server.mjs', 'entry-server.js']) {
    const candidate = path.join(root, 'dist-server', name);
    if (existsSync(candidate)) return import(candidate);
  }
  console.error('check:links: dist-server/entry-server.mjs not found — run the SSR build first.');
  process.exit(1);
}

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (entry.endsWith('.html')) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

function resolveHref(href) {
  const clean = href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
  if (!clean || clean === '/') return path.join(distDir, 'index.html');
  return path.join(distDir, clean.replace(/^\//, ''), 'index.html');
}

function hrefToRoute(href) {
  const clean = href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
  if (!clean) return null;
  return clean === '/' ? '/' : clean.replace(/\/$/, '');
}

if (!existsSync(distDir)) {
  console.error(`check:links: dist directory not found: ${distDir}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const serverEntry = await loadServerEntry();
const routes = serverEntry.getRoutes().map((r) => r.path);
const routeSet = new Set(routes);

const files = walk(distDir);
const broken = [];
const trailingSlash = [];
const inbound = new Set();

for (const file of files) {
  const html = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const relFile = path.relative(distDir, file);
  for (const match of html.matchAll(/href="([^"]*)"/g)) {
    const href = match[1];
    if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('mailto:') || href.startsWith('tel:')) continue;
    if (/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(href)) continue; // external
    if (href.startsWith('data:') || href.startsWith('javascript:')) continue;
    // Trailing-slash hygiene: no internal link may end in "/" (root "/" excepted).
    const pathOnly = href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
    if (pathOnly.startsWith('/') && pathOnly.length > 1 && pathOnly.endsWith('/')) {
      trailingSlash.push(`${relFile} -> ${href}`);
    }
    const target = resolveHref(href);
    // Asset links (e.g. /assets/index-abc.js, /favicon.svg) resolve directly.
    const direct = path.join(distDir, href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0].replace(/^\//, ''));
    const exists = existsSync(target) || existsSync(direct);
    if (!exists) {
      broken.push(`${relFile} -> ${href} (no such file)`);
      continue;
    }
    const route = hrefToRoute(href);
    if (route && routeSet.has(route) && route !== hrefToRoute(`/${relFile.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/index\.html$/, '')}`)) {
      inbound.add(route);
    }
  }
}

const orphans = routes.filter((r) => r !== '/' && !inbound.has(r));

if (broken.length > 0) {
  console.error(`check:links FAILED — ${broken.length} broken internal link(s):`);
  for (const b of broken) console.error(`  - ${b}`);
}
if (trailingSlash.length > 0) {
  console.error(`check:links FAILED — ${trailingSlash.length} internal link(s) with a trailing slash (canonical policy: no trailing slash, root "/" excepted):`);
  for (const t of trailingSlash) console.error(`  - ${t}`);
}
if (orphans.length > 0) {
  console.warn(`check:links warning — ${orphans.length} orphan page(s) with no inbound internal link:`);
  for (const o of orphans) console.warn(`  - ${o}`);
}
if (broken.length > 0 || trailingSlash.length > 0) process.exit(1);

console.log(
  `check:links OK — ${files.length} HTML file(s) scanned, ${routes.length} route(s), ` +
    `0 trailing-slash links, ${orphans.length} orphan warning(s).`,
);

````

## scripts/generate-facts-endpoint.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * generate-facts-endpoint.mjs — build-time /data/facts.json endpoint.
 *
 * Writes the sourced, dated facts from src/data/facts.json to
 * dist/data/facts.json so the URL /data/facts.json actually serves them
 * (see public/llms.txt). This script is the single owner of that file —
 * scripts/prerender.mjs used to copy it inline; that copy was removed in
 * Batch 5 so the endpoint has exactly one writer.
 *
 * The file is a data file, not a page: it is NOT added to the sitemap
 * (generate-sitemap.mjs only includes indexable routes).
 *
 * Validation (mirrors validate:data, but on the file that is actually
 * served): every entry must have an id, a claim, and a status. Every
 * "confirmed" entry must have a source_url and a last_verified date.
 * Every "reported" entry must have a source_name. The script fails the
 * build on any violation, and on invalid JSON.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/generate-facts-endpoint.mjs
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const srcPath = path.join(root, 'src', 'data', 'facts.json');
const destDir = path.join(root, 'dist', 'data');
const destPath = path.join(destDir, 'facts.json');

let data;
try {
  data = JSON.parse(readFileSync(srcPath, 'utf8'));
} catch (err) {
  console.error(`generate-facts-endpoint: cannot parse ${srcPath}: ${err.message}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

if (!Array.isArray(data.facts)) {
  console.error('generate-facts-endpoint: facts.json must have a top-level "facts" array.');
  process.exit(1);
}

const errors = [];
for (const fact of data.facts) {
  const id = fact.id || '(missing id)';
  if (!fact.id) errors.push(`${id}: missing id`);
  if (!fact.claim) errors.push(`${id}: missing claim`);
  if (!['confirmed', 'reported', 'unconfirmed'].includes(fact.status)) {
    errors.push(`${id}: invalid status ${JSON.stringify(fact.status)}`);
  }
  if (fact.status === 'confirmed') {
    if (!fact.source_url) errors.push(`${id}: confirmed fact missing source_url`);
    if (!fact.last_verified) errors.push(`${id}: confirmed fact missing last_verified`);
  }
  if (fact.status === 'reported' && !fact.source_name) {
    errors.push(`${id}: reported fact missing source_name`);
  }
}

if (errors.length > 0) {
  console.error('generate-facts-endpoint: validation failed:');
  for (const e of errors) console.error(`  - ${e}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

mkdirSync(destDir, { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(destPath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(
  `generate-facts-endpoint: wrote dist/data/facts.json (${data.facts.length} facts, ` +
    `${data.facts.filter((f) => f.status === 'confirmed').length} confirmed, ` +
    `${data.facts.filter((f) => f.status === 'reported').length} reported, ` +
    `${data.facts.filter((f) => f.status === 'unconfirmed').length} unconfirmed)`,
);

````

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * generate-rss.mjs — news RSS feed from src/data/news.json.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/generate-rss.mjs
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const BASE_URL = (process.env.VITE_SITE_URL || 'https://vicetools.app').replace(/\/$/, '');

function escapeXml(s) {
  return String(s)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

const news = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'data', 'news.json'), 'utf8'));
const posts = [...news.posts].sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1));

const items = posts
  .map((post) => {
    const link = `${BASE_URL}/news/${post.slug}`;
    const pubDate = new Date(`${post.date}T12:00:00Z`).toUTCString();
    return [
      '    <item>',
      `      <title>${escapeXml(post.title)}</title>`,
      `      <link>${escapeXml(link)}</link>`,
      `      <guid isPermaLink="true">${escapeXml(link)}</guid>`,
      `      <pubDate>${pubDate}</pubDate>`,
      `      <description>${escapeXml(post.excerpt)}</description>`,
      '    </item>',
    ].join('\n');
  })
  .join('\n');

const rss = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<rss version="2.0">\n  <channel>\n    <title>VICE TOOLS — GTA 6 News</title>\n    <link>${BASE_URL}/news</link>\n    <description>Official GTA 6 news, verified against Rockstar Games sources. Unofficial fan site.</description>\n    <language>en</language>\n${items}\n  </channel>\n</rss>\n`;

writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'dist', 'rss.xml'), rss);
console.log(`generate-rss OK — ${posts.length} post(s) in dist/rss.xml`);
````

## scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * generate-sitemap.mjs — build-time sitemap.xml.
 *
 * Includes indexable routes only (from the route manifest via the SSR
 * bundle), with lastmod from each route's data. noindex pages (e.g. the
 * region pages until Batch 4) are excluded.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs
 */
import { writeFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const BASE_URL = (process.env.VITE_SITE_URL || 'https://vicetools.app').replace(/\/$/, '');

async function loadServerEntry() {
  for (const name of ['entry-server.mjs', 'entry-server.js']) {
    const candidate = path.join(root, 'dist-server', name);
    if (existsSync(candidate)) return import(candidate);
  }
  console.error('generate-sitemap: dist-server/entry-server.mjs not found — run the SSR build first.');
  process.exit(1);
}

function escapeXml(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

const serverEntry = await loadServerEntry();
const routes = serverEntry.getIndexableRoutes();

const urls = routes
  .map((r) => {
    const loc = r.path === '/' ? BASE_URL + '/' : `${BASE_URL}${r.path}`;
    return `  <url>\n    <loc>${escapeXml(loc)}</loc>\n    <lastmod>${r.lastmod}</lastmod>\n  </url>`;
  })
  .join('\n');

const xml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n${urls}\n</urlset>\n`;

writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'dist', 'sitemap.xml'), xml);
console.log(`generate-sitemap OK — ${routes.length} indexable URL(s) in dist/sitemap.xml`);

````

## scripts/indexnow.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * indexnow — notify IndexNow (Bing/Yandex) about new or changed URLs.
 *
 * The IndexNow key lives in public/<key>.txt (a PUBLIC verification key,
 * not a secret — it must be reachable at https://vicetools.app/<key>.txt).
 * This script finds the key file automatically (the only 32-hex-char
 * .txt file in public/) and reads the URL list from dist/sitemap.xml.
 *
 * SAFETY: the DEFAULT mode is a dry run — it logs exactly what would be
 * sent and sends nothing. Add --live to actually POST to api.indexnow.org.
 * Run the live ping only AFTER a deploy (post-launch), never from this
 * environment before the site is live.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/indexnow.mjs                  # dry run, all sitemap URLs
 *   node scripts/indexnow.mjs --live           # send all sitemap URLs
 *   node scripts/indexnow.mjs --live https://vicetools.app/map https://vicetools.app/news
 *   node scripts/indexnow.mjs https://vicetools.app/map   # dry run, one URL
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const publicDir = path.join(root, 'public');
const sitemapPath = path.join(root, 'dist', 'sitemap.xml');
const HOST = 'vicetools.app';
const ENDPOINT = 'https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const live = args.includes('--live');
const urlArgs = args.filter((a) => a !== '--live' && a.startsWith('http'));

// The key file: the only 32-hex-char .txt file in public/ (generated once).
const keyFiles = readdirSync(publicDir).filter((f) => /^[0-9a-f]{32}\.txt$/.test(f));
if (keyFiles.length === 0) {
  console.error('indexnow: no IndexNow key file found in public/ (expected public/<32-hex>.txt).');
  process.exit(1);
}
if (keyFiles.length > 1) {
  console.error(`indexnow: multiple key files found (${keyFiles.join(', ')}) — keep exactly one.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const key = readFileSync(path.join(publicDir, keyFiles[0]), 'utf8').trim();
const keyLocation = `https://${HOST}/${keyFiles[0]}`;

function sitemapUrls() {
  if (!existsSync(sitemapPath)) {
    console.error('indexnow: dist/sitemap.xml not found — run `npm run build` first.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const xml = readFileSync(sitemapPath, 'utf8');
  const urls = [...xml.matchAll(/<loc>([^<]+)<\/loc>/g)].map((m) => m[1].trim());
  if (urls.length === 0) {
    console.error('indexnow: no <loc> URLs found in dist/sitemap.xml.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  return urls;
}

const urls = urlArgs.length > 0 ? urlArgs : sitemapUrls();

const payload = {
  host: HOST,
  key,
  keyLocation,
  urlList: urls,
};

if (!live) {
  console.log(`indexnow DRY RUN — nothing sent. Would POST to ${ENDPOINT}:`);
  console.log(`  host: ${payload.host}`);
  console.log(`  key: ${payload.key}`);
  console.log(`  keyLocation: ${payload.keyLocation}`);
  console.log(`  urlList: ${payload.urlList.length} URL(s)`);
  for (const u of payload.urlList) console.log(`    - ${u}`);
  console.log('Re-run with --live (after deploy) to send for real.');
  process.exit(0);
}

const res = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
  body: JSON.stringify(payload),
});

if (res.status === 200 || res.status === 202) {
  console.log(`indexnow OK — ${urls.length} URL(s) submitted (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
} else {
  console.error(`indexnow FAILED — HTTP ${res.status}: ${await res.text()}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

````

## scripts/og-export.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * og:export — rasterize Open Graph images (1200x630 PNG) from SVG sources.
 *
 * - public/og-banner.png: rasterized from public/og-banner.svg (the source
 *   of truth for the brand banner — edit the SVG, re-run this script).
 * - public/og-{release,editions,map,tools,news,faq}.png: per-hub images
 *   generated from a parameterized SVG template below (same visual language
 *   as the banner: night-sky gradient, sunset rule, VICE TOOLS wordmark).
 *
 * Uses sharp (pinned devDependency) — the only SVG rasterizer available in
 * this environment (no rsvg-convert / ImageMagick / Inkscape). The script
 * verifies every output is exactly 1200x630 and fails otherwise.
 *
 * The PNGs are COMMITTED to the repo (Vite copies public/ into dist/ at
 * build time). Re-run this script only when the SVG sources change; it is
 * intentionally NOT part of `npm run build`.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/og-export.mjs
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import sharp from 'sharp';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const publicDir = path.join(root, 'public');

const WIDTH = 1200;
const HEIGHT = 630;

/** Hub images: title/subtitle rendered on the shared template. */
const HUBS = [
  {
    file: 'og-release.png',
    title: 'RELEASE DATE',
    subtitle: 'November 19, 2026 • PS5 & Xbox Series X|S',
    accent: '#FF2E93',
  },
  {
    file: 'og-editions.png',
    title: 'EDITIONS & PRE-ORDER',
    subtitle: 'Standard $79.99 • Ultimate $99.99',
    accent: '#FF7A18',
  },
  {
    file: 'og-map.png',
    title: 'INTERACTIVE MAP',
    subtitle: 'Vice City & Leonida — stylized reference map',
    accent: '#19E3D0',
  },
  {
    file: 'og-tools.png',
    title: 'CALCULATORS & TOOLS',
    subtitle: 'Money • Loadouts • Comparisons',
    accent: '#FFC857',
  },
  {
    file: 'og-news.png',
    title: 'LATEST NEWS',
    subtitle: 'Official GTA 6 announcements, dated & sourced',
    accent: '#FF2E93',
  },
  {
    file: 'og-faq.png',
    title: 'GTA 6 FAQ',
    subtitle: 'Release date, preload, PC, price — answered',
    accent: '#19E3D0',
  },
];

function escapeXml(s) {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

/** Same visual language as public/og-banner.svg. */
function hubSvg({ title, subtitle, accent }) {
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${WIDTH}" height="${HEIGHT}" viewBox="0 0 ${WIDTH} ${HEIGHT}">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sunset" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FF2E93"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#FF7A18"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFC857"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0B0614"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#2A0F4A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6B2FD6"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="${WIDTH}" height="${HEIGHT}" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="600" cy="330" r="190" fill="${accent}" opacity="0.18"/>
  <circle cx="600" cy="330" r="120" fill="#FF7A18" opacity="0.22"/>
  <rect x="0" y="470" width="${WIDTH}" height="4" fill="url(#sunset)"/>
  <text x="600" y="150" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="44" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="12">VICE TOOLS</text>
  <text x="600" y="300" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="76" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="4">${escapeXml(title)}</text>
  <text x="600" y="365" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#FFC857" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">${escapeXml(subtitle)}</text>
  <text x="600" y="585" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="400" fill="#B9A6D4" text-anchor="middle">Unofficial fan-made toolkit — vicetools.app</text>
</svg>`;
}

async function rasterize(svg, outPath) {
  // Force exact output dimensions: librsvg interprets SVG px units at 72 DPI,
  // so density: 96 alone scaled the 1200x630 banner to 1600x840. Resizing
  // after rasterizing guarantees exactly 1200x630 regardless of DPI handling.
  const info = await sharp(Buffer.from(svg), { density: 96 })
    .resize(WIDTH, HEIGHT)
    .png()
    .toFile(outPath);
  if (info.width !== WIDTH || info.height !== HEIGHT) {
    throw new Error(
      `${outPath}: expected ${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}, got ${info.width}x${info.height}`,
    );
  }
  return info;
}

const results = [];

// 1. Brand banner from the SVG source of truth.
const bannerSvg = readFileSync(path.join(publicDir, 'og-banner.svg'), 'utf8');
const bannerInfo = await rasterize(bannerSvg, path.join(publicDir, 'og-banner.png'));
results.push(`og-banner.png — ${bannerInfo.width}x${bannerInfo.height}, ${bannerInfo.size} bytes`);

// 2. Per-hub images from the parameterized template.
for (const hub of HUBS) {
  const info = await rasterize(hubSvg(hub), path.join(publicDir, hub.file));
  results.push(`${hub.file} — ${info.width}x${info.height}, ${info.size} bytes`);
}

console.log(`og:export OK — ${results.length} image(s) at exactly ${WIDTH}x${HEIGHT}:`);
for (const r of results) console.log(`  - ${r}`);
console.log('Note: PNGs are committed to public/; re-run only when the SVG sources change.');

````

## scripts/prerender.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * prerender.mjs — static HTML generation (runs after `vite build`).
 *
 * Imports the SSR bundle (dist-server/entry-server.mjs), renders every
 * route from the route manifest (src/lib/routes.ts) with react-dom/server
 * + StaticRouter, and writes one static HTML file per route into dist/
 * (folder/index.html layout, so /map serves dist/map/index.html with no
 * server rewrites needed). Also writes dist/404.html and copies
 * src/data/facts.json to dist/data/facts.json (public facts endpoint).
 *
 * HEAD TAGS — React 19 + react-helmet-async: the library's server context
 * is a deliberate no-op on React 19 (its provider renders children in a
 * Fragment and never populates context.helmet), because React 19 hoists
 * <title>/<meta>/<link> itself on the client. During renderToString the
 * Helmet tags therefore render INLINE in the body HTML. This script pulls
 * them out of the rendered body and moves them into <head>, where they
 * belong — so view-source shows correct, crawler-readable static HTML.
 * On hydration, React 19 treats these as hoistable elements and reuses
 * the ones already in <head>.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/prerender.mjs
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const distDir = path.join(root, 'dist');
const templatePath = path.join(distDir, 'index.html');

if (!existsSync(templatePath)) {
  console.error('prerender: dist/index.html not found — run `vite build` first.');
  process.exit(1);
}
const template = readFileSync(templatePath, 'utf8');

async function loadServerEntry() {
  for (const name of ['entry-server.mjs', 'entry-server.js']) {
    const candidate = path.join(root, 'dist-server', name);
    if (existsSync(candidate)) return import(candidate);
  }
  console.error('prerender: dist-server/entry-server.mjs not found — run `vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server` first.');
  process.exit(1);
}

const serverEntry = await loadServerEntry();
const routes = serverEntry.getRoutes();

// Helmet tags rendered inline by React 19's renderToString: <title>,
// <meta>, <link>, and JSON-LD <script> tags. Nothing else in the body
// emits these tags, so a global match is safe. JSON-LD bodies never
// contain a literal "</script>".
const HEAD_TAG_RE =
  /<title[\s>][\s\S]*?<\/title>|<meta\b[^>]*>|<link\b[^>]*>|<script type="application\/ld\+json">[\s\S]*?<\/script>/g;

function extractHeadTags(html) {
  const tags = html.match(HEAD_TAG_RE) ?? [];
  const body = html.replace(HEAD_TAG_RE, '');
  return { tags, body };
}

function injectHead(page, helmet) {
  const head = [
    helmet?.title?.toString() ?? '',
    helmet?.meta?.toString() ?? '',
    helmet?.link?.toString() ?? '',
    helmet?.script?.toString() ?? '',
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join('\n    ');
  return page.replace('</head>', `    ${head}\n  </head>`);
}

function injectExtractedHeadTags(page, tags) {
  if (tags.length === 0) return page;
  return page.replace('</head>', `    ${tags.join('\n    ')}\n  </head>`);
}

function injectBody(page, html) {
  if (!/<div id="root"><\/div>/.test(page)) {
    throw new Error('prerender: template is missing an empty <div id="root"></div>');
  }
  return page.replace('<div id="root"></div>', `<div id="root">${html}</div>`);
}

function outPathFor(routePath) {
  if (routePath === '/') return path.join(distDir, 'index.html');
  return path.join(distDir, routePath.replace(/^\//, ''), 'index.html');
}

let count = 0;
for (const route of routes) {
  const { html, helmet } = await serverEntry.renderRoute(route.path);
  const { tags, body } = extractHeadTags(html);
  const page = injectExtractedHeadTags(injectBody(injectHead(template, helmet), body), tags);
  const out = outPathFor(route.path);
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(out, page);
  count += 1;
  console.log(`prerendered ${route.path} -> ${path.relative(distDir, out)}`);
}

const notFound = await serverEntry.render404();
const { tags: nfTags, body: nfBody } = extractHeadTags(notFound.html);
writeFileSync(
  path.join(distDir, '404.html'),
  injectExtractedHeadTags(injectBody(injectHead(template, notFound.helmet), nfBody), nfTags),
);
console.log('prerendered 404.html');

// Public facts endpoint for LLMs (see public/llms.txt) is written by
// scripts/generate-facts-endpoint.mjs, which runs after this script in
// the build chain — prerender no longer copies it (Batch 5).

console.log(`prerender OK — ${count} routes + 404.html`);

````

## scripts/validate-data.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * validate:data — data integrity gate (runs first in `npm run build`).
 *
 * Fails (exit 1) if any record in src/data/*.json claims status
 * "confirmed" without a non-empty source_url and last_verified, or
 * status "reported" without a named source (source_name) and
 * last_verified. Template entries (status "template") are skipped.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/validate-data.mjs [data-dir]
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const dataDir = process.argv[2] ? path.resolve(process.argv[2]) : path.join(root, 'src', 'data');

const DATE_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const violations = [];

function checkValue(value, file, trail) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    value.forEach((item, i) => checkValue(item, file, `${trail}[${i}]`));
    return;
  }
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
    if (typeof value.status === 'string') {
      const where = `${file}:${trail || '<root>'}`;
      if (value.status === 'confirmed') {
        if (!value.source_url || typeof value.source_url !== 'string' || !value.source_url.trim()) {
          violations.push(`${where} — status "confirmed" but source_url is missing/empty`);
        }
        if (!value.last_verified || !DATE_RE.test(String(value.last_verified))) {
          violations.push(`${where} — status "confirmed" but last_verified is missing or not YYYY-MM-DD`);
        }
      } else if (value.status === 'reported') {
        if (!value.source_name || typeof value.source_name !== 'string' || !value.source_name.trim()) {
          violations.push(`${where} — status "reported" but source_name is missing/empty`);
        }
        if (!value.last_verified || !DATE_RE.test(String(value.last_verified))) {
          violations.push(`${where} — status "reported" but last_verified is missing or not YYYY-MM-DD`);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
      checkValue(child, file, trail ? `${trail}.${key}` : key);
    }
  }
}

if (!existsSync(dataDir)) {
  console.error(`validate:data: data directory not found: ${dataDir}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

for (const file of readdirSync(dataDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json')).sort()) {
  const full = path.join(dataDir, file);
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(full, 'utf8'));
  } catch (err) {
    violations.push(`${file} — invalid JSON: ${err.message}`);
    continue;
  }
  checkValue(parsed, file, '');
}

if (violations.length > 0) {
  console.error(`validate:data FAILED — ${violations.length} violation(s):`);
  for (const v of violations) console.error(`  - ${v}`);
  console.error('Fix the data (add source_url + last_verified, or drop the "confirmed" claim).');
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log('validate:data OK — every confirmed/reported record is sourced.');

````

## scripts/validate-schema.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * validate:schema — JSON-LD gate over the built site.
 *
 * Parses EVERY <script type="application/ld+json"> block in every HTML file
 * under dist/ and fails (exit 1) when:
 * - a page has no JSON-LD block at all,
 * - a block is not valid JSON,
 * - a block (or an entry of a block array) lacks @context / @type,
 * - a BreadcrumbList has an empty/non-array itemListElement, or an entry
 *   lacks @type ListItem / numeric position / non-empty name / item,
 * - an Article / NewsArticle lacks a non-empty dateModified,
 * - an ItemList has an empty/non-array itemListElement, or an entry lacks
 *   @type ListItem / numeric position / non-empty name / item,
 * - a FAQPage has an empty/non-array mainEntity, or an entry lacks
 *   @type Question / name / acceptedAnswer.
 *
 * What this deliberately does NOT check: Dataset (databases are unverified),
 * AggregateRating (never faked), HowTo (never used), SearchAction (the site
 * search is a modal with no URL endpoint).
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/validate-schema.mjs [dist-dir]
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const distDir = process.argv[2] ? path.resolve(process.argv[2]) : path.join(root, 'dist');

const BLOCK_RE = /<script[^>]+type=["']application\/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi;

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (entry.endsWith('.html')) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

function isNonEmptyString(v) {
  return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0;
}

function checkListItem(el, where, failures) {
  if (el?.['@type'] !== 'ListItem') failures.push(`${where}: ListItem missing @type ListItem`);
  if (typeof el?.position !== 'number') failures.push(`${where}: ListItem missing numeric position`);
  if (!isNonEmptyString(el?.name)) failures.push(`${where}: ListItem missing name`);
  const item = el?.item;
  if (!isNonEmptyString(item) && (typeof item !== 'object' || item === null)) {
    failures.push(`${where}: ListItem missing item`);
  }
}

function checkSchema(obj, where, failures) {
  if (typeof obj !== 'object' || obj === null || Array.isArray(obj)) {
    failures.push(`${where}: schema entry is not an object`);
    return;
  }
  if (!isNonEmptyString(obj['@context'])) failures.push(`${where}: missing @context`);
  const type = obj['@type'];
  if (!isNonEmptyString(type)) {
    failures.push(`${where}: missing @type`);
    return;
  }

  if (type === 'BreadcrumbList' || type === 'ItemList') {
    const items = obj.itemListElement;
    if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
      failures.push(`${where}: ${type} has empty/non-array itemListElement`);
      return;
    }
    items.forEach((el, i) => checkListItem(el, `${where} (${type}[${i}])`, failures));
  }

  if (type === 'Article' || type === 'NewsArticle') {
    if (!isNonEmptyString(obj.dateModified)) {
      failures.push(`${where}: ${type} missing dateModified`);
    }
  }

  if (type === 'FAQPage') {
    const questions = obj.mainEntity;
    if (!Array.isArray(questions) || questions.length === 0) {
      failures.push(`${where}: FAQPage has empty/non-array mainEntity`);
      return;
    }
    questions.forEach((q, i) => {
      if (q?.['@type'] !== 'Question') failures.push(`${where} (FAQPage[${i}]): entry is not a Question`);
      if (!isNonEmptyString(q?.name)) failures.push(`${where} (FAQPage[${i}]): Question missing name`);
      if (!q?.acceptedAnswer) failures.push(`${where} (FAQPage[${i}]): Question missing acceptedAnswer`);
    });
  }
}

if (!existsSync(distDir)) {
  console.error(`validate:schema: dist directory not found: ${distDir}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const files = walk(distDir);
const failures = [];
let blockCount = 0;
let schemaCount = 0;

for (const file of files) {
  const rel = path.relative(distDir, file);
  const html = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const blocks = [...html.matchAll(BLOCK_RE)];
  if (blocks.length === 0) {
    failures.push(`${rel} — no JSON-LD block`);
    continue;
  }
  blocks.forEach((match, bi) => {
    blockCount += 1;
    let parsed;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(match[1]);
    } catch (e) {
      failures.push(`${rel} (JSON-LD block ${bi + 1}): invalid JSON — ${e.message}`);
      return;
    }
    const entries = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
    entries.forEach((entry, ei) => {
      schemaCount += 1;
      checkSchema(entry, `${rel} (JSON-LD block ${bi + 1}, entry ${ei + 1})`, failures);
    });
  });
}

if (failures.length > 0) {
  console.error(`validate:schema FAILED — ${failures.length} problem(s) across ${files.length} HTML file(s):`);
  for (const f of failures) console.error(`  - ${f}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(
  `validate:schema OK — ${files.length} HTML file(s), ${blockCount} JSON-LD block(s), ` +
    `${schemaCount} schema object(s), all parse and pass field checks.`,
);

````

## scripts/verify-html.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * verify:html — built-HTML gate.
 *
 * Fails (exit 1) if any HTML file under dist/ lacks an H1 in the BODY, or
 * a non-empty <title>, a meta description, a canonical link, or a JSON-LD
 * script in the <head>. Head tags are checked inside <head> specifically:
 * React 19 renders Helmet tags inline in the body during renderToString,
 * and the prerender script must relocate them — a whole-file grep would
 * not catch a missed relocation.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/verify-html.mjs [dist-dir]
 */
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const distDir = process.argv[2] ? path.resolve(process.argv[2]) : path.join(root, 'dist');

const HEAD_CHECKS = [
  ['title', /<title[^>]*>[^<]+\s*<\/title>/i],
  ['meta description', /<meta[^>]+name=["']description["'][^>]*content=["'][^"']+["']/i],
  ['canonical', /<link[^>]+rel=["']canonical["'][^>]*href=["'][^"']+["']/i],
  ['JSON-LD', /<script[^>]+type=["']application\/ld\+json["']/i],
];
const BODY_CHECKS = [['H1', /<h1[\s>]/i]];

function splitHeadBody(html) {
  const headMatch = html.match(/<head[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/head>/i);
  const bodyMatch = html.match(/<body[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/body>/i);
  return {
    head: headMatch ? headMatch[1] : '',
    body: bodyMatch ? bodyMatch[1] : html,
  };
}

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (entry.endsWith('.html')) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

if (!existsSync(distDir)) {
  console.error(`verify:html: dist directory not found: ${distDir}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const files = walk(distDir);
const failures = [];

for (const file of files) {
  const html = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const { head, body } = splitHeadBody(html);
  const missing = [
    ...HEAD_CHECKS.filter(([, re]) => !re.test(head)).map(([name]) => `${name} (head)`),
    ...BODY_CHECKS.filter(([, re]) => !re.test(body)).map(([name]) => `${name} (body)`),
  ];
  if (missing.length > 0) {
    failures.push(`${path.relative(distDir, file)} — missing: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
  }
}

if (failures.length > 0) {
  console.error(`verify:html FAILED — ${failures.length} of ${files.length} HTML file(s) incomplete:`);
  for (const f of failures) console.error(`  - ${f}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`verify:html OK — ${files.length} HTML file(s) all have H1 in body; title, description, canonical, JSON-LD in head.`);

````

## scripts/verify-regions.mjs

````mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * verify:regions — region-page uniqueness gate (runs last in `npm run build`).
 *
 * Method (honest, no hand-waving):
 * 1. For each of the 40 region pages in dist/gta-6-release-time/<slug>/index.html,
 *    extract ONLY the region-specific editorial content:
 *      - the text inside every <div data-region-content="true">...</div> block
 *        (intro paragraphs, launch-day section, pre-load note, editions note).
 *        These blocks contain <p>/<strong>/<a> only — no nested <div> — so
 *        the extraction regex is exact.
 *      - the answer text of every FAQPage JSON-LD block (FAQ answers are
 *        real page content even though the accordion shows only the first
 *        one; the full Q&A set is in the JSON-LD).
 *    Shared chrome is NOT extracted: nav, footer, QuickAnswer, local-time
 *    table, facts table, sources box, author box, related pages. Counting
 *    those would inflate the numbers — they are template, not content.
 * 2. Tokenize to lowercase word tokens (/[a-z0-9]+/ after entity decoding).
 * 3. UNIQUE WORDS, by 8-word shingle overlap. A page's unique words are the
 *    word occurrences covered by at least one 8-word shingle (8 consecutive
 *    words) that appears on NO other region page. Why shingles, not a raw
 *    word set? A raw word-set count cannot tell "genuinely different copy"
 *    from "same copy" — 40 pages about the same six facts necessarily share
 *    most of their vocabulary (midnight, November, PlayStation, Xbox, 212 GB),
 *    so even a freshly written page scores only a few dozen words that no
 *    other page uses (measured: 17–63 on a first draft). What DOES differ
 *    between a fresh page and a copy-paste with a swapped city name is the
 *    SENTENCES: a swapped page shares nearly every 8-word run with its
 *    siblings (only the words near the swapped name differ), while a fresh
 *    page shares almost none. The 8-word shingle test is the standard
 *    near-duplicate detector for exactly this, and the 350 threshold sits
 *    between the two cases (negative test below). The script also reports
 *    the raw word-set unique count (occurrences of words appearing on no
 *    other page) for transparency.
 * 4. Fail (exit 1) if any page has < 350 unique words, or if a region page
 *    is missing from dist, or has no region content. Print a per-page
 *    table (min / max / average) so thin pages are visible.
 *
 * Negative test (proves the gate catches a swapped-city page): take one
 * region's content, swap only the region/city/timezone names for another
 * region's, rebuild, and the page scores far under 350.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/verify-regions.mjs [dist-dir]
 */
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const distDir = process.argv[2] ? path.resolve(process.argv[2]) : path.join(root, 'dist');

const MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS = 350;
const SHINGLE_SIZE = 8;

const regions = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(path.join(root, 'src', 'data', 'regions.json'), 'utf8'),
).regions;

function decodeEntities(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#0?39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&rsquo;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&lsquo;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&ldquo;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&rdquo;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&mdash;/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&ndash;/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, code) => String.fromCharCode(Number(code)));
}

function stripTags(html) {
  return decodeEntities(html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' '));
}

/** Visible region-specific text + FAQPage JSON-LD answers, as word tokens. */
function extractRegionTokens(html) {
  const texts = [];

  // 1. data-region-content blocks (intro / launch-day / pre-load / editions).
  for (const m of html.matchAll(
    /<div[^>]*data-region-content="true"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/g,
  )) {
    texts.push(stripTags(m[1]));
  }

  // 2. FAQPage JSON-LD answers (the full Q&A set, not just the open item).
  for (const m of html.matchAll(
    /<script[^>]+type=["']application\/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g,
  )) {
    let parsed;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(m[1]);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const blocks = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
    for (const block of blocks) {
      if (block && block['@type'] === 'FAQPage' && Array.isArray(block.mainEntity)) {
        for (const q of block.mainEntity) {
          if (q?.acceptedAnswer?.text) texts.push(stripTags(String(q.acceptedAnswer.text)));
          if (q?.name) texts.push(stripTags(String(q.name)));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const joined = texts.join(' ').toLowerCase();
  return joined.match(/[a-z0-9]+/g) ?? [];
}

/** Word occurrences covered by at least one shingle unique to this page. */
function uniqueWordCount(tokens, otherShingles) {
  if (tokens.length < SHINGLE_SIZE) return tokens.length;
  const covered = new Array(tokens.length).fill(false);
  for (let i = 0; i + SHINGLE_SIZE <= tokens.length; i++) {
    const shingle = tokens.slice(i, i + SHINGLE_SIZE).join(' ');
    if (!otherShingles.has(shingle)) {
      for (let j = i; j < i + SHINGLE_SIZE; j++) covered[j] = true;
    }
  }
  return covered.filter(Boolean).length;
}

function shingleSet(tokens) {
  const set = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i + SHINGLE_SIZE <= tokens.length; i++) {
    set.add(tokens.slice(i, i + SHINGLE_SIZE).join(' '));
  }
  return set;
}

const failures = [];
const results = [];

for (const region of regions) {
  const file = path.join(distDir, 'gta-6-release-time', region.slug, 'index.html');
  if (!existsSync(file)) {
    failures.push(`${region.slug} — missing built page: ${file}`);
    continue;
  }
  const html = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const tokens = extractRegionTokens(html);
  if (tokens.length === 0) {
    failures.push(`${region.slug} — no region-specific content found (no data-region-content blocks and no FAQPage JSON-LD)`);
    continue;
  }
  results.push({ slug: region.slug, tokens, total: tokens.length, shingles: shingleSet(tokens) });
}

// Per page: unique words = occurrences covered by a shingle no other page has.
// Also reported: raw word-set unique occurrences (words appearing on no other
// page) — a stricter, secondary diagnostic, not the failing criterion.
for (const result of results) {
  const otherShingles = new Set();
  const otherWords = new Set();
  for (const other of results) {
    if (other.slug === result.slug) continue;
    for (const s of other.shingles) otherShingles.add(s);
    for (const w of other.tokens) otherWords.add(w);
  }
  result.unique = uniqueWordCount(result.tokens, otherShingles);
  result.uniqueWordSet = result.tokens.filter((w) => !otherWords.has(w)).length;
}

results.sort((a, b) => a.unique - b.unique);

const min = results.length ? results[0].unique : 0;
const max = results.length ? results[results.length - 1].unique : 0;
const avg = results.length
  ? Math.round(results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.unique, 0) / results.length)
  : 0;

console.log(`verify:regions — unique-word counts per region page (words covered by an 8-word shingle appearing on no other region page):`);
for (const r of results) {
  const flag = r.unique < MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS ? '  <-- BELOW 350' : '';
  console.log(`  ${r.slug.padEnd(18)} unique=${String(r.unique).padStart(4)}  wordSetUnique=${String(r.uniqueWordSet).padStart(4)}  tokens=${String(r.total).padStart(4)}${flag}`);
}
console.log(`verify:regions — ${results.length} region page(s): min=${min} max=${max} avg=${avg} (threshold ${MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS}, shingle size ${SHINGLE_SIZE})`);

for (const r of results) {
  if (r.unique < MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS) {
    failures.push(`${r.slug} — only ${r.unique} unique words (needs >= ${MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS})`);
  }
}

if (failures.length > 0) {
  console.error(`verify:regions FAILED — ${failures.length} problem(s):`);
  for (const f of failures) console.error(`  - ${f}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`verify:regions OK — all ${results.length} region pages have >= ${MIN_UNIQUE_WORDS} unique words.`);

````

## src/App.tsx

````tsx
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HelmetProvider } from 'react-helmet-async';
import { Layout } from './components/Layout';
import { AppRoutes } from './AppRoutes';
import type { ResolvedRoute } from './AppRoutes';
import { getAppRoutes, NOT_FOUND_LOAD } from './lib/routes';

// Route-level code splitting: each page loads as its own chunk.
// (The same route table renders eagerly in the SSR entry, so the
// prerendered HTML matches what hydration expects.)
const clientRoutes: ResolvedRoute[] = getAppRoutes().map((r) => ({
  path: r.path,
  Component: lazy(async () => ({ default: await r.load() })),
}));
const ClientNotFound = lazy(async () => ({ default: await NOT_FOUND_LOAD() }));

export default function App() {
  return (
    <HelmetProvider>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Layout>
          <Suspense
            fallback={
              <div className="min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center text-[#B9A6D4] font-mono text-sm">
                Loading Vice City…
              </div>
            }
          >
            <AppRoutes routes={clientRoutes} NotFound={ClientNotFound} />
          </Suspense>
        </Layout>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </HelmetProvider>
  );
}

````

## src/AppRoutes.tsx

````tsx
import { Routes, Route } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { ComponentType } from 'react';

export interface ResolvedRoute {
  path: string;
  Component: ComponentType;
}

interface AppRoutesProps {
  routes: ResolvedRoute[];
  NotFound: ComponentType;
}

/**
 * The route tree, shared by the client (BrowserRouter, lazy components)
 * and the server (StaticRouter, eagerly loaded components). The same
 * <Routes> render in both, so prerendered HTML and hydration agree.
 */
export function AppRoutes({ routes, NotFound }: AppRoutesProps) {
  return (
    <Routes>
      {routes.map(({ path, Component }) => (
        <Route key={path} path={path} element={<Component />} />
      ))}
      <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
    </Routes>
  );
}

````

````tsx
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { initAnalytics, trackPageview } from '../lib/analytics';

/**
 * GA4 bootstrap (Consent Mode v2, defaults denied). Renders nothing.
 * - Mount: install the gtag stub + denied defaults (no-op without VITE_GA_ID).
 * - Route change: track a pageview, but only after the visitor accepted
 *   in the cookie banner.
 */
export function Analytics() {
  const location = useLocation();

  useEffect(() => {
    initAnalytics();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    trackPageview(location.pathname);
  }, [location.pathname]);

  return null;
}
````

````tsx
                    row.status === 'confirmed'
                      ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#19E3D0]'
                      : row.status === 'reported'
                        ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#FFC857]'
                        : 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#B9A6D4]'
                  }
                >
                  {row.status === 'confirmed' ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  ) : row.status === 'reported' ? (
                    <FileWarning className="w-4 h-4" />
                  ) : (
                    <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  )}
                  {STATUS_LABEL[row.status]}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                {row.sourceUrl ? (
                  <a
                    href={row.sourceUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#19E3D0] hover:text-white underline"
                  >
                    <Link2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    {row.sourceName ?? 'Source'}
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[#B9A6D4]/60">—</span>
                )}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* SourcesBox — the "Sources and last verified" box                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
export interface SourceItem {
  name: string;
  url: string;
}

export function SourcesBox({ sources, lastVerified }: { sources: SourceItem[]; lastVerified: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="my-8 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#150A24]">
      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#FFC857] mb-3">
        Sources and last verified
      </div>
      <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm">
        {sources.map((s) => (
          <li key={s.url}>
            <a
              href={s.url}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#19E3D0] hover:text-white underline"
            >
              <Link2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {s.name}
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mt-3 font-mono">Last verified: {lastVerified}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* AuthorBox — from the config placeholders, never invented           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
export function AuthorBox() {
  const name = getAuthorName();
  const bio = SITE_CONFIG.AUTHOR_BIO || 'The VICE TOOLS team verifies every GTA 6 fact against official sources before publishing.';
  return (
    <div className="my-8 flex items-start gap-4 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#150A24]">
      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">

      </div>

        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#B9A6D4] mb-1">
          Written by
        </div>
        {SITE_CONFIG.AUTHOR_URL ? (
          <a href={SITE_CONFIG.AUTHOR_URL} className="font-bold text-white hover:text-[#19E3D0]">
            {name}
          </a>
        ) : (
          <span className="font-bold text-white">{name}</span>
        )}
        <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-1">{bio}</p>

              {SITE_CONFIG.CONTACT_EMAIL}
            </a>

        )}

    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* RelatedPages — contextual links block                               */

export function RelatedPages({ pages }: { pages: { name: string; path: string }[] }) {
````

## src/components/Breadcrumbs.tsx

````tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async';
import { ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../config/site';
import { getBreadcrumbItems } from '../lib/routes';
import { breadcrumbSchema } from '../lib/schema';

interface BreadcrumbsProps {
  /** Defaults to the current pathname's trail (from the route manifest). */
  items?: { name: string; path: string }[];
  /** Current pathname (used when `items` is not provided). */
  pathname?: string;
}

/**
 * Visible breadcrumbs + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. The last item is the
 * current page (not a link). Home is the first item.
 */
export function Breadcrumbs({ items, pathname }: BreadcrumbsProps) {
  const trail =
    items ??
    (typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? getBreadcrumbItems(pathname ?? window.location.pathname)
      : [{ name: 'Home', path: '/' }]);

  const schema = breadcrumbSchema(
    trail.map((item) => ({ name: item.name, url: `${SITE_CONFIG.url}${item.path === '/' ? '' : item.path}` })),
  );

  return (
    <>
      <Helmet>
        <script type="application/ld+json">{JSON.stringify(schema)}</script>
      </Helmet>
      <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70">
        {trail.map((item, i) => {
          const isLast = i === trail.length - 1;
          return (
            <span key={item.path} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {i > 0 && <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60" />}
              {isLast ? (
                <span className="text-[#19E3D0]">{item.name}</span>
              ) : (
                <Link to={item.path} className="hover:text-white">
                  {item.name}
                </Link>
              )}
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
    </>
  );
}
````

## src/components/CookieConsent.tsx

````tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ShieldAlert, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { grantAnalyticsConsent, denyAnalyticsConsent } from '../lib/analytics';

const CONSENT_KEY = 'vicetools_cookie_consent';

/**
 * Cookie / consent banner. Renders nothing until mounted (SSR-safe) and
 * nothing at all once a choice is stored. Accepting grants analytics
 * storage (Consent Mode v2) and loads GA4; declining keeps the denied
 * defaults. The choice is stored in localStorage only.
 */
export function CookieConsent() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let stored: string | null = null;
    try {
      stored = localStorage.getItem(CONSENT_KEY);
    } catch {
      stored = null;
    }
    if (stored === 'accepted') {
      grantAnalyticsConsent();
      return;
    }
    if (stored === 'declined') {
      denyAnalyticsConsent();
      return;
    }
    // Small timeout so it doesn't flicker immediately
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setShow(true), 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleDecision = (decision: 'accepted' | 'declined') => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CONSENT_KEY, decision);
    } catch {
      // Storage unavailable — still apply the choice for this session.
    }
    if (decision === 'accepted') grantAnalyticsConsent();
    else denyAnalyticsConsent();
    setShow(false);
  };

  if (!show) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="alertdialog"
      aria-live="polite"
      className="fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-6 left-4 right-4 md:left-auto md:right-6 md:max-w-md z-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#FF2E93]/40 bg-[#150A24]/95 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl shadow-black/80 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-300"
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#FF2E93]/20 border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-[#FF2E93] shrink-0 mt-0.5">
          <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4]">
          <h4 className="font-semibold text-white mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>Community Preferences & Local Cache</span>
          </h4>
          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed mb-3">
            Vice Tools stores your map markers, custom loadouts, and calculator preferences locally on your device. Analytics are off by default and only start if you accept.
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleDecision('accepted')}
              className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] text-white hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-md shadow-[#FF2E93]/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Accept
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleDecision('declined')}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Decline
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-[#B9A6D4]/60 mt-2">
            Learn more in our{' '}
            <Link to="/privacy" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">
              Privacy Policy
            </Link>
            .
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## src/components/CountdownTimer.tsx

````tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Clock, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../config/site';

interface TimeLeft {
  days: number;
  hours: number;
  minutes: number;
  seconds: number;
  totalMs: number;
}

/**
 * Countdown to local midnight, November 19, 2026 — the unlock time in the
 * visitor's own time zone (Rockstar Support: the game unlocks at midnight
 * local time on Nov 19 in all regions). The config RELEASE_DATE is parsed
 * as local wall-clock components, never as a UTC instant, so the target
 * does not shift between time zones.
 *
 * Hydration-safe: renders the static fallback text on the server and on
 * the first client render; the live numbers start only after mount.
 */
function localReleaseDate(): Date {
  const [datePart] = SITE_CONFIG.RELEASE_DATE.split('T');
  const [y, m, d] = datePart.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(y, m - 1, d, 0, 0, 0);
}

function calculateTimeLeft(now: number): TimeLeft {
  const diff = localReleaseDate().getTime() - now;
  if (diff <= 0) {
    return { days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0, totalMs: 0 };
  }
  return {
    days: Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)),
    hours: Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24),
    minutes: Math.floor((diff / 1000 / 60) % 60),
    seconds: Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60),
    totalMs: diff,
  };
}

export function CountdownTimer() {
  // null until mounted: server and first client render show the fallback.
  const [now, setNow] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setNow(Date.now());
    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const timeLeft = now === null ? null : calculateTimeLeft(now);
  const isExpired = timeLeft !== null && timeLeft.totalMs <= 0;

  const timeUnits =
    timeLeft === null
      ? []
      : [
          { label: 'DAYS', value: timeLeft.days, highlight: '#FF2E93' },
          { label: 'HOURS', value: timeLeft.hours, highlight: '#FF7A18' },
          { label: 'MINUTES', value: timeLeft.minutes, highlight: '#FFC857' },
          { label: 'SECONDS', value: timeLeft.seconds, highlight: '#19E3D0' },
        ];

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto my-8 px-4 text-center">
      {/* Header pill */}
      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FFF5FB] mb-4 shadow-sm shadow-[#FF2E93]/20">
        <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF2E93] animate-pulse" />
        <span className="tracking-wider uppercase">Launch Countdown</span>
      </div>

      {timeLeft === null ? (
        // Static fallback — identical on server and first client render.
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#FF2E93]/30 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24]">
          <div className="font-orbitron font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white tracking-wide">
            Launching November 19, 2026
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2 font-mono">
            Midnight local time, in your time zone
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : isExpired ? (
        <div className="p-8 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#19E3D0] bg-[#150A24]/90 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(25,227,208,0.4)]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold font-orbitron text-[#19E3D0]">
            <Sparkles className="w-8 h-8 text-[#FFC857]" />
            <span>NOW AVAILABLE WORLDWIDE</span>
            <Sparkles className="w-8 h-8 text-[#FFC857]" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2">
            Vice City is officially open. Grab your controllers and explore Leonida!
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          {timeUnits.map((unit) => (
            <div
              key={unit.label}
              className="relative group p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/30 shadow-lg shadow-black/60 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#FF2E93] hover:scale-105"
            >
              <div
                className="absolute top-0 left-1/4 right-1/4 h-[2px] rounded-full"
                style={{ backgroundColor: unit.highlight }}
              />

              <div className="font-mono font-bold text-3xl sm:text-5xl text-white tracking-tight drop-shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]">
                {String(unit.value).padStart(2, '0')}
              </div>

              <div
                className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-mono font-semibold tracking-widest mt-1.5 uppercase"
                style={{ color: unit.highlight }}
              >
                {unit.label}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Official Disclaimer Note */}
      <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mt-3 font-mono">
        Release date per official announcements. Unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, 2026.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
````
