## src/components/EmailCapture.tsx

````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BellRing, Check } from 'lucide-react';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'vicetools_notify_emails';

/**
 * Honest email capture: client-side only. The address is stored in
 * localStorage on the visitor's own device (there is no backend yet).
 * Copy never promises a delivery we cannot make — it says we will notify
 * this browser when verified data is added.
 */
export function EmailCapture({ title }: { title?: string }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const value = email.trim();
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value)) {
      setError('Please enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }
    setError('');
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const list: string[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      if (!list.includes(value)) {
        list.push(value);
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
      }
    } catch {
      // Storage unavailable — still confirm in-session.
    }
    setSaved(true);
  };

  if (saved) {
    return (
      <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#19E3D0]/40 bg-[#19E3D0]/5 flex items-start gap-3">
        <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19E3D0] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <p className="text-sm text-white/90">
          Saved in this browser. We will show you a notification here when verified data is added.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#FF2E93]/30 bg-[#150A24]">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
        <BellRing className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FF2E93]" />
        <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm">{title ?? 'Get notified when verified data is added'}</span>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mb-3">
        Saved only in this browser — no account, no spam. We will show you a notification here when
        verified entries go live.
      </p>
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
        <input
          type="email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="you@example.com"
          aria-label="Email address"
          className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-[#B9A6D4]/50 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#FF2E93]"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] text-white hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
        >
          Notify me
        </button>
      </div>
      {error && <p className="text-xs text-[#FF7A18] mt-2">{error}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}
````

## src/components/FAQSection.tsx

````tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { BadgeStatus } from './BadgeStatus';

export interface FAQItem {
  id?: string;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  status?: 'confirmed' | 'unconfirmed' | string;
}

interface FAQSectionProps {
  items: FAQItem[];
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  badge?: string;
  badgeColor?: string;
  className?: string;
  renderJsonLd?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Builds Schema.org FAQPage structured data object.
 * Adheres to Google Search Central FAQPage guidelines:
 * https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/faqpage
 */
export function buildFaqPageSchema(items: FAQItem[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'FAQPage',
    mainEntity: items.map((item) => ({
      '@type': 'Question',
      name: item.question,
      acceptedAnswer: {
        '@type': 'Answer',
        text: item.answer,
      },
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Standalone component that injects only the Schema.org FAQPage JSON-LD tag into <head>
 */
export function FaqJsonLd({ faqs }: { faqs: FAQItem[] }) {
  if (!faqs || faqs.length === 0) return null;
  const schema = buildFaqPageSchema(faqs);

  return (
    <Helmet>
      <script type="application/ld+json">
        {JSON.stringify(schema)}
      </script>
    </Helmet>
  );
}

/**
 * Full interactive FAQ Accordion UI with automated JSON-LD injection.
 *
 * SEO NOTE (Batch 5): every answer is rendered in the DOM on every load.
 * Closed answers are hidden with the `hidden` attribute, not removed —
 * so the prerendered HTML (and any crawler) sees the full Q&A text, while
 * visitors still get the accordion behaviour. `useState` only controls
 * which answer is visible, never whether it exists in the document.
 */
export function FAQSection({
  items,
  title = 'Frequently Asked Questions',
  subtitle,
  badge = 'Essential Intel',
  badgeColor = '#FFC857',
  className = '',
  renderJsonLd = true,
}: FAQSectionProps) {
  const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<number | null>(0);

  const toggleIndex = (index: number) => {
    setOpenIndex(openIndex === index ? null : index);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {renderJsonLd && <FaqJsonLd faqs={items} />}

      <section
        className={`max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6 ${className}`}
        aria-label={title}
      >
        {(badge || title) && (
          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            {badge && (
              <span
                className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-current/30 inline-block mb-2"
                style={{ color: badgeColor, backgroundColor: `${badgeColor}15` }}
              >
                {badge}
              </span>
            )}
            <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
              {title}
            </h2>
            {subtitle && (
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] max-w-xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                {subtitle}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {items.map((item, index) => {
            const isOpen = openIndex === index;
            const itemId = item.id || `faq-item-${index}`;
            const contentId = `faq-content-${itemId}`;
            const headerId = `faq-header-${itemId}`;

            return (
              <div
                key={itemId}
                className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#150A24] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 hover:border-[#FF2E93]/40 shadow-md"
              >
                <button
                  id={headerId}
                  onClick={() => toggleIndex(index)}
                  className="w-full p-4 sm:p-5 flex items-center justify-between text-left gap-4 cursor-pointer focus:outline-none"
                  aria-expanded={isOpen}
                  aria-controls={contentId}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {item.status ? (
                      <BadgeStatus status={item.status} size="sm" />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <span className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base text-white">
                      {item.question}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {isOpen ? (
                    <ChevronUp className="w-5 h-5 text-[#FF2E93] shrink-0" />
                  ) : (
                    <ChevronDown className="w-5 h-5 text-[#B9A6D4] shrink-0" />
                  )}
                </button>

                {/* Every answer stays in the DOM; closed ones are hidden
                    (not removed) so prerendered HTML contains the full Q&A. */}
                <div
                  id={contentId}
                  role="region"
                  aria-labelledby={headerId}
                  hidden={!isOpen}
                  className="px-5 pb-5 pt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed border-t border-white/5 animate-in fade-in duration-200"
                >
                  <p>{item.answer}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>
    </>
  );
}

````

## src/components/GlobalSearchModal.tsx

````tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Search, X, MapPin, FileText, ArrowRight, Newspaper, Scale, Globe } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import guidesData from '../data/guides.json';
import newsData from '../data/news.json';
import verifiedMapRegions from '../data/verified-map-regions.json';
import { getRoutes } from '../lib/routes';
import { REGIONS } from '../lib/regions';

interface GlobalSearchModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface SearchItem {
  name: string;
  category: string;
  path: string;
  icon: 'map' | 'guide' | 'news' | 'compare' | 'region' | 'page';
}

const ICONS = {
  map: MapPin,
  guide: FileText,
  news: Newspaper,
  compare: Scale,
  region: Globe,
  page: Search,
} as const;

/**
 * Site search index — built from the route manifest and the verified data
 * files, not from hard-coded lists. Catalog items (vehicles, weapons,
 * properties, locations) are deliberately NOT indexed: no verified entries
 * exist yet, and indexing invented names would surface them as real.
 */
function buildSearchIndex(): SearchItem[] {
  const items: SearchItem[] = [];

  for (const route of getRoutes()) {
    if (route.path === '/') {
      items.push({ name: 'Home — Vice Tools', category: 'Page', path: '/', icon: 'page' });
      continue;
    }
    items.push({
      name: route.title,
      category: 'Page',
      path: route.path,
      icon: route.path.startsWith('/compare') ? 'compare' : route.path.startsWith('/gta-6-release-time') ? 'region' : 'page',
    });
  }

  for (const guide of guidesData) {
    items.push({ name: guide.title, category: 'Guide', path: `/guides/${guide.slug}`, icon: 'guide' });
  }

  for (const post of newsData.posts) {
    items.push({ name: post.title, category: 'News', path: `/news/${post.slug}`, icon: 'news' });
  }

  for (const region of REGIONS) {
    items.push({
      name: `GTA 6 release time in ${region.location}`,
      category: 'Release time',
      path: `/gta-6-release-time/${region.slug}`,
      icon: 'region',
    });
  }

  for (const region of verifiedMapRegions.regions) {
    items.push({
      name: `${region.name} — ${region.category}`,
      category: 'Map region',
      path: '/map',
      icon: 'map',
    });
  }

  return items;
}

export function GlobalSearchModal({ isOpen, onClose }: GlobalSearchModalProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const index = useMemo(buildSearchIndex, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    } else {
      setQuery('');
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Keyboard shortcut listener (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    if (isOpen) window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const results = q
    ? index
        .filter(
          (item) =>
            item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            item.category.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            item.path.toLowerCase().includes(q),
        )
        .slice(0, 10)
    : [];

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSelect = (path: string) => {
    onClose();
    navigate(path);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-start justify-center pt-[10vh] px-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-xl bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl shadow-[#FF2E93]/20 overflow-hidden animate-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-200"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label="Search Vice Tools"
      >
        {/* Input Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-b border-white/10">
          <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-[#FF2E93] shrink-0" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search guides, news, release times, tools..."
            className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-white placeholder-[#B9A6D4]/50 text-base focus:outline-none"
            aria-label="Search Vice Tools"
          />
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close search"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Results */}
        <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto p-2">
          {!q && (
            <div className="p-4 text-center text-sm text-[#B9A6D4]">
              <p className="mb-2 font-semibold text-white">Try searching for:</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
                {['release time', 'preload', 'price', 'PC', 'map', 'trailer'].map((s) => (
                  <button
                    key={s}
                    onClick={() => setQuery(s)}
                    className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-xs hover:border-[#FF2E93] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {s}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {q && results.length === 0 && (
            <div className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-[#B9A6D4]">
              No results for &ldquo;{query}&rdquo;. Try &ldquo;release&rdquo;, &ldquo;preload&rdquo;, or &ldquo;price&rdquo;.
            </div>
          )}

          {results.map((item) => {
            const Icon = ICONS[item.icon];
            return (
              <button
                key={`${item.path}-${item.name}`}
                onClick={() => handleSelect(item.path)}
                className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 text-left group transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#FF2E93]/10 text-[#FF2E93] shrink-0">
                  <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-sm font-medium text-white truncate">{item.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">{item.category}</div>
                </div>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-[#B9A6D4] group-hover:text-[#FF2E93] group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all shrink-0" />
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="px-4 py-2 border-t border-white/10 text-[11px] text-[#B9A6D4]/60 font-mono flex justify-between">
          <span>Only verified pages and guides are indexed</span>
          <span>ESC to close</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Navbar } from './Navbar';
import { MobileBottomNav } from './MobileBottomNav';
import { Footer } from './Footer';
import { CookieConsent } from './CookieConsent';
import { GlobalSearchModal } from './GlobalSearchModal';
import { Analytics } from './Analytics';
import { ScrollToTop } from './ScrollToTop';

/**
 * Shared page chrome (navbar, footer, search, consent, analytics).
 * Used by both the client App (BrowserRouter) and the SSR entry
 * (StaticRouter) so prerendered HTML and hydration render identically.
 */
export function Layout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#0B0614] text-[#FFF5FB] bg-grain font-sans">
      {/* Skip link: first focusable element on every page; visible on focus. */}
      <a
        href="#main-content"
        className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:absolute focus:left-4 focus:top-4 focus:z-[100] focus:rounded-lg focus:bg-[#150A24] focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:font-semibold focus:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#19E3D0]"
      >
        Skip to content
      </a>
      <ScrollToTop />
      <Analytics />
      <Navbar onOpenSearch={() => setSearchOpen(true)} />

      <main id="main-content" className="flex-1 pb-16 md:pb-0">{children}</main>

      <Footer />
      <MobileBottomNav />
      <GlobalSearchModal isOpen={searchOpen} onClose={() => setSearchOpen(false)} />
      <CookieConsent />
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async';
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../config/site';

interface SEOProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  canonical?: string;
  type?: 'website' | 'article';
  schema?: Record<string, unknown> | Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  ogImage?: string;
  /** True = <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> (page stays out of search). */
  noindex?: boolean;
  /** Article dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Emitted as article:published_time / modified_time. */
  articlePublished?: string;
  articleModified?: string;
}

export function SEO({
  title,
  description = SITE_CONFIG.description,
  canonical,
  type = 'website',
  schema,
  // Default OG image is the rasterized banner (public/og-banner.png, produced
  // by `npm run og:export` from og-banner.svg). Per-hub PNGs exist for the
  // release/map/tools/news hubs; pass ogImage explicitly on those pages.
  ogImage = 'https://vicetools.app/og-banner.png',
  noindex = false,
  articlePublished,
  articleModified,
}: SEOProps) {
  const fullTitle = title
    ? `${title} | ${SITE_CONFIG.name}`
    : `${SITE_CONFIG.name} | ${SITE_CONFIG.tagline}`;

  const canonicalUrl = canonical
    ? (canonical.startsWith('http') ? canonical : `${SITE_CONFIG.url}${canonical}`)
    : SITE_CONFIG.url;

  // Every page gets JSON-LD: the page's own schema when provided, otherwise
  // a minimal WebPage schema so verify:html never sees a page without one.
  const jsonLd = schema ?? {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'WebPage',
    name: fullTitle,
    url: canonicalUrl,
  };

  return (
    <Helmet>
      <title>{fullTitle}</title>
      <meta name="description" content={description} />
      <link rel="canonical" href={canonicalUrl} />
      {noindex && <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow" />}

      {/* Open Graph */}
      <meta property="og:title" content={fullTitle} />
      <meta property="og:description" content={description} />
      <meta property="og:type" content={type} />
      <meta property="og:url" content={canonicalUrl} />
      <meta property="og:image" content={ogImage} />
      <meta property="og:site_name" content={SITE_CONFIG.name} />
      {type === 'article' && articlePublished && (
        <meta property="article:published_time" content={articlePublished} />
      )}
      {type === 'article' && articleModified && (
        <meta property="article:modified_time" content={articleModified} />
      )}

      {/* Twitter */}
      <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
      <meta name="twitter:title" content={fullTitle} />
      <meta name="twitter:description" content={description} />
      <meta name="twitter:image" content={ogImage} />

      {/* JSON-LD Schemas */}
      <script type="application/ld+json">
        {JSON.stringify(jsonLd)}
      </script>
    </Helmet>
  );
}

````

## src/config/site.ts

````ts
/**
 * VICE TOOLS - Site Configuration
 * Centralized settings for GTA 6 companion tools, launch date, and features.
 *
 * Every date/price/size below is a VERIFIED fact (see src/data/facts.json).
 * Do not change a value here without updating its source entry.
 */

export const SITE_CONFIG = {
  name: 'VICE TOOLS',
  tagline: 'The ultimate GTA 6 companion toolkit',
  description:
    'Unofficial fan-made GTA 6 companion toolkit featuring interactive map, money & loadout calculators, vehicle & weapon database, server status, and guides.',
  url: 'https://vicetools.app',

  // Launch: Thursday, November 19, 2026 (Rockstar Newswire, Nov 6, 2025).
  // Rockstar has said the game unlocks at LOCAL MIDNIGHT on Nov 19 in each
  // region (Rockstar Support pre-load guidance) — there is no single global
  // unlock instant. RELEASE_DATE is therefore the local-midnight wall time
  // in the visitor's own time zone, used by the countdown.
  RELEASE_DATE: '2026-11-19T00:00:00',

  // Verified reference instant: US store midnight ET, November 19, 2026.
  // Used for schema/OG dates and cross-timezone reference ONLY — the
  // unlock itself is local midnight everywhere, not this instant.
  REFERENCE_ISO: '2026-11-19T00:00:00-05:00',

  // Pre-load begins November 10, 2026 (Rockstar Newswire, Nov 3, 2026).
  PRELOAD_DATE: '2026-11-10',
  // Pre-load file: up to 212 GB depending on device (same source).
  PRELOAD_SIZE_GB: 212,

  // Advertising: OFF until AdSense is configured (see public/ads.txt).
  // When false, AdSlot renders nothing — no placeholder boxes, no space.
  ADS_ENABLED: false,

  // Analytics: empty = no-op. Set VITE_GA_ID in the environment to enable
  // GA4 (loaded only after the visitor accepts in the cookie banner).
  ANALYTICS_ID: '',

  // Social links: empty string = hidden in the UI. Add a URL only for an
  // account that actually exists — never a placeholder.
  socialLinks: {
    discord: '',
    twitter: '',
    reddit: '',
    youtube: '',
  },

  // Author / contact placeholders. Fill these in before launch — the UI
  // shows "VICE TOOLS team" while AUTHOR_NAME is empty. Never invent an
  // email address here.
  AUTHOR_NAME: '',
  AUTHOR_BIO: '',
  AUTHOR_URL: '',
  CONTACT_EMAIL: '',

  // Mandatory disclaimer
  disclaimer:
    "Vice Tools is an unofficial fan-made website. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. All game data marked 'Unconfirmed' may change.",
};

/** Display name for article bylines: config author, or the team fallback. */
export function getAuthorName(): string {
  return SITE_CONFIG.AUTHOR_NAME || 'VICE TOOLS team';
}

/**
 * Contact email from config, or '' when not set. The Contact page shows a
 * "not set yet" state instead of a fake address when this is empty.
 * Never invent an email address here.
 */
export function getContactEmail(): string {
  return SITE_CONFIG.CONTACT_EMAIL || '';
}
````

## src/data/README.md

````md
# VICE TOOLS — data files

How the site's data works, and how to add verified data after launch.

## Rules (enforced by `scripts/validate-data.mjs`, which runs first in `npm run build`)

- Every record with `status: "confirmed"` **must** have `source_url` and
  `last_verified` (YYYY-MM-DD). The build fails without them.
- Every record with `status: "reported"` **must** name its source in
  `source_name` (and link it in `source_url` when a URL exists).
- `status: "template"` entries are documentation only — pages filter them out.
  Never list a template entry as a real item.
- Never invent a name, stat, price, date, or quote. If Rockstar has not
  published it, the entry is `unconfirmed` or it does not exist yet.

## Files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `facts.json` | Sourced fact registry. One entry per verified fact (`id`, `claim`, `status`, `source_url`, `last_verified`). `src/lib/facts.ts` reads it. Copied to `dist/data/facts.json` at build time for LLMs. |
| `news.json` | Dated, sourced news posts. Add a post here and it appears on `/news`, in `/rss.xml`, and in the sitemap automatically. Fields: `slug`, `title`, `date`, `dateModified`, `excerpt`, `body` (paragraphs separated by blank lines), `source_url`, `last_verified`, `status`. |
| `regions.json` | The 40 release-time regions (`slug`, `location`, IANA `timezone`, `keyword`). Local times are computed at build time from the config reference timestamps — never hand-written here. |
| `editions.json` | Standard + Ultimate editions, verified facts only. Do **not** add individual Ultimate Edition items (e.g. the '95 Grotti Cheetah) as confirmed until verified on rockstargames.com/VI/editions. |
| `comparisons.json` | `/compare/*` pages. Verified facts only, `source_url` + `last_verified` per entry. |
| `faqs.json` | Home-page FAQs. Every entry needs `source_url` + `last_verified`. |
| `guides.json` | Long-form guides. Same slugs must be kept (routes depend on them). Each guide needs `source_url` + `last_verified`. Content is light markdown: `### ` headings (one per section, followed by paragraphs), blank-line-separated paragraphs, `- ` or `1. ` lists. No `**bold**` — the renderer does not parse it. Heading anchor ids are derived from the heading text, so keep `headings[].id` in sync with the `### ` text. Author is the site-wide config author (see `src/config/site.ts`), not a per-guide byline. |
| `vehicles.json`, `weapons.json`, `properties.json`, `locations.json` | Catalog data. Currently each file holds **only a template entry** — every invented entry was removed in Batch 1. Add an item only when it is verified in official Rockstar material, with `status: "confirmed"` + `source_url` + `last_verified`. Real (non-template) entries automatically appear in the database hubs, the detail pages (which become indexable), the calculators, and search. |
| `verified-map-regions.json` | The only named regions the interactive map ships (Vice City, Leonida). Positions are approximate points on the stylized reference map. |
| `status.json` | Pre-launch state. See the `_comment` inside the file for the post-launch interface (real services, real `checkedAt` timestamps, `lastChecked`). Never invent uptime, ping, or incidents. |

## News publishing workflow

1. Add a post to `news.json` with a unique `slug`, a `date` (publication date),
   `dateModified`, `excerpt`, `body`, and `source_url` + `last_verified`.
2. Run `npm run validate:data` — it fails if any sourced field is missing.
3. Run `npm run build` — the post is prerendered at `/news/<slug>`, added to
   `/rss.xml` and the sitemap, and linked from `/news` and the home page.
4. Do not back-date posts. If a fact in an old post changes, update `body`
   and `dateModified`, and say what changed in the post.

## Adding verified catalog data after launch

1. Add the item to the right file with `status: "confirmed"`, `source_url`,
   and `last_verified` (plus all schema fields — see the template entry's
   `_comment` in each file).
2. Run `npm run validate:data` and `npm run build`.
3. The item appears in its hub, gets a prerendered detail page (indexable),
   and becomes searchable. Remove the template entry once the first real
   item exists.

````

## src/data/guides.json

````json
[
  {
    "category": "Install and Preload",
    "content": "### The Release Date\n\nGrand Theft Auto VI launches on Thursday, November 19, 2026. That date is confirmed by Rockstar Games itself, in a Newswire post dated November 6, 2025, titled “Grand Theft Auto VI is now set to launch November 19, 2026.” It is the third date the game has carried: it was first announced for Fall 2025, then delayed to May 26, 2026, and then delayed again to November 19, 2026. The November date is the current one, and there has been no further change since the November 6, 2025 announcement.\n\nThe game unlocks at local midnight on November 19, 2026. That means 12:00 AM in your own time zone, on the day itself — not a single global moment. The US PlayStation Store lists the unlock as 12:00 AM ET on November 19, which is 9:00 PM PT on November 18 for players on the US West Coast. No Xbox unlock time has been published, so do not assume it matches PlayStation. Rockstar has not published an hour-by-hour global unlock map, and this site does not invent one: the release-time hub lists all 40 regions with their local midnight unlock, and says plainly where the Xbox time is unknown.\n\n### When Exactly Does It Unlock?\n\nThe unlock rule is simple, and it is the same rule Rockstar has used before: finished pre-loads unlock server-side at local midnight. On PlayStation 5, that is midnight in your console’s time zone. On Xbox Series X|S, Rockstar has not published a time, and the store listing does not give one — so the honest answer for Xbox players is that the unlock is expected at local midnight, but it has not been confirmed. If you are planning a launch-night session, the safe plan is to have the pre-load finished by the evening of November 18 and to check the game at midnight. Do not trust a countdown site that gives you a single global unlock time: there is no such time, and any site that claims one is guessing.\n\nThe launch trailer, published on October 15, 2026, is the most recent official video, and it is ninety seconds of footage captured in-game on PlayStation 5. It does not change the date. Nothing since the November 6, 2025 Newswire post has moved the launch, and the pre-load announcement of November 3, 2026 confirmed the same date again by scheduling pre-load for November 10. If a new delay were announced, this guide would be updated the same day, with the source. As of November 5, 2026, there is no sign of one.\n\n### The Road to November 19\n\nThe date has moved twice, and the history matters because it explains why some older articles give different dates. The game was first announced for Fall 2025. On May 2, 2025, Rockstar delayed it to May 26, 2026, saying: “We are very sorry that this is later than you expected... We hope you understand that we need this extra time to deliver at the level of quality you expect and deserve.” On November 6, 2025, it was delayed again, to November 19, 2026, with similar wording: “We are sorry that this is later than you expected... We need this extra time to deliver at the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve.” Two delays, two apologies, and the same reason both times: more time for quality and polish. There is no third delay announced, and this guide does not speculate about one.\n\n### Platforms: What Is Confirmed\n\nGTA 6 launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. That is confirmed on the official GTA VI page and in every Rockstar announcement since the delay notices. There is no PlayStation 4 version and no Xbox One version — the game is built for current-generation hardware only, and it will not run on last-generation consoles. There is no Nintendo Switch version announced, and no PC version announced. The “no PC version” point deserves its own sentence, because it is the most-asked question about the game: as of November 5, 2026, Rockstar has not announced a PC version, a PC date, a Steam or Epic Games Store page, or any PC system requirements. A report in October 2026 suggested a Q1 2027 PC release, but Rockstar has not commented on it and the report is unconfirmed. Do not plan around it.\n\nThe game is a single-player campaign at launch. No online mode has been announced. That does not mean there will never be one — GTA Online followed GTA V, and Red Dead Online followed Red Dead Redemption 2 — but nothing has been announced for GTA 6, and this guide does not assume an online mode exists. If you are buying the game for online play, you are buying on a hope, not a promise.\n\n### What To Do Before Launch\n\nThree things, in order. First, pre-order if you want the bonuses: pre-orders opened June 25, 2026, and buying before November 20, 2026 — pre-order or not — gets you the Vintage Vice City Pack. A digital pre-order also includes one month of GTA+. The Standard Edition is $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition is $99.99 in the US; the Ultimate Edition is digital-only, and the boxed Standard Edition contains a download code, not a disc. Second, pre-load: pre-load begins November 10, 2026 — midnight local time on PS5, 12:00 AM GMT globally on Xbox — and the file is up to 212 GB. Clear at least 212 GB before November 10, and start the download as soon as it is available, because a 212 GB file takes hours on most connections. Third, check your region’s exact times on the release-time hub, which lists all 40 regions with their local pre-load and unlock times. Do all three before November 10, and launch night is just a matter of waiting for midnight.",

    "content": "### The File Size: Up to 212 GB\n\nThe GTA 6 pre-load file is up to 212 GB, depending on device. That figure comes from Rockstar’s Newswire post of November 3, 2026, “Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10,” and from the PlayStation Blog, which tells PlayStation 5 owners to clear a minimum of 212 GB before pre-loading. It is the confirmed size, and it replaces every earlier estimate: the figures that circulated for months were guesses, and an October 2026 store-tracker report of 210 GB was superseded by Rockstar’s own announcement. The “up to” matters — the file may be smaller on one platform than the other, and it may change with a day-one patch — but 212 GB is the number to plan around, and it is the number PlayStation itself gives.\n\nTwo hundred and twelve gigabytes is large by any standard. For comparison, it is roughly four times the size of a typical large game, and it is large enough that the storage on a base PlayStation 5 (667 GB usable) or a base Xbox Series X (802 GB usable) will feel it. If your console is full of other games, you will need to delete something. If your internet is slow, you will need to start early. Both of those are planning problems, not launch-night problems, and this guide exists to move them to November 10, when you have nine days to solve them.\n\n### How Much Space Do You Really Need?\n\nClear a minimum of 212 GB — that is PlayStation’s own instruction, and it is the right target on Xbox too. In practice, clear more if you can: the game may download a day-one patch on top of the pre-load, and consoles need free space to install and update. A safe target is 230–250 GB free before November 10. To check on PlayStation 5, go to Settings, then Storage, and look at the available space on the console storage. To check on Xbox Series X|S, go to Settings, then System, then Storage devices, and look at the available space on the internal drive. If you are short, delete games you have finished, move games you are not playing to an external drive (PlayStation 5 games cannot run from an external USB drive, but they can be stored there and moved back; Xbox Series X|S games can be stored on an external drive and moved back too), or delete captured video, which accumulates faster than most players realise.\n\n### How to Pre-Load on PlayStation 5\n\nPre-load on PlayStation 5 begins at midnight local time on November 10, 2026. If you have pre-ordered the digital edition, the download should start automatically if your console is set to download in rest mode — check Settings, then System, then Power Saving, then Features Available in Rest Mode, and make sure “Stay Connected to the Internet” is on. If it does not start automatically, go to your Game Library, find Grand Theft Auto VI, and start the download manually. The download is the full game, up to 212 GB, and it will sit encrypted on your console until it unlocks at local midnight on November 19. You cannot play it early, and you cannot peek at it: pre-loaded games are locked until the unlock time. If you bought the boxed Standard Edition, you do not pre-load — the boxes reach shops from November 12, 2026, and the box contains a download code, not a disc, so you will download the same 212 GB file after you redeem the code.\n\n### How to Pre-Load on Xbox Series X|S\n\nPre-load on Xbox Series X|S begins at 12:00 AM GMT on November 10, 2026 — one global instant, not midnight local time. That is November 9 at 7:00 PM ET and 4:00 PM PT for players in the United States, and November 10 at 1:00 AM CET for players in Central Europe. The release-time hub lists the local pre-load time for all 40 regions, so check your own rather than converting in your head. If you have pre-ordered digitally, the download should start automatically if your console is set to download updates in standby — check Settings, then General, then Power mode, and make sure the console is set to download in standby. If it does not start, go to My games & apps, find Grand Theft Auto VI, and start it manually. As on PlayStation, the file is locked until the unlock: Rockstar has not published an Xbox unlock time, so the unlock is expected at local midnight on November 19 but has not been confirmed for Xbox specifically.\n\n### What If Your Connection Is Slow?\n\nA 212 GB download is a real commitment on a slow connection. At 100 Mbps, it takes about five hours. At 50 Mbps, about ten hours. At 25 Mbps, about nineteen hours. At 10 Mbps, about two days. Those are ideal figures — real speeds are lower, and a download that pauses, throttles, or restarts takes longer. The fix is time: pre-load opens on November 10 and the game unlocks on November 19, so you have nine days. Start the download on November 10, leave the console in rest mode or standby overnight, and do not wait until November 18. If your connection is very slow, consider downloading at a friend’s house or a place with faster internet, if your console and account allow it — but do not use a public Wi-Fi network for a 212 GB download, and do not pay a third party to download the game for you. If you cannot pre-load at all, you can still download on launch day, but you will be downloading with everyone else, and the store servers will be under their heaviest load of the year.\n\n### After Pre-Load: The Unlock\n\nOnce the pre-load finishes, there is nothing to do but wait. The game unlocks server-side at local midnight on November 19, 2026 — 12:00 AM in your own time zone on PlayStation, and expected at local midnight on Xbox, though not confirmed for Xbox. The unlock is server-side, which means you cannot play early by changing your console’s clock or your region: the game checks with Rockstar’s servers, not with your console. If you pre-loaded, the unlock should be automatic — the game becomes playable at midnight without another download, unless a day-one patch is released, in which case a smaller download may be needed first. Rockstar has not announced a day-one patch, its size, or its contents, and this guide does not guess at them. Check the status page on launch night for the official status of PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, and Rockstar Support, and for the honest pre-launch notice that the servers are not live yet.",

    "category": "Settings",
    "content": "### The Short Answer: No PC Version Announced\n\nThere is no PC version of GTA 6 announced. Not a date, not a window, not a Steam page, not an Epic Games Store page, not a system requirements list. Rockstar has said nothing about a PC version in any Newswire post, on the official GTA VI page, or in any store listing. The game launches on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. That is the whole official position, and it has not changed since the game was announced. Everything else in this guide is context — history, one unconfirmed report, and honest advice — and it is labelled as such.\n\n### What Rockstar Has Actually Said\n\nRockstar has said nothing about a PC version of GTA 6. That silence is not an oversight and it is not a hint: it is the company’s normal position before a PC announcement, and it is the same silence that surrounded the PC versions of its previous games before they were announced. What Rockstar has said, repeatedly, is that GTA 6 launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026. Every official statement lists those two platforms and no others. If you read a headline that says “Rockstar confirms GTA 6 PC” or “GTA 6 PC release date revealed,” check the source: if it is not rockstargames.com, the Rockstar Newswire, or a Rockstar statement quoted by a named outlet, it is not a confirmation. As of November 5, 2026, no such confirmation exists.\n\n### The Q1 2027 Report\n\nOne report deserves a careful paragraph, because it is the only PC claim with any sourcing behind it. On October 13, 2026, GamesBeat reported — by Alexander Lee, citing four anonymous sources — that a PC version of GTA 6 was planned for the first quarter of 2027. Rockstar has not commented on the report, and no other outlet has independently confirmed it. That makes it a report, not a fact: it comes from a named outlet and a named reporter, but its sources are anonymous and its subject has not confirmed it. This site labels it as reported, names the outlet and the date, and does not link directly to the article because the direct URL was not verified in our research. Do not plan around Q1 2027. Do not pre-order a PC version that does not exist. Do not pay anyone who claims to sell PC access. If Rockstar announces a PC version, this guide will be updated the same day with the official source.\n\n### Why Rockstar Releases PC Later\n\nRockstar has a consistent history: its games come to console first and to PC later. Grand Theft Auto V launched on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in September 2013, came to PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in November 2014, and reached PC in April 2015 — about nineteen months after the original launch. Red Dead Redemption 2 launched on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in October 2018 and reached PC in November 2019 — about thirteen months later. That pattern is the reason most people expect a GTA 6 PC version eventually, and it is a reasonable expectation: Rockstar has never kept a mainline Grand Theft Auto game off PC permanently, and the PC versions of GTA V and RDR2 were substantial, well-supported releases. But a pattern is not a promise. The gap has varied — nineteen months for GTA V, thirteen for RDR2 — and there is no announced gap for GTA 6 at all. History suggests a PC version will come; it does not say when, and anyone who gives you a date is guessing.\n\n### What a PC Version Would Need\n\nNo PC system requirements have been announced for GTA 6, because no PC version has been announced. Any “GTA 6 PC requirements” list you find online is invented — usually by copying the requirements of another game or by extrapolating from the console hardware — and this site does not reproduce one. When Rockstar does announce a PC version, the requirements will come from Rockstar, and they will be published here with the source. Until then, the only honest guidance is general: the game’s pre-load file is up to 212 GB on console, so a PC version would need at least that much storage, and it is built for current-generation console hardware, so it will demand a modern PC. Those are inferences, not requirements, and they are labelled as such. Do not buy hardware for a PC version that has not been announced.\n\n### What To Do If You Only Have a PC\n\nIf you only have a PC, the honest answer is that there is no legitimate way to play GTA 6 on November 19, 2026. The game launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. Your options are to wait for a PC announcement, to play on a console if you have access to one, or to watch the launch from the sidelines — the four official trailers, the launch coverage, and the community reaction. What you should not do is pay for “PC early access,” download a “GTA 6 PC version” from any site, or enter your account details into a page promising a free PC copy. There is no free GTA 6 download on any platform, and every offer of one is a scam. The legitimate PC route, when it exists, will be a Steam page, an Epic Games Store page, or the Rockstar Games Launcher — announced by Rockstar, on rockstargames.com, with a date. Until that announcement, the PC question has one answer: not announced.",
````

## src/entry-server.tsx

````tsx
import type { ComponentType } from 'react';
import { renderToString } from 'react-dom/server';
import { StaticRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HelmetProvider } from 'react-helmet-async';
import type { HelmetServerState } from 'react-helmet-async';
import { Layout } from './components/Layout';
import { AppRoutes } from './AppRoutes';
import type { ResolvedRoute } from './AppRoutes';
import { getRoutes, getAppRoutes, getIndexableRoutes, NOT_FOUND_LOAD } from './lib/routes';

export interface RenderResult {
  html: string;
  /**
   * Helmet server state. NOTE: react-helmet-async v3 is a deliberate no-op
   * on React 19 — its provider never populates this (it relies on React
   * 19 hoisting title/meta/link on the client). During renderToString the
   * Helmet tags render inline in `html` instead; scripts/prerender.mjs
   * relocates them into <head>. This field is kept for forward
   * compatibility and is normally undefined in this project.
   */
  helmet: HelmetServerState | undefined;
}

let cachedRoutes: ResolvedRoute[] | null = null;
let cachedNotFound: ComponentType | null = null;

async function resolveRoutes(): Promise<{ routes: ResolvedRoute[]; NotFound: ComponentType }> {
  if (!cachedRoutes || !cachedNotFound) {
    const appRoutes = getAppRoutes();
    cachedRoutes = await Promise.all(
      appRoutes.map(async (r) => ({ path: r.path, Component: await r.load() })),
    );
    cachedNotFound = await NOT_FOUND_LOAD();
  }
  return { routes: cachedRoutes, NotFound: cachedNotFound };
}

function renderApp(location: string, routes: ResolvedRoute[], NotFound: ComponentType): RenderResult {
  const helmetContext: { helmet?: HelmetServerState } = {};
  const html = renderToString(
    <HelmetProvider context={helmetContext}>
      <StaticRouter location={location}>
        <Layout>
          <AppRoutes routes={routes} NotFound={NotFound} />
        </Layout>
      </StaticRouter>
    </HelmetProvider>,
  );
  return { html, helmet: helmetContext.helmet };
}

/** Render one route to static HTML + its Helmet head state. */
export async function renderRoute(url: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
  const { routes, NotFound } = await resolveRoutes();
  return renderApp(url, routes, NotFound);
}

/** Render the 404 page (location /404 matches the catch-all route). */
export async function render404(): Promise<RenderResult> {
  const { routes, NotFound } = await resolveRoutes();
  return renderApp('/404', routes, NotFound);
}

// Re-exported for the build scripts (sitemap, link checker).
export { getRoutes, getIndexableRoutes };

````

## src/lib/analytics.ts

````ts
/**
 * Minimal GA4 + Consent Mode v2 helper.
 *
 * - No-op when VITE_GA_ID is not set (the default).
 * - Consent defaults are DENIED until the visitor accepts in the cookie
 *   banner. Accepting grants analytics_storage only and then loads the
 *   GA4 script; declining leaves everything denied.
 * - Safe to call on the server: every function guards for `window`.
 */

const GA_ID = (import.meta.env.VITE_GA_ID as string | undefined) || '';

declare global {
  interface Window {
    dataLayer?: unknown[];
    gtag?: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
  }
}

let gtagLoaded = false;
let consentGranted = false;

function pushGtag(...args: unknown[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') {
    window.gtag(...args);
  } else {
    window.dataLayer.push(args);
  }
}

/** Install the gtag stub and set Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied. */
export function initAnalytics(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !GA_ID) return;
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  if (typeof window.gtag !== 'function') {
    window.gtag = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      window.dataLayer?.push(args);
    };
  }
  pushGtag('consent', 'default', {
    ad_storage: 'denied',
    analytics_storage: 'denied',
    functionality_storage: 'denied',
    personalization_storage: 'denied',
    security_storage: 'granted',
  });
  pushGtag('js', new Date());
  pushGtag('config', GA_ID, { anonymize_ip: true });
}

/** Visitor accepted: grant analytics storage and load the GA4 script. */
export function grantAnalyticsConsent(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !GA_ID) return;
  consentGranted = true;
  pushGtag('consent', 'update', { analytics_storage: 'granted' });
  if (!gtagLoaded) {
    gtagLoaded = true;
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.async = true;
    script.src = `https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${GA_ID}`;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }
}

/** Visitor declined: keep all consent denied (the default). */
export function denyAnalyticsConsent(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !GA_ID) return;
  consentGranted = false;
  pushGtag('consent', 'update', { analytics_storage: 'denied' });
}

export function hasAnalyticsConsent(): boolean {
  return consentGranted;
}

/** Pageview, sent only after consent was granted. */
export function trackPageview(path: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !GA_ID || !consentGranted) return;
  pushGtag('event', 'page_view', { page_path: path });
}
````

````ts
import factsData from '../data/facts.json';

export type FactStatus = 'confirmed' | 'reported' | 'unconfirmed' | 'template';

export interface Fact {
  id: string;
  claim: string;
  status: FactStatus;
  source_url: string;
  source_name: string;
  last_verified: string;
}

const FACTS: Fact[] = (factsData as { facts: Fact[] }).facts;

export function getFacts(): Fact[] {
  return FACTS;
}

export function getFact(id: string): Fact | undefined {
  return FACTS.find((f) => f.id === id);
}

/** Returns 'confirmed' | 'reported' for a known fact id, or 'unknown'. */
export function factStatus(id: string): FactStatus | 'unknown' {
  const fact = getFact(id);
  return fact ? fact.status : 'unknown';
}

/** Confirmed facts only, for pages that must cite a source per claim. */
export function getConfirmedFacts(): Fact[] {
  return FACTS.filter((f) => f.status === 'confirmed');
}
````

````ts
import contentData from '../data/region-content.json';

/**
 * Per-region editorial content for the 40 release-time pages.
 * Every field is hand-written, region-specific prose — never a template
 * with a swapped city name. No `status` fields here (validate:data only
 * checks objects that claim a status), and no invented local prices,
 * retailer names, or release events: prices are US-confirmed only, and
 * local availability always points at the official PlayStation/Xbox stores.
 */
export interface RegionFaq {
  question: string;
  answer: string;
}

export interface RegionContent {
  slug: string;
  /** Short name used in the <title> only (keeps it under 60 chars). */
  titleName?: string;
  /** 3 intro paragraphs: timezone + unlock, pre-load in local terms, rollout position. */
  intro: string[];
  /** Launch-day paragraph: what Thursday, November 19 looks like locally. */
  launchDay: string;
  /** Pre-load note: 212 GB, clearing space, PS5 vs Xbox local times. */
  preloadNote: string;
  /** Editions note: US prices confirmed, local store check, no disc. */
  editionsNote: string;
  /** 5–6 questions; at least 2 answers are region-specific. */
  faq: RegionFaq[];
}

export const REGION_CONTENT: RegionContent[] = (
  contentData as { regions: RegionContent[] }
).regions;

export function getRegionContent(slug: string): RegionContent | undefined {
  return REGION_CONTENT.find((c) => c.slug === slug);
}
````

## src/lib/regions.ts

````ts
import regionsData from '../data/regions.json';
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../config/site';

export interface RegionInfo {
  slug: string;
  location: string;
  timezone: string;
  keyword: string;
}

export const REGIONS: RegionInfo[] = (regionsData as { regions: RegionInfo[] }).regions;

export function getRegion(slug: string): RegionInfo | undefined {
  return REGIONS.find((r) => r.slug === slug);
}

export interface RegionTimes {
  /** "November 10, 2026, 12:00 AM PKT" — PS5 pre-load, local wall time. */
  ps5Preload: string;
  /** Xbox pre-load instant (Nov 10, 00:00 GMT) formatted in the region's time. */
  xboxPreload: string;
  /** "November 19, 2026, 12:00 AM PKT" — unlock, local wall time. */
  unlock: string;
  /** The Xbox pre-load instant in UTC, for reference. */
  xboxPreloadUtc: string;
  /** Short time-zone name for the region on the unlock date (e.g. PKT, EST). */
  tzAbbrev: string;
}

const XBOX_PRELOAD_UTC = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 10, 0, 0, 0); // Nov 10, 2026 00:00 GMT

/**
 * Curated time-zone abbreviations for the 40 region zones, valid for the
 * November 10 / November 19, 2026 dates this site computes (Batch 5 fix).
 *
 * Node's ICU `timeZoneName: 'short'` returns generic offsets ("GMT+5",
 * "GMT+13") for most zones, which reads wrong on a release-time table.
 * This map is keyed by IANA zone and holds the abbreviation in force on
 * those dates: Europe and North America are on standard time in November
 * (CET / GMT / WET / EST / CST / MST / PST), Sydney and Auckland are on
 * daylight time (AEDT / NZDT). Values are labels only — every instant is
 * still computed from the verified references with Intl, never hand-typed.
 * Unknown zones fall back to the ICU short name (never to a blank string).
 */
const TZ_ABBREV: Record<string, string> = {
  'Asia/Karachi': 'PKT',
  'Asia/Kolkata': 'IST',
  'Asia/Dubai': 'GST',
  'Asia/Riyadh': 'AST',
  'Europe/London': 'GMT',
  'Europe/Dublin': 'GMT',
  'Europe/Berlin': 'CET',
  'Europe/Paris': 'CET',
  'Europe/Madrid': 'CET',
  'Europe/Rome': 'CET',
  'Europe/Amsterdam': 'CET',
  'Europe/Warsaw': 'CET',
  'Europe/Stockholm': 'CET',
  'Europe/Lisbon': 'WET',
  'Europe/Istanbul': 'TRT',
  'Africa/Cairo': 'EET',
  'Africa/Lagos': 'WAT',
  'Africa/Johannesburg': 'SAST',
  'Asia/Jerusalem': 'IST',
  'Asia/Tokyo': 'JST',
  'Asia/Seoul': 'KST',
  'Asia/Shanghai': 'CST',
  'Asia/Singapore': 'SGT',
  'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur': 'MYT',
  'Asia/Jakarta': 'WIB',
  'Asia/Bangkok': 'ICT',
  'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh': 'ICT',
  'Asia/Manila': 'PHT',
  'Australia/Sydney': 'AEDT',
  'Australia/Perth': 'AWST',
  'Pacific/Auckland': 'NZDT',
  'America/New_York': 'EST',
  'America/Chicago': 'CST',
  'America/Denver': 'MST',
  'America/Los_Angeles': 'PST',
  'America/Toronto': 'EST',
  'America/Vancouver': 'PST',
  'America/Sao_Paulo': 'BRT',
  'America/Mexico_City': 'CST',
  'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires': 'ART',
};

function tzAbbrev(timezone: string, utcDate: Date): string {
  if (TZ_ABBREV[timezone]) return TZ_ABBREV[timezone];
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    timeZoneName: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric',
  }).formatToParts(utcDate);
  return parts.find((p) => p.type === 'timeZoneName')?.value ?? '';
}

function formatInZone(utcDate: Date, timezone: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: timezone,
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric',
    hour: 'numeric',
    minute: '2-digit',
  }).format(utcDate);
}

/**
 * Computes a region's pre-load and unlock times from the verified reference
 * timestamps in the site config. Unlock is local midnight, Nov 19, 2026, in
 * every region (Rockstar Support) — there is no single global unlock instant,
 * so the unlock and PS5 pre-load are wall-clock times in the region's zone.
 * The Xbox pre-load IS one global instant (Nov 10, 00:00 GMT), converted
 * here into the region's local time.
 */
export function computeRegionTimes(timezone: string): RegionTimes {
  const abbrev = tzAbbrev(timezone, new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 19, 12, 0, 0)));
  return {
    ps5Preload: `November 10, 2026, 12:00 AM ${abbrev}`,
    // The Xbox pre-load is one global instant (Nov 10, 00:00 GMT); the
    // formatted local time now carries the region's abbreviation too
    // (Batch 5 fix — previously the cell had no abbreviation at all).
    xboxPreload: `${formatInZone(new Date(XBOX_PRELOAD_UTC), timezone)} ${abbrev}`,
    unlock: `November 19, 2026, 12:00 AM ${abbrev}`,
    xboxPreloadUtc: 'November 10, 2026, 12:00 AM GMT',
    tzAbbrev: abbrev,
  };
}

/** The verified reference timestamps, for pages that state them in prose. */
export const RELEASE_REFERENCES = {
  /** Local-midnight wall time used by the countdown (visitor's own zone). */
  releaseDateLocal: SITE_CONFIG.RELEASE_DATE,
  /** US store midnight ET, Nov 19, 2026 — a reference instant, not the unlock. */
  referenceIso: SITE_CONFIG.REFERENCE_ISO,
  preloadDate: SITE_CONFIG.PRELOAD_DATE,
  preloadSizeGb: SITE_CONFIG.PRELOAD_SIZE_GB,
};

````

````ts
  { path: '/gta-6-leaks-vs-confirmed', title: 'GTA 6 Leaks vs Confirmed', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/world/LeaksVsConfirmedPage')).LeaksVsConfirmedPage },
  { path: '/gta-6-faq', title: 'GTA 6 FAQ', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/faq/FaqHubPage')).FaqHubPage },
  { path: '/about/methodology', title: 'Methodology & Editorial Policy', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/about/MethodologyPage')).MethodologyPage },
  { path: '/about', title: 'About', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/utility/AboutPage')).AboutPage },
  { path: '/contact', title: 'Contact', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/utility/ContactPage')).ContactPage },
  { path: '/privacy', title: 'Privacy Policy', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/utility/PrivacyPage')).PrivacyPage },
  { path: '/terms', title: 'Terms of Service', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/utility/TermsPage')).TermsPage },
  { path: '/disclaimer', title: 'Disclaimer', indexable: true, lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED, load: async () => (await import('../pages/utility/DisclaimerPage')).DisclaimerPage },
];

/**
 * Dynamic routes, generated from data files. Database detail pages are NOT
 * generated here: with no verified entries there is nothing to prerender.
 * Once a verified entry is added to a catalog file, add its route here
 * (or generate it from the data) and it becomes a prerendered, indexable
 * page automatically.
 */
function dynamicRoutes(): RouteInfo[] {
  const routes: RouteInfo[] = [];

  for (const guide of guidesData) {
    routes.push({
      path: `/guides/${guide.slug}`,
      title: guide.title,
      indexable: true,
      lastmod: guide.lastUpdated,
      load: async () => (await import('../pages/guides/GuideDetail')).GuideDetail,
    });
  }

  for (const post of newsData.posts) {
    routes.push({
      path: `/news/${post.slug}`,
      title: post.title,
      indexable: true,
      lastmod: post.dateModified || post.date,
      load: async () => (await import('../pages/news/NewsPostPage')).NewsPostPage,
    });
  }

  for (const comparison of comparisonsData.comparisons) {
    routes.push({
      path: `/compare/${comparison.slug}`,
      title: comparison.seoTitle,
      indexable: true,
      lastmod: comparison.last_verified,
      load: async () => (await import('../pages/compare/ComparePage')).ComparePage,
    });
  }

  // Region pages: Batch 4 gave each of the 40 regions >=350 unique words
  // of real content (src/data/region-content.json, gated by verify:regions),
  // so they are indexable now and enter the sitemap.
  for (const region of REGIONS) {
    routes.push({
      path: `/gta-6-release-time/${region.slug}`,
      title: `GTA 6 Release Time in ${region.location}`,
      indexable: true,
      lastmod: LAST_REVIEWED,
      load: async () => (await import('../pages/release/ReleaseTimeRegionPage')).ReleaseTimeRegionPage,
    });
  }

  return routes;
}

/** Every concrete URL that gets a prerendered HTML file. */
export function getRoutes(): RouteInfo[] {
  return [...STATIC_ROUTES, ...dynamicRoutes()];
}

/** Prerendered routes that may appear in the sitemap. */
export function getIndexableRoutes(): RouteInfo[] {
  return getRoutes().filter((r) => r.indexable);
}

/**
 * Route patterns for the client router and the SSR renderer.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: dynamic pages are registered ONLY as :slug patterns, never as
 * concrete paths. A concrete route (e.g. /news/some-slug) carries no params,
 * so useParams() inside the detail component would return {} and the page
 * would render its "not found" state. The pattern route matches the same
 * URL and supplies the slug. getRoutes() (above) is the concrete URL list
 * used by the prerender script and the sitemap — the two lists serve
 * different purposes and must not be merged.
 */
export function getAppRoutes(): AppRoute[] {
  return [
    ...STATIC_ROUTES.map((r) => ({ path: r.path, load: r.load })),
    // Patterns for detail pages: the components render their own honest
    // "not found / coming at launch" state for unknown slugs instead of the 404 page.
    { path: '/guides/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/guides/GuideDetail')).GuideDetail },
    { path: '/news/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/news/NewsPostPage')).NewsPostPage },
    { path: '/compare/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/compare/ComparePage')).ComparePage },
    { path: '/gta-6-release-time/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/release/ReleaseTimeRegionPage')).ReleaseTimeRegionPage },
    { path: '/database/vehicles/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/database/VehicleDetail')).VehicleDetail },
    { path: '/database/weapons/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/database/WeaponDetail')).WeaponDetail },
    { path: '/database/properties/:slug', load: async () => (await import('../pages/database/PropertyDetail')).PropertyDetail },
  ];
}

/** Loader for the catch-all 404 page (used by the router and dist/404.html). */
export const NOT_FOUND_LOAD: PageLoader = async () => (await import('../pages/utility/NotFoundPage')).NotFoundPage;

const SEGMENT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  map: 'Interactive Map',
  calculators: 'Calculators',
  money: 'Money Calculator',
  loadout: 'Loadout Builder',
  compare: 'Vehicle Comparison',
  database: 'Database',
  vehicles: 'Vehicles',
  weapons: 'Weapons',
  properties: 'Properties',
  status: 'Server Status',
  guides: 'Guides',
  news: 'News',
  'gta-6-release-time': 'GTA 6 Release Time',
  'gta-6-release-date': 'GTA 6 Release Date',
  'gta-6-countdown': 'GTA 6 Countdown',
  'gta-6-preload': 'GTA 6 Pre-Load',
  'gta-6-file-size': 'GTA 6 File Size',
  'gta-6-platforms': 'GTA 6 Platforms',
  'gta-6-pc-release-date': 'GTA 6 PC Release Date',
  'gta-6-delay-history': 'GTA 6 Delay History',
  'gta-6-why-no-pc': 'Why GTA 6 Is Not on PC',
  'gta-6-physical-disc': 'GTA 6 Physical Disc',
  'gta-6-pre-order': 'GTA 6 Pre-Order',
  'gta-6-editions': 'GTA 6 Editions',
  'gta-6-price': 'GTA 6 Price',
  'gta-6-download': 'GTA 6 Download',
  'gta-6-pre-orders-sold': 'GTA 6 Pre-Orders Sold',
  'gta-6-map': 'GTA 6 Map',
  'gta-6-vice-city-leonida': 'Vice City & Leonida',
  'gta-6-characters-jason-lucia': 'Jason & Lucia',
  'gta-6-story-and-length': 'How Long to Beat GTA 6',
  'gta-6-trailers': 'GTA 6 Trailers',
  'gta-6-development-cost': 'How Much Did GTA 6 Cost to Make',
  'gta-6-leaks-vs-confirmed': 'Leaks vs Confirmed',
  'gta-6-faq': 'GTA 6 FAQ',
  about: 'About',
  methodology: 'Methodology & Editorial Policy',
  contact: 'Contact',
  privacy: 'Privacy Policy',
  terms: 'Terms of Service',
  disclaimer: 'Disclaimer',
};

function titleCase(slug: string): string {
  return slug
    .split('-')
    .map((w) => (w ? w[0].toUpperCase() + w.slice(1) : w))
    .join(' ');
}

function labelForSegment(segment: string, fullPath: string): string {
  if (SEGMENT_LABELS[segment]) return SEGMENT_LABELS[segment];
  const guide = guidesData.find((g) => `/guides/${g.slug}` === fullPath);
  if (guide) return guide.title;
  const post = newsData.posts.find((p) => `/news/${p.slug}` === fullPath);
  if (post) return post.title;
  const comparison = comparisonsData.comparisons.find(
    (c) => `/compare/${c.slug}` === fullPath,
  );
  if (comparison) return comparison.h1;
  const region = REGIONS.find((r) => `/gta-6-release-time/${r.slug}` === fullPath);
  if (region) return region.location;
  return titleCase(segment);
}

/** Breadcrumb trail for a pathname: Home + one item per path segment. */
export function getBreadcrumbItems(pathname: string): { name: string; path: string }[] {
  const items = [{ name: 'Home', path: '/' }];
  const segments = pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  let cumulative = '';
  for (const segment of segments) {
    cumulative += `/${segment}`;
    items.push({ name: labelForSegment(segment, cumulative), path: cumulative });
  }
  return items;
}

````

## src/lib/schema.ts

````ts
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../config/site';

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  name: string;
  url: string;
}

export function websiteSchema(): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'WebSite',
    name: SITE_CONFIG.name,
    url: SITE_CONFIG.url,
    description: SITE_CONFIG.description,
  };
}

export function breadcrumbSchema(items: BreadcrumbItem[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
    itemListElement: items.map((item, i) => ({
      '@type': 'ListItem',
      position: i + 1,
      name: item.name,
      item: item.url,
    })),
  };
}

export interface ArticleSchemaInput {
  headline: string;
  description: string;
  datePublished: string;
  dateModified: string;
  authorName: string;
  url: string;
}

export function articleSchema(input: ArticleSchemaInput): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Article',
    headline: input.headline,
    description: input.description,
    datePublished: input.datePublished,
    dateModified: input.dateModified,
    author: {
      '@type': 'Organization',
      name: input.authorName,
      url: SITE_CONFIG.url,
    },
    publisher: {
      '@type': 'Organization',
      name: SITE_CONFIG.name,
      url: SITE_CONFIG.url,
      logo: {
        '@type': 'ImageObject',
        url: `${SITE_CONFIG.url}/favicon.svg`,
      },
    },
    mainEntityOfPage: {
      '@type': 'WebPage',
      '@id': input.url,
    },
  };
}

export function softwareApplicationSchema(input: {
  name: string;
  description: string;
}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'SoftwareApplication',
    name: input.name,
    applicationCategory: 'GameApplication',
    operatingSystem: 'All',
    offers: {
      '@type': 'Offer',
      price: '0',
      priceCurrency: 'USD',
    },
    description: input.description,
  };
}

export interface ItemListEntry {
  name: string;
  /** Site-relative path, e.g. '/map' — the helper makes it absolute. */
  path: string;
}

/**
 * VideoObject for official Rockstar videos (trailers page only).
 * Use ONLY when every field is real and sourced: the YouTube video must
 * exist on the official Rockstar Games channel, uploadDate must be the
 * real publish date, and duration must be the real runtime. If any field
 * cannot be verified, omit the VideoObject for that video entirely —
 * never guess a date, a duration, or a video ID.
 */
export interface VideoSchemaInput {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  /** YouTube video ID on the official Rockstar Games channel. */
  youtubeId: string;
  /** Real publish date, YYYY-MM-DD. */
  uploadDate: string;
  /** Real runtime, ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'PT1M30S', 'PT26M48S'. */
  duration: string;
}

export function videoSchema(input: VideoSchemaInput): Record<string, unknown> {
  const watchUrl = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${input.youtubeId}`;
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'VideoObject',
    name: input.name,
    description: input.description,
    thumbnailUrl: `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${input.youtubeId}/hqdefault.jpg`,
    uploadDate: input.uploadDate,
    duration: input.duration,
    contentUrl: watchUrl,
    embedUrl: `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${input.youtubeId}`,
  };
}

/**
 * ItemList for hub pages (home, /database, /calculators, /guides, /news,
 * /gta-6-release-time). Every entry must be a real link rendered on the
 * page — never invent list entries. Deliberately NOT Dataset (databases are
 * unverified), NOT AggregateRating (never faked), NOT HowTo (never used).
 */
export function itemListSchema(name: string, items: ItemListEntry[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'ItemList',
    name,
    itemListElement: items.map((item, i) => ({
      '@type': 'ListItem',
      position: i + 1,
      name: item.name,
      item: `${SITE_CONFIG.url}${item.path}`,
    })),
  };
}

````

## src/lib/useMounted.ts

````ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * True only after the component has mounted in the browser.
 * Renders `false` on the server and on the first client render, so
 * server-rendered HTML and the first client render always match
 * (no hydration mismatch) while browser-only UI (charts, maps,
 * localStorage-backed state) appears after mount.
 */
export function useMounted(): boolean {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);
  return mounted;
}

````

## src/main.tsx

````tsx
import { createRoot, hydrateRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App.tsx';
import './index.css';

const rootEl = document.getElementById('root')!;

// Prerendered HTML exists in production builds: hydrate it instead of
// re-rendering, so the server HTML and the client tree agree exactly.
// In dev (empty #root) fall back to a normal client render.
if (rootEl.hasChildNodes()) {
  hydrateRoot(rootEl, <App />);
} else {
  createRoot(rootEl).render(<App />);
}

````

````tsx
                      Confirmed

        <section className="py-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">

            items={faqsData}

            badge="Essential Intel"

            <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1/3 bg-gradient-to-l from-[#FF2E93]/20 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

                Get notified when verified map regions, guides, or launch updates are added — sourced from Rockstar, never rumours.

              <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">

                  to="/guides"
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] text-white font-['Orbitron'] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-md hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all min-h-[44px]"
                >
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />

                  to="/status"
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#19E3D0] hover:text-[#19E3D0] text-white font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all min-h-[44px]"
                >
                  <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                  <span>Check Server Status</span>
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>

        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````
