````tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import type L from 'leaflet';
// Leaflet CSS is bundled locally (was an unpkg CDN link in index.html).
import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';
import {
  Filter,
  Search,
  CheckCircle,
  Circle,
  Share2,
  Download,
  Upload,
  RotateCcw,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  MapPin,
  X,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Info
} from 'lucide-react';

import { SEO } from '../components/SEO';
import { BadgeStatus } from '../components/BadgeStatus';
import verifiedRegionsData from '../data/verified-map-regions.json';

interface LocationItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  description: string;
  status: string;
}

const CATEGORIES = [
  { name: 'Regions', color: '#19E3D0', icon: MapPin },
];

// ONLY verified named regions ship on the map (Vice City + Leonida).
// The official game map has not been released; positions are approximate
// real-world analogues shown on a stylized reference map. Verified entries
// are added to src/data/verified-map-regions.json after launch.
const locationsData: LocationItem[] = verifiedRegionsData.regions.map((r) => ({
  id: r.id,
  name: r.name,
  category: r.category,
  lat: r.lat,
  lng: r.lng,
  description: r.description,
  status: r.status,
}));

function createCustomPin(leaflet: typeof import('leaflet'), color: string, isFound: boolean) {
  return leaflet.divIcon({
    className: 'custom-leaflet-marker',
    html: `
      <div style="
        position: relative;
        width: 32px;
        height: 32px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        opacity: ${isFound ? '0.45' : '1'};
        transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
      ">
        <div style="
          width: 24px;
          height: 24px;
          border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0;
          background: ${color};
          transform: rotate(-45deg);
          border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
          box-shadow: 0 0 12px ${color};
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
        ">
          <div style="
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: #0B0614;
            border-radius: 50%;
          "></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [32, 32],
    iconAnchor: [16, 32],
    popupAnchor: [0, -32],
  });
}

export function MapPage() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [selectedCategories, setSelectedCategories] = useState<string[]>(
    CATEGORIES.map((c) => c.name)
  );
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [hideFound, setHideFound] = useState(false);
  const [mobileFilterOpen, setMobileFilterOpen] = useState(false);
  const [showResetConfirm, setShowResetConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [showDataModal, setShowDataModal] = useState(false);
  const [dataModalMode, setDataModalMode] = useState<'export' | 'import'>('export');
  const [importJsonText, setImportJsonText] = useState('');
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState('');
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Discovered markers — localStorage only, loaded after mount so the
  // server render and the first client render agree (SSR-safe).
  const [foundIds, setFoundIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('vicetools_found_markers');
      if (saved) setFoundIds(JSON.parse(saved));
    } catch {
      // Ignore corrupt/unavailable storage.
    }
  }, []);

  const mapContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mapInstanceRef = useRef<L.Map | null>(null);
  const markersLayerRef = useRef<L.LayerGroup | null>(null);
  const leafletRef = useRef<typeof import('leaflet') | null>(null);
  const [leafletReady, setLeafletReady] = useState(false);

  const saveFoundIds = (newIds: string[]) => {
    setFoundIds(newIds);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('vicetools_found_markers', JSON.stringify(newIds));
    } catch {
      // Storage unavailable — progress is kept in memory only.
    }
  };

  const toggleFound = (id: string) => {
    if (foundIds.includes(id)) {
      saveFoundIds(foundIds.filter((item) => item !== id));
      showToast('Marker unchecked');
    } else {
      saveFoundIds([...foundIds, id]);
      showToast('Marked as discovered!');
    }
  };

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3000);
  };

  // URL query handling (?id=loc-01&category=Vehicles)
  const queryId = searchParams.get('id');
  const queryCategory = searchParams.get('category');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (queryCategory) {
      const match = CATEGORIES.find(
        (c) => c.name.toLowerCase() === queryCategory.toLowerCase()
      );
      if (match && !selectedCategories.includes(match.name)) {
        setSelectedCategories([match.name]);
      }
    }
  }, [queryCategory]);

  const targetLocation = useMemo(() => {
    if (!queryId) return null;
    return locationsData.find((l) => l.id === queryId) || null;
  }, [queryId]);

  // Filter locations
  const filteredLocations = useMemo(() => {
    return locationsData.filter((loc) => {
      if (!selectedCategories.includes(loc.category)) return false;
      if (hideFound && foundIds.includes(loc.id)) return false;
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matchesName = loc.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesDesc = loc.description.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesCat = loc.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matchesName && !matchesDesc && !matchesCat) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [selectedCategories, hideFound, foundIds, searchQuery]);

  // Statistics
  const totalCount = locationsData.length;
  const foundCount = foundIds.filter((id) =>
    locationsData.some((l) => l.id === id)
  ).length;
  const overallPercentage = Math.round((foundCount / totalCount) * 100);

  const categoryStats = useMemo(() => {
    return CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
      const totalInCat = locationsData.filter((l) => l.category === cat.name).length;
      const foundInCat = locationsData.filter(
        (l) => l.category === cat.name && foundIds.includes(l.id)
      ).length;
      const pct = totalInCat > 0 ? Math.round((foundInCat / totalInCat) * 100) : 0;
      return {
        ...cat,
        total: totalInCat,
        found: foundInCat,
        pct,
      };
    });
  }, [foundIds]);

  const toggleCategory = (catName: string) => {
    if (selectedCategories.includes(catName)) {
      setSelectedCategories(selectedCategories.filter((c) => c !== catName));
    } else {
      setSelectedCategories([...selectedCategories, catName]);
    }
  };

  const selectAllCategories = () => setSelectedCategories(CATEGORIES.map((c) => c.name));
  const clearAllCategories = () => setSelectedCategories([]);

  const handleCopyShareLink = (loc: LocationItem) => {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/map?category=${encodeURIComponent(
      loc.category
    )}&id=${loc.id}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
    showToast('Direct coordinate link copied to clipboard!');
  };

  const handleResetProgress = () => {
    saveFoundIds([]);
    setShowResetConfirm(false);
    showToast('All map discovery progress cleared.');
  };

  const handleExportJson = () => {
    const dataStr = JSON.stringify(foundIds, null, 2);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(dataStr);
    showToast('Progress JSON copied to clipboard!');
  };

  const handleImportJson = () => {
    setImportError('');
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(importJsonText);
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        throw new Error('Import data must be a JSON array of location IDs.');
      }
      saveFoundIds(parsed);
      setShowDataModal(false);
      setImportJsonText('');
      showToast(`Successfully imported ${parsed.length} discovered items!`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (err instanceof Error) {
        setImportError(err.message);
      } else {
        setImportError('Invalid JSON format.');
      }
    }
  };

  // Initialize Map — Leaflet is loaded dynamically AFTER mount (it needs
  // window/document, so it must never run during SSR).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mapContainerRef.current) return;
    if (mapInstanceRef.current) return;
    let cancelled = false;

    (async () => {
      const leaflet = await import('leaflet');
      if (cancelled || !mapContainerRef.current) return;
      leafletRef.current = leaflet;

      const initialCenter: [number, number] = targetLocation
        ? [targetLocation.lat, targetLocation.lng]
        : [25.78, -80.20];

      const map = leaflet.map(mapContainerRef.current, {
        center: initialCenter,
        zoom: 9,
        minZoom: 7,
        maxZoom: 16,
      });

      leaflet.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
        attribution: '&copy; CARTO &copy; OpenStreetMap',
      }).addTo(map);

      const layerGroup = leaflet.layerGroup().addTo(map);
      markersLayerRef.current = layerGroup;
      mapInstanceRef.current = map;
      setLeafletReady(true);
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
        mapInstanceRef.current.remove();
        mapInstanceRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Update Markers when filters / foundIds change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!leafletReady || !leafletRef.current || !mapInstanceRef.current || !markersLayerRef.current) return;
    const L = leafletRef.current;
    const layer = markersLayerRef.current;
    layer.clearLayers();

    filteredLocations.forEach((loc) => {
      const catConfig = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.name === loc.category);
      const color = catConfig ? catConfig.color : '#FF2E93';
      const isFound = foundIds.includes(loc.id);

      const marker = L.marker([loc.lat, loc.lng], {
        icon: createCustomPin(L, color, isFound),
      });

      // Construct popup element
      const popupDiv = document.createElement('div');
      popupDiv.className = 'p-1 max-w-xs text-left';
      popupDiv.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;">
          <span style="font-size:10px;font-family:monospace;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;background-color:${color}25;color:${color}">
            ${loc.category}
          </span>
          <span style="font-size:10px;font-family:monospace;color:${loc.status === 'confirmed' ? '#19E3D0' : '#FFC857'}">
            ${loc.status.toUpperCase()}
          </span>
        </div>
        <h4 style="font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;color:#FFFFFF;margin:0 0 4px 0;">
          ${loc.name}
        </h4>
        <p style="font-size:12px;color:#B9A6D4;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 10px 0;">
          ${loc.description}
        </p>
        <div style="padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;">
          <button id="btn-toggle-${loc.id}" style="
            flex:1;
            padding:6px 10px;
            border-radius:8px;
            font-size:11px;
            font-family:monospace;
            font-weight:bold;
            cursor:pointer;
            background:${isFound ? 'rgba(25,227,208,0.2)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'};
            color:${isFound ? '#19E3D0' : '#FFFFFF'};
            border:${isFound ? '1px solid rgba(25,227,208,0.4)' : '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)'};
          ">
            ${isFound ? '✓ Discovered' : '○ Mark Found'}
          </button>
          <button id="btn-share-${loc.id}" style="
            padding:6px 10px;
            border-radius:8px;
            font-size:11px;
            cursor:pointer;
            background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            color:#B9A6D4;
            border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
          " title="Copy coordinate link">
            🔗
          </button>
        </div>
      `;

      marker.bindPopup(popupDiv);

      marker.on('popupopen', () => {
        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-toggle-${loc.id}`);
        const shareBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-share-${loc.id}`);

        if (toggleBtn) {
          toggleBtn.onclick = () => {
            toggleFound(loc.id);
            marker.closePopup();
          };
        }
        if (shareBtn) {
          shareBtn.onclick = () => {
            handleCopyShareLink(loc);
          };
        }
      });

      layer.addLayer(marker);

      // If this matches queryId, auto-open popup
      if (queryId === loc.id) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          marker.openPopup();
        }, 300);
      }
    });
  }, [leafletReady, filteredLocations, foundIds, queryId]);

  // Center on target location when queryId changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetLocation && mapInstanceRef.current) {
      mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo([targetLocation.lat, targetLocation.lng], 13, { duration: 1.2 });
    }
  }, [targetLocation]);

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="Interactive GTA 6 Map | Leonida & Vice City Regions"
        description="Stylized reference map for Grand Theft Auto VI showing the two confirmed regions — Vice City and Leonida. The official game map has not been released; positions are approximate."
        canonical="/map"
        ogImage="https://vicetools.app/og-map.png"
      />

      {/* Main Map Container */}
      <div className="relative w-full h-[calc(100vh-64px)] flex flex-col md:flex-row overflow-hidden bg-[#0B0614]">
        
        {/* LAUNCH NOTICE BANNER */}
        <div className="absolute top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[400] max-w-lg w-[92%] sm:w-auto px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#150A24]/90 border border-[#FF2E93]/40 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0] shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-mono">
              <strong>Official map not released:</strong> stylized reference map of the two confirmed regions (Vice City, Leonida). Positions are approximate.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TOAST NOTIFICATION */}
        {toastMessage && (
          <div className="absolute top-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[500] px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19E3D0] text-[#0B0614] font-semibold text-xs font-mono shadow-xl animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
            {toastMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* DESKTOP SIDEBAR / FILTER PANEL */}
        <aside className="hidden md:flex flex-col w-80 lg:w-96 bg-[#150A24] border-r border-[#FF2E93]/20 z-10 shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden">
          {/* Header & Overall Progress */}
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#1E1033]/50">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <MapPin className="w-5 h-5 text-[#FF2E93]" />
                <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white">
                  LEONIDA ATLAS
                </h1>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#19E3D0] bg-[#19E3D0]/10 border border-[#19E3D0]/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold">
                FAN RADAR
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Overall Progress Bar */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
                <span className="text-[#B9A6D4]">Exploration Progress</span>
                <span className="text-white font-bold">
                  {foundCount} / {totalCount} ({overallPercentage}%)
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] via-[#FF7A18] to-[#19E3D0] transition-all duration-300"
                  style={{ width: `${overallPercentage}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Search Box */}
          <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/5">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#B9A6D4] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search regions..."
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-xs text-white placeholder-[#B9A6D4]/40 focus:border-[#FF2E93] focus:outline-none"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Filter Controls Bar */}
          <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={selectAllCategories}
                className="text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                All
              </button>
              <span className="text-white/20">|</span>
              <button
                onClick={clearAllCategories}
                className="text-[#B9A6D4] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setHideFound(!hideFound)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            >
              {hideFound ? (
                <>
                  <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF7A18]" />
                  <span>Hidden ({foundCount})</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Hide Found</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Categories List with Checkboxes & Progress */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-1.5">
            {categoryStats.map((cat) => {
              const isChecked = selectedCategories.includes(cat.name);
              return (
                <div
                  key={cat.name}
                  onClick={() => toggleCategory(cat.name)}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between ${
                    isChecked
                      ? 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 hover:border-[#FF2E93]/40'
                      : 'bg-transparent border-transparent opacity-50 hover:opacity-80'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div
                      className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full shrink-0"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: cat.color }}
                    />
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                        {cat.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70">
                        {cat.found} / {cat.total} found
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                      {cat.pct}%
                    </span>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isChecked}
                      onChange={() => {}}
                      className="rounded accent-[#FF2E93] cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Action Bar (Import / Export / Reset) */}
          <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#0B0614]/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setDataModalMode('export');
                setShowDataModal(true);
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#19E3D0] p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
              title="Backup your discovered markers"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Export</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setDataModalMode('import');
                setShowDataModal(true);
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#19E3D0] p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
              title="Import saved progress"
            >
              <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Import</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#FF2E93] hover:text-red-400 p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
              title="Reset discovered markers"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Reset</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* MOBILE FILTER TOGGLE BAR (FLOATING) */}
        <div className="md:hidden absolute bottom-20 left-4 right-4 z-[400] flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setMobileFilterOpen(true)}
            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#150A24]/95 border border-[#FF2E93] text-white font-mono text-xs font-semibold shadow-xl shadow-black/80 backdrop-blur-md cursor-pointer"
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FF2E93]" />
            <span>Map Filters & Progress ({foundCount}/{totalCount})</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* MOBILE BOTTOM SHEET FOR FILTERS */}
        {mobileFilterOpen && (
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[600] md:hidden bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end"
            onClick={() => setMobileFilterOpen(false)}
          >
            <div
              className="w-full bg-[#150A24] border-t border-[#FF2E93] rounded-t-3xl p-6 pb-24 max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300"
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10 mb-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white">
                    FILTER MAP COORDINATES
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Discovered: {foundCount} of {totalCount} ({overallPercentage}%)
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setMobileFilterOpen(false)}
                  className="p-2 rounded-lg text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Mobile Quick Actions */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-white/5 text-xs font-mono">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button onClick={selectAllCategories} className="text-[#19E3D0]">
                    Select All
                  </button>
                  <span>•</span>
                  <button onClick={clearAllCategories} className="text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Clear
                  </button>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setHideFound(!hideFound)}
                  className="text-xs text-[#FF7A18]"
                >
                  {hideFound ? 'Showing All' : 'Hide Found Items'}
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Categories */}
              <div className="overflow-y-auto py-3 space-y-2 flex-1">
                {categoryStats.map((cat) => {
                  const isChecked = selectedCategories.includes(cat.name);
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={cat.name}
                      onClick={() => toggleCategory(cat.name)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                        isChecked
                          ? 'bg-white/5 border-[#FF2E93]/40'
                          : 'bg-transparent border-transparent opacity-60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div
                          className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: cat.color }}
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                          {cat.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                        {cat.found}/{cat.total}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(true)}
                  className="text-xs font-mono text-[#FF2E93] hover:underline"
                >
                  Reset Progress
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setMobileFilterOpen(false)}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Apply Filters
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* NATIVE LEAFLET MAP CONTAINER */}
        <div className="flex-1 h-full relative z-0">
          <div ref={mapContainerRef} className="w-full h-full bg-[#0B0614]" />
        </div>

        {/* RESET CONFIRMATION MODAL */}
        {showResetConfirm && (
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[700] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in"
          >
            <div className="max-w-sm w-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
              <h4 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white mb-2">
                RESET EXPLORATION PROGRESS?
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed mb-6">
                This will uncheck all {foundCount} discovered locations stored in your browser. This action cannot be undone.
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleResetProgress}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-[#FF2E93] text-white hover:bg-red-500"
                >
                  Confirm Reset
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* IMPORT / EXPORT MODAL */}
        {showDataModal && (
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[700] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in"
          >
            <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/50 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10 mb-4">
                <h4 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white">
                  {dataModalMode === 'export' ? 'EXPORT PROGRESS' : 'IMPORT PROGRESS'}
                </h4>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowDataModal(false)}
                  className="text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {dataModalMode === 'export' ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Your current discovered list contains {foundCount} markers. Click below to copy the JSON payload to transfer across devices.
                  </p>
                  <pre className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#19E3D0] max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
                    {JSON.stringify(foundIds, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleExportJson}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#19E3D0] to-[#FF2E93] text-[#0B0614] font-mono font-bold text-xs hover:brightness-110 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Copy JSON to Clipboard
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Paste your previously exported JSON array of discovered IDs below:
                  </p>
                  <textarea
                    rows={4}
                    value={importJsonText}
                    onChange={(e) => setImportJsonText(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder='["loc-01", "loc-02"]'
                    className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-white/20 focus:border-[#19E3D0] focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  {importError && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-[#FF2E93] font-mono">{importError}</p>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={handleImportJson}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#19E3D0] text-[#0B0614] font-mono font-bold text-xs hover:brightness-110 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Load Progress
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { Activity, Clock, ExternalLink, Server, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { SEO } from '../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { EmailCapture } from '../components/EmailCapture';
import { QuickAnswer } from '../components/Article';
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../config/site';
import statusData from '../data/status.json';

/**
 * Honest pre-launch status page. GTA 6 is not out yet, so there is no live
 * server telemetry to show — and this page does not pretend otherwise.
 * It links out to the official status pages and documents how real status
 * data will be wired in after launch (see src/data/status.json _comment).
 */
export function StatusPage() {
  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Server Status — Pre-Launch"
        description="GTA 6 servers are not live yet. Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026 — check the official PlayStation, Xbox, and Rockstar status pages here."
        canonical="/status"
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/status" />

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FFC857]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FFC857] mb-3">
            <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>PRE-LAUNCH</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Server & Cloud <span className="text-[#19E3D0]">Status</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] max-w-2xl">
            {statusData.message}
          </p>
        </div>

        <QuickAnswer>
          Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
          There are no GTA 6 servers to monitor yet — and no online mode has been announced for
          launch. This page will switch to live status once Rockstar publishes real server data.
        </QuickAnswer>

        {/* NOT-LIVE NOTICE */}
        <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FFC857]/30 shadow-xl mb-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start gap-4">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#FFC857]/10 border border-[#FFC857]/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <Server className="w-6 h-6 text-[#FFC857]" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white">Servers not live yet</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Any site showing GTA 6 uptime, ping, or outage history today is inventing it. We do
              not publish server numbers until they come from a real, checkable source. The
              official status pages below are the only live sources right now.
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mt-2 font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF2E93]" />
              Last checked: no live data yet — this page shows a check time only once real data exists.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* OFFICIAL STATUS LINKS */}
        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl text-white uppercase mb-4">
          Official status pages
        </h2>
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 mb-12">
          {statusData.officialStatusLinks.map((link) => (
            <a
              key={link.url}
              href={link.url}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="group p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 hover:border-[#19E3D0]/60 transition-all"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <Activity className="w-6 h-6 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4 text-[#B9A6D4] group-hover:text-[#19E3D0] transition-colors" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white group-hover:text-[#19E3D0] transition-colors">
                {link.label}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mt-1">{link.url}</p>
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* WHAT HAPPENS AT LAUNCH */}
        <div className="p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 mb-12">
          <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl text-white uppercase mb-4">
            What happens at launch
          </h2>
          <ul className="space-y-3 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed list-disc pl-5">
            <li>
              Pre-load begins November 10, 2026 (PlayStation 5 at midnight local time; Xbox
              Series X|S at 12:00 AM GMT). The pre-load file is up to 212 GB.
            </li>
            <li>
              The game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions, on
              both consoles.
            </li>
            <li>
              Once Rockstar publishes real server status, this page will show it with a visible
              &ldquo;last checked&rdquo; time and a link to the source — never invented numbers.
            </li>
            <li>
              No online mode has been announced for launch. If Rockstar announces one, it will
              be added here with its source.
            </li>
          </ul>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]/60 mt-4 font-mono">
            Sources: {statusData.sources.map((s) => s.name).join(' · ')} — last verified{' '}
            {statusData.sources[0]?.last_verified ?? '2026-11-05'}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="max-w-xl mb-12">
          <EmailCapture title="Get notified when live status goes up" />
        </div>

        <div className="text-center">
          <Link to="/" className="text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline">
            ← Back to the toolkit
          </Link>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[#B9A6D4]/50 mt-4 font-mono">
            {SITE_CONFIG.disclaimer}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

````

## src/pages/about/MethodologyPage.tsx

````tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { BookOpen } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { AuthorBox, RelatedPages } from '../../components/Article';
import { articleSchema } from '../../lib/schema';
import { getAuthorName, SITE_CONFIG } from '../../config/site';

/**
 * Methodology + editorial policy page. Explains the three labels
 * (Confirmed / Reported / Rumor), the official-sources rule, how
 * corrections are handled, and carries the dated update log seeded with
 * the Batch 1–5 milestones. Linked from About and the site footer.
 */
export function MethodologyPage() {
  const description =
    'How VICE TOOLS verifies every GTA 6 fact: official sources only for Confirmed, Reported vs Rumor labels, corrections policy, and the full update log.';
  const url = `${SITE_CONFIG.url}/about/methodology`;

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="Methodology — How We Verify GTA 6 Facts"
        description={description}
        canonical="/about/methodology"
        type="article"
        articlePublished="2026-11-05"
        articleModified="2026-11-05"
        schema={articleSchema({
          headline: 'Methodology — How We Verify GTA 6 Facts',
          description,
          datePublished: '2026-11-05',
          dateModified: '2026-11-05',
          authorName: getAuthorName(),
          url,
        })}
      />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/about/methodology" />

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mb-3">
            <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>EDITORIAL POLICY • LAST UPDATED NOVEMBER 5, 2026</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white leading-tight">
            Methodology &amp; Editorial Policy
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] mt-3">Last updated: November 5, 2026</p>
        </div>

        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-6 font-light">
          VICE TOOLS is an unofficial, fan-made companion site for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is
          not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two
          Interactive. Because the game has not launched yet, most of what is written about it
          online is a mixture of fact, report, and rumor — and this site exists to separate the
          three. This page explains exactly how we do that, how we handle mistakes, and what has
          changed on the site so far.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          The three labels
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Every fact on this site carries one of three labels, shown in the facts table on every
          content page. <strong className="text-white">Confirmed</strong> means the claim comes
          from an official source: Rockstar Games Newswire, rockstargames.com/VI, the
          PlayStation Store, or the Xbox Store. A confirmed claim must have a source URL and a
          last-verified date, and the site&rsquo;s build fails if either is missing — the rule
          is enforced by an automated check, not by good intentions. The release date, the
          prices, the editions, the pre-load date, and the 212 GB file size are all confirmed
          in that sense.
        </p>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          <strong className="text-white">Reported</strong> means the claim comes from a named,
          reputable source — a known outlet, a court document, or documented reference coverage
          — but Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, or Xbox has not confirmed it. Reported claims
          are always labelled as reported, always dated, and always sourced to the outlet that
          made them. The $1–1.5 billion development-cost estimate, the 80-hour playthrough, and
          the claim that the map is three times larger than Red Dead Redemption 2&rsquo;s are
          all reported, not confirmed. <strong className="text-white">Rumor</strong> means a
          claim with no source at all — a social-media post, an anonymous forum thread, a
          video with no citation. Rumors are not published on this site, even to debunk them.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What we do not publish
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          We do not publish leaked material, link to it, or describe it. Leaks are unreliable —
          early footage and documents are outdated by the time they circulate — unfair to the
          people making the game, and a security risk for readers, because most links promising
          leaked footage are malware or phishing. We do not publish &ldquo;free download&rdquo;
          or &ldquo;free early access&rdquo; offers, because there is no free GTA 6 download:
          the game is $79.99 (Standard) or $99.99 (Ultimate), and the only legitimate sources
          are the PlayStation Store, the Xbox Store, and authorised retailers. We do not use
          Rockstar&rsquo;s logos, artwork, screenshots, or trademarked fonts. We do not invent
          authors, reviews, ratings, uptime numbers, server status, or social accounts — where
          a name or an account is not yet set, the site shows a placeholder or nothing at all.
          See our{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-leaks-vs-confirmed" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">leaks vs confirmed</Link> page
          for the full policy and how to spot fake offers.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          How content is written
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Content pages follow a fixed structure so that readers — and search engines — can
          check every claim. Each page opens with a short &ldquo;quick answer&rdquo; of forty
          to sixty words, then a facts table with a Confirmed, Reported, or Unconfirmed label
          and a source link for every row. Depth sections follow, then a FAQ, then a
          &ldquo;Sources and last verified&rdquo; box with the date the page was last checked.
          Titles are unique and under sixty characters; descriptions are under 155 characters.
          Every page carries structured data (Article and FAQPage, plus VideoObject only where
          every field is real and verified) and a visible last-updated date that matches the
          date in the structured data. Dated phrasing is used for anything that will change —
          &ldquo;As of November 5, 2026&rdquo; — so a number that goes stale is visibly dated
          rather than silently wrong.
        </p>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          The tools on this site — the map, the calculators, the database, and the status page —
          follow the same rule. The map shows only the two confirmed regions, Vice City and
          Leonida, and is labelled as a stylised reference map with a visible notice that the
          official map has not been released. The database catalogues are empty until launch,
          because no entry in them can be verified yet: every item in the original catalogues

        </h2>
````

````tsx
          The Standard Edition is the game, nothing more and nothing less: the full
          single-player campaign of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in Vice City and Leonida, on
          PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S, launching November 19, 2026. It costs $79.99 in the
          US, and it is the only edition with a boxed version — a code-in-box release that
          reaches shops from November 12, 2026 and contains a download code, not a disc. Buy
          before November 20, 2026 and it includes the Vintage Vice City Pack; buy digital and
          it includes one month of GTA+. Pre-loading starts November 10 (November 12 for a
          boxed code), and the game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19. If you only
          want the game, this is the edition to buy.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Ultimate Edition in detail
        </h2>

          The Ultimate Edition is the same game plus one thing: the{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">Ultimate Edition Upgrade</strong>. It costs $99.99 in
          the US — $20 more than Standard — and it is digital-only, so there is no boxed
          version. The PlayStation Store lists the Ultimate Edition as the game, the Upgrade,
          the Vintage Vice City Pack, one month of GTA+, and the nine-day pre-load. The Xbox
          Store describes the Upgrade as exclusive in-game bonuses for Grand Theft Auto VI,
          available to Jason and Lucia across their story, with new items uncovered behind each
          chapter.
        </p>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          One deliberate omission on this page: we do not name the individual items in the
          Upgrade. The official store listings describe it as a collection without an itemized,
          checkable list, and naming individual items from rumours or from other sites&rsquo;
          round-ups would be presenting unverified details as facts. The same applies to the
          Vintage Vice City Pack: Rockstar has not published a detailed item list for it on the
          pages we verified. If Rockstar publishes itemized lists, this page will carry them
          with the source.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Which edition should you buy?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          The honest answer is that it depends on one question: do you want the extra in-game
          bonuses? The game itself, the launch date, the pre-load, and the pre-order bonuses
          are identical in both editions. The $20 buys only the Ultimate Edition Upgrade. If
          you play GTA for the story and the world, Standard is enough — the campaign is the
          same. If you want the extra bonuses threaded through Jason and Lucia&rsquo;s story, buy
          Ultimate. And if you are unsure, buy Standard: you can purchase the Upgrade
          separately later, so the decision is not final at launch. The one choice you cannot
          make later is the format — Ultimate is digital-only, so if you want a box on the
          shelf, it has to be the Standard Edition code-in-box.
        </p>
````

````tsx
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire',
            },
            {
              fact: 'An official pre-order total from Rockstar or Take-Two',
              status: 'unconfirmed',
            },
          ]}
        />

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          The honest answer: nobody outside Rockstar knows
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          This is the shortest honest answer on the site, and it is worth stating plainly
          before anything else: <strong className="text-white">Rockstar Games and Take-Two
          Interactive have published no official pre-order numbers for GTA 6.</strong> Not a
          total, not a revenue figure, not a unit count, not a record claim. Pre-orders opened
          on June 25, 2026, and the game launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox
          Series X|S — but the companies have said nothing about how many people have bought
          it. Any number you see presented as &lsquo;the&rsquo; pre-order total is either an estimate
          from a third party, or it is invented. This page carries the estimates that exist,
          each dated and sourced, and labels them as what they are.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What has been reported
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Two estimates circulate, and they measure different things. The first, reported by{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">Insider Gaming</strong>, puts GTA 6 pre-orders at
          roughly <strong className="text-white">$750 million</strong> in revenue, or about{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">7.7 million orders</strong>. That is a revenue-first
          figure: it is about money taken, not a count of individual copies, and it comes from
          a games-industry outlet rather than from Rockstar or Take-Two. The second, from{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">Sensor Tower</strong>, estimated about{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">6.45 million digital pre-orders</strong>, worth about{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">$630 million</strong>, as of{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">October 20, 2026</strong>. That one is narrower by
          design: digital pre-orders only, counted to a specific date, by a third-party
          analytics firm that tracks store data. Neither firm is Rockstar. Neither figure is
          official.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Why the estimates disagree
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          The two figures look like they should match, and they do not — $750 million against
          $630 million, 7.7 million against 6.45 million. That is not a contradiction; it is
          what happens when two different things are measured on two different dates. One
          counts revenue, the other counts digital units. One has no stated cut-off date, the
          other is fixed to October 20, 2026. One may include boxed pre-orders, the other
          counts digital only. Pre-orders also keep growing every day between the estimate and
          the launch, so any number dated October is already out of date by November. The
          correct way to read these figures is as a range with a direction — pre-orders are
          very large, and growing — not as a precise total. Anyone quoting one of them without
          its date and its source is quoting it wrong.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What Take-Two has said
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Take-Two has not given a pre-order number either — but it has said something about
          the scale it expects. The company has told investors it expects record levels of net
          bookings in fiscal 2027, which covers the GTA 6 launch, and its CEO has described the
          game as the most extraordinary title in the history of entertainment. That is
          confidence, not a number, and this page does not turn it into one. The first official
          numbers, if Take-Two publishes any, will come in its earnings reports after launch —
          and when they do, this page will carry them with the source and the date, and the
          estimates above will be marked as superseded.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          How to read pre-order headlines
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Three questions separate a useful headline from a misleading one. First: who is the
          source — Rockstar, Take-Two, or a third party? If it is not one of the two companies,
          it is an estimate. Second: what is being counted — revenue, units, digital only, or
          all pre-orders? A revenue figure and a unit figure are not interchangeable. Third:
          when was it measured? A number from October is not a number for November. If a
          headline gives you a total with no source, no definition, and no date, it has given
          you a rumour with the packaging removed. The figures on this page pass all three
          tests, and they are still only estimates — which is exactly why they are labelled
          that way.
        </p>

        <FAQSection items={faq} title="GTA 6 pre-orders — Questions" subtitle="" badge="" badgeColor="#FFC857" />

        <SourcesBox
          sources={[
            { name: 'Rockstar Newswire — GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 (no numbers published)', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026' },
            { name: 'Rockstar Games — GTA VI editions page', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/editions' },
          ]}
          lastVerified="2026-11-05"
        />

        <AuthorBox />

        <RelatedPages
          pages={[
            { name: 'GTA 6 pre-order', path: '/gta-6-pre-order' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 editions', path: '/gta-6-editions' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 price', path: '/gta-6-price' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 delay history', path: '/gta-6-delay-history' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 release date', path: '/gta-6-release-date' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
          What the $20 buys

          The $20 between the editions buys exactly one thing: the{' '}
          <strong className="text-white">Ultimate Edition Upgrade</strong>. It is a collection of
          exclusive in-game bonuses for Jason and Lucia, with new items uncovered behind each

          — the game, the November 19, 2026 launch date, the midnight local unlock, the
          November 10 pre-load, the Vintage Vice City Pack before November 20, and the month of
          GTA+ with a digital pre-order. If you buy Standard and change your mind, you can buy
          the Upgrade separately later, so the $20 is a decision you can defer. No standalone
          price for the Upgrade alone has been published on the pages we verified, so this page
          does not state one. The full comparison is on our{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-editions" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">editions page</Link>.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Regional pricing
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          The prices above are US prices. Regional prices vary by store and currency, and they
          are not a simple conversion of the dollar price — each store sets its own local price.
          This site lists US prices only, because those are the ones confirmed on the official
          editions page. We do not list prices for other regions, because we have not verified
          them against the official store listings one by one, and a wrong local price is worse
          than no local price. Before you buy, check the price in your own country&rsquo;s store:{' '}
          <a href="https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">PlayStation Store</a> for
          PS5, or{' '}
          <a href="https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/grand-theft-auto-vi/9P3H4968GRSM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">Xbox Store</a> for
          Xbox Series X|S. The store in your region will show the price in your currency, and
          that is the price that applies to you.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Is the price the new normal?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          GTA 6&rsquo;s Standard Edition costs ten dollars more than the price many new games
          launched at in recent years, and the industry has been watching that number closely —
          some analysts expected Rockstar to charge even more. But the price is what it is: $79.99
          and $99.99 in the US, confirmed by Rockstar and both console stores, and there is no
          higher &lsquo;premium&rsquo; tier above Ultimate. Whether other publishers follow Rockstar&rsquo;s
          price is their decision, not something this page predicts. What matters for you is
          simpler: the game costs what the store in your country says it costs, and the only
          legitimate way to pay less is to wait for a sale that has not been announced.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Will the price drop?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          No price drop has been announced, and Rockstar has said nothing about future pricing.
          Big games do go on sale eventually, but &lsquo;eventually&rsquo; is not a date, and this site
          does not predict one. If you want the pre-order bonuses — the Vintage Vice City Pack
          and the month of GTA+ — the relevant deadline is not a sale but November 20, 2026:
          purchases made before that date include the pack, and purchases after it do not. If
          you are willing to wait for a lower price, you are also giving up those bonuses. That
          is the real trade-off, and it is the only one this page can state with confidence.
        </p>

        <FAQSection items={faq} title="GTA 6 price — Questions" subtitle="" badge="" badgeColor="#FFC857" />

          sources={[
````

````tsx
      path: '/calculators/loadout',

    },

      badge: 'Motorsports',
      badgeColor: '#19E3D0',
      features: ['Head-to-head stat bars', 'Automated winner highlights', 'Class filters', 'Price-to-speed ratio']
    }
  ];

  return (

      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Calculators & Optimization Tools"

        canonical="/calculators"
        ogImage="https://vicetools.app/og-tools.png"
        schema={[
          faqSchema,
          itemListSchema('GTA 6 Calculators', [
            { name: 'Money Calculator', path: '/calculators/money' },
            { name: 'Loadout Builder', path: '/calculators/loadout' },
            { name: 'Vehicle Comparison', path: '/calculators/compare' },
          ]),
        ]}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-12">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19E3D0] mb-4">
            <Cpu className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#19E3D0]" />
            <span>ALGORITHMIC GAMEPLAY ENGINES</span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-5xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Tactical & Economy <span className="gradient-sunset-text">Calculators</span>
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-4 text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            Plan your progression with your own numbers. The calculators work with the values you
            enter — no in-game prices or stats are officially confirmed yet.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Ad Slot */}

        {/* Tools Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 mb-16">
          {tools.map((tool) => (
            <div
              key={tool.id}
              className="rounded-3xl p-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 hover:border-[#FF2E93] transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-[#FF2E93]/20 flex flex-col justify-between group"
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
                  <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 group-hover:border-[#FF2E93] flex items-center justify-center transition-all">
                    <tool.icon className="w-7 h-7 text-[#FF2E93] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-current/30"
                    style={{ color: tool.badgeColor }}
                  >
                    {tool.badge}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl text-white group-hover:text-[#FF7A18] transition-colors mb-3">
                  {tool.title}
                </h2>

                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed mb-6">
                  {tool.description}
                </p>

                {/* Features List */}
                <div className="space-y-2 pt-4 border-t border-white/5 mb-6">
                  {tool.features.map((feat) => (
                    <div key={feat} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/80">
                      <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                      <span>{feat}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <Link
                to={tool.path}
                className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] text-white font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg shadow-[#FF2E93]/30 hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all min-h-[44px]"
              >
                <span>Launch {tool.title.split(' ')[0]} Tool</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Link>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Informational SEO text block */}
        <div className="p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed space-y-4 mb-16">
          <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0]" />
            <span>Why Progression Planning Matters in Vice City</span>
          </h3>
          <p>
            Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
            Until then, no in-game prices, incomes, or stats are officially confirmed, so the
            calculators work with the numbers you enter: set a savings goal, enter your hourly
            income, and plan your sessions. When verified values arrive at launch, they will be
            added with a source and a last-verified date.
          </p>
          <p>
            All mathematical parameters across our calculator modules are client-side only. Your saved goals, builds, and custom comparisons are cached directly inside your browser storage, meaning your session data never leaves your device and remains completely private.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* FAQ ACCORDION & SCHEMA.ORG JSON-LD */}
        <FAQSection
          items={calculatorHubFaqs}
          title="Calculators & Tooling FAQ"
          subtitle="Everything you need to know about our algorithms, local persistence, and accuracy."
          badge="Calculator Intel"
          badgeColor="#19E3D0"
          className="mb-8"
          renderJsonLd={false}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````
