````tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { 
  Crosshair, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Share2, 
  Save, 
  Sparkles, 
  ArrowRight, 
  Coins, 
  Check, 
  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronUp, 
  Bookmark
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  Radar, 
  RadarChart, 
  PolarGrid, 
  PolarAngleAxis, 
  PolarRadiusAxis, 
  ResponsiveContainer 
} from 'recharts';

import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { EmailCapture } from '../../components/EmailCapture';
import { QuickAnswer } from '../../components/Article';
import { FAQSection, FAQItem, buildFaqPageSchema } from '../../components/FAQSection';
import { useMounted } from '../../lib/useMounted';
import weaponsData from '../../data/weapons.json';

interface WeaponItem {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  magCapacity: number;
  stats: {
    damage: number;
    range: number;
    fireRate: number;
    accuracy: number;
    mobility: number;
  };
  description: string;
  status: string;
}

interface SavedPreset {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  weaponIds: string[];
  createdAt: string;
}

export function LoadoutBuilder() {
  const mounted = useMounted();
  // VERIFIED weapons only — the data file holds a schema template, not real items.
  const realWeapons = useMemo(() => weaponsData.filter((w) => w.status === 'confirmed'), []);

  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [selectedWeaponIds, setSelectedWeaponIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  // Saved presets — localStorage only, loaded after mount (SSR-safe).
  const [savedPresets, setSavedPresets] = useState<SavedPreset[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('vicetools_loadout_presets');
      if (saved) setSavedPresets(JSON.parse(saved));
    } catch {
      // Ignore corrupt/unavailable storage.
    }
  }, []);

  const [presetNameInput, setPresetNameInput] = useState('');
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false);
  const [feedbackToast, setFeedbackToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Read URL params ?w=wep-01,wep-02 on initial load
  useEffect(() => {
    const weaponParam = searchParams.get('w');
    if (weaponParam) {
      const ids = weaponParam.split(',').filter((id) => realWeapons.some((w) => w.id === id));
      if (ids.length > 0) {
        setSelectedWeaponIds(ids.slice(0, 6));
      }
    }
    // No default loadout: no weapons are verified yet, so nothing is
    // pre-selected. The builder starts empty until launch.
  }, []);

  // Sync state to URL for sharing
  const syncToUrl = (ids: string[]) => {
    if (ids.length > 0) {
      setSearchParams({ w: ids.join(',') }, { replace: true });
    } else {
      setSearchParams({}, { replace: true });
    }
  };

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setFeedbackToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackToast(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleAddWeapon = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedWeaponIds.includes(id)) return;
    if (selectedWeaponIds.length >= 6) {
      showToast('Maximum 6 weapons allowed in a loadout.');
      return;
    }
    const updated = [...selectedWeaponIds, id];
    setSelectedWeaponIds(updated);
    syncToUrl(updated);
  };

  const handleRemoveWeapon = (id: string) => {
    const updated = selectedWeaponIds.filter((wId) => wId !== id);
    setSelectedWeaponIds(updated);
    syncToUrl(updated);
  };

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setSelectedWeaponIds([]);
    syncToUrl([]);
  };

  const handleCopyShareLink = () => {
    const url = window.location.href;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
    setCopiedLink(true);
    showToast('Loadout permalink copied to clipboard!');
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(false), 2500);
  };

  // Preset saving in localStorage
  const handleSavePreset = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!presetNameInput.trim() || selectedWeaponIds.length === 0) return;

    const newPreset: SavedPreset = {
      id: `preset-${Date.now()}`,
      name: presetNameInput.trim(),
      weaponIds: selectedWeaponIds,
      createdAt: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    };

    const updated = [newPreset, ...savedPresets];
    setSavedPresets(updated);
    try { localStorage.setItem('vicetools_loadout_presets', JSON.stringify(updated)); } catch { /* Storage unavailable. */ }
    setPresetNameInput('');
    showToast(`Saved preset "${newPreset.name}" to browser storage!`);
  };

  const handleLoadPreset = (preset: SavedPreset) => {
    setSelectedWeaponIds(preset.weaponIds);
    syncToUrl(preset.weaponIds);
    showToast(`Loaded "${preset.name}"`);
  };

  const handleDeletePreset = (id: string) => {
    const updated = savedPresets.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
    setSavedPresets(updated);
    try { localStorage.setItem('vicetools_loadout_presets', JSON.stringify(updated)); } catch { /* Storage unavailable. */ }
  };

  // Selected weapons objects
  const selectedWeapons: WeaponItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedWeaponIds
      .map((id) => realWeapons.find((w) => w.id === id))
      .filter((w) => w !== undefined);
  }, [selectedWeaponIds, realWeapons]);

  // Aggregate cost
  const totalCost = selectedWeapons.reduce((sum, w) => sum + w.price, 0);

  // Compute average stats for Radar Chart
  const radarData = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedWeapons.length === 0) {
      return [
        { stat: 'Damage', value: 0, fullMark: 100 },
        { stat: 'Range', value: 0, fullMark: 100 },
        { stat: 'Fire Rate', value: 0, fullMark: 100 },
        { stat: 'Accuracy', value: 0, fullMark: 100 },
        { stat: 'Mobility', value: 0, fullMark: 100 },
      ];
    }

    const totals = selectedWeapons.reduce(
      (acc, w) => ({
        damage: acc.damage + w.stats.damage,
        range: acc.range + w.stats.range,
        fireRate: acc.fireRate + w.stats.fireRate,
        accuracy: acc.accuracy + w.stats.accuracy,
        mobility: acc.mobility + w.stats.mobility,
      }),
      { damage: 0, range: 0, fireRate: 0, accuracy: 0, mobility: 0 }
    );

    const count = selectedWeapons.length;
    return [
      { stat: 'Damage', value: Math.round(totals.damage / count), fullMark: 100 },
      { stat: 'Range', value: Math.round(totals.range / count), fullMark: 100 },
      { stat: 'Fire Rate', value: Math.round(totals.fireRate / count), fullMark: 100 },
      { stat: 'Accuracy', value: Math.round(totals.accuracy / count), fullMark: 100 },
      { stat: 'Mobility', value: Math.round(totals.mobility / count), fullMark: 100 },
    ];
  }, [selectedWeapons]);

  const seoFaqs: FAQItem[] = [
    {
      id: 'faq-loadout-1',
      question: 'How do I build a balanced loadout?',
      answer: 'A balanced loadout covers different ranges: a close-quarters option, a mid-range option, and something for distance. The radar chart averages damage, range, fire rate, accuracy, and mobility across your equipped slots so you can see the trade-offs at a glance.',
      status: 'confirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-loadout-2',
      question: 'Can I share my custom loadouts with crew members?',
      answer: 'Yes. Every change you make automatically serializes into the browser URL. Simply click "Copy Share Link" and send the permalink to your crew or discord channel. They will instantly see your exact weapon slots and radar polygon.',
      status: 'confirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-loadout-3',
      question: 'Are loadout costs based on base weapon prices or attachments?',
      answer: 'The total cost reflects the verified prices in our database. No weapon prices are officially confirmed yet, so the builder works with example values until launch. Attachment costs will be added if Rockstar confirms them.',
      status: 'unconfirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-loadout-4',
      question: 'How is the 5-axis combat radar chart calculated?',
      answer: 'The radar polygon averages out damage, effective range, cyclic fire rate, accuracy, and handling mobility across all equipped slots on a normalized 0-100 baseline.',
      status: 'confirmed'
    }
  ];

  const appSchema = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'SoftwareApplication',
    name: 'Vice Tools Loadout Radar Builder',
    applicationCategory: 'GameApplication',
    operatingSystem: 'All',
    offers: {
      '@type': 'Offer',
      price: '0',
      priceCurrency: 'USD'
    },
    description: 'Interactive tactical loadout builder and radar chart visualizer for Grand Theft Auto VI weaponry and gear.'
  };

  const faqSchema = buildFaqPageSchema(seoFaqs);

  // Coming soon: no verified weapons exist yet, so the builder has nothing
  // to build with. Show the honest state instead of an empty armory.
  if (realWeapons.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        <SEO
          title="GTA 6 Loadout Radar Builder | Coming at Launch"
          description="Build and balance weapon loadouts for GTA 6. Verified weapon stats arrive at launch, November 19, 2026."
          canonical="/calculators/loadout"
        />
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
          <Breadcrumbs pathname="/calculators/loadout" />
          <div className="mt-6 text-center">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF2E93] mb-3">
              <Crosshair className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>COMING AT LAUNCH</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
              Loadout <span className="text-[#FF2E93]">Radar Builder</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <QuickAnswer>
            No GTA 6 weapon has been officially confirmed with stats or a price yet, so there is
            nothing to build a loadout from. The builder goes live at launch with verified weapons
            — damage, range, fire rate, accuracy, and mobility on a radar chart, plus shareable
            permalinks.
          </QuickAnswer>
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto mb-8">
            <EmailCapture title="Get notified when verified weapons are added" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <Link to="/calculators" className="text-sm text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline">
              ← Back to all calculators
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Loadout Radar Builder | Weapon Stats & Cost Calculator"
        description="Build and balance up to 6 weapon slots for GTA 6. Interactive radar chart analyzes damage, range, mobility, and accuracy. Shareable permalinks."
        canonical="/calculators/loadout"
        schema={[appSchema, faqSchema]}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        {/* Breadcrumb */}
        <nav className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mb-6">
          <Link to="/" className="hover:text-white">Home</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <Link to="/calculators" className="hover:text-white">Calculators</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <span className="text-[#FF2E93]">Loadout Builder</span>
        </nav>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF2E93] mb-3">
            <Crosshair className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>TACTICAL ARMORY SIMULATOR</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Loadout <span className="text-[#FF2E93]">Radar Builder</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            Construct custom multi-slot weapon arsenals tailored for robbery getaways, open Everglades reconnaissance, and syndicate turf wars. Analyze dynamic radar synergy curves, calculate purchase budgets, and generate shareable links.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Toast */}
        {feedbackToast && (
          <div className="fixed top-20 right-6 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#19E3D0] text-[#0B0614] font-semibold text-xs font-mono shadow-2xl animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
            {feedbackToast}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Ad slot */}

        {/* BUILDER WORKSPACE (2 Columns) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 mb-12">
          
          {/* LEFT: CURRENT LOADOUT SLOTS & WEAPON PICKER (7 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
            
            {/* ACTIVE SLOTS CONTAINER */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/30 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white">
                    Equipped Slots ({selectedWeapons.length}/6)
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Tap trash icon to unequip slot
                  </p>
                </div>
                {selectedWeapons.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleClearAll}
                    className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#FF2E93] underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Clear All
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Slots Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {selectedWeapons.map((wep, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={wep.id}
                    className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 shadow-md group"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 text-white font-bold">
                          Slot {idx + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#19E3D0]">
                          {wep.category}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white">
                        {wep.name}
                      </h3>
                      <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#FFC857] mt-1">
                        ${wep.price.toLocaleString()} • {wep.magCapacity} Rnds
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveWeapon(wep.id)}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#FF2E93] hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
                      aria-label={`Remove ${wep.name}`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}

                {/* Empty slot placeholders up to 6 */}
                {Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, 6 - selectedWeapons.length) }).map((_, i) => (
                  <div
                    key={`empty-${i}`}
                    className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-center text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/40 min-h-[90px]"
                  >
                    Empty Slot {selectedWeapons.length + i + 1}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Share & Save Preset Bar */}
              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-white/10 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <button
                  onClick={handleCopyShareLink}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-[#FF2E93]/20 hover:border-[#FF2E93]/40 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {copiedLink ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#19E3D0]" /> : <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF2E93]" />}
                  <span>{copiedLink ? 'Link Copied!' : 'Copy Share Link'}</span>
                </button>

                {/* Save Preset to LocalStorage Form */}
                <form onSubmit={handleSavePreset} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={presetNameInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setPresetNameInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Preset name (e.g. Heist Kit)..."
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-xs text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:border-[#FF2E93] focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#FF2E93] hover:bg-[#FF7A18] text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    title="Save Loadout"
                  >
                    <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* CATALOG PICKER TO ADD WEAPONS */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white">
                Available Armory ({realWeapons.length} Models)
              </h2>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {realWeapons.map((wep) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedWeaponIds.includes(wep.id);
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={wep.id}
                      className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all flex items-center justify-between ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-[#19E3D0]/10 border-[#19E3D0]/40 opacity-75'
                          : 'bg-white/5 border-white/5 hover:border-[#FF2E93]/40 hover:bg-[#1E1033]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                          {wep.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mt-0.5">
                          {wep.category} • ${wep.price.toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {isSelected ? (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-[#19E3D0] px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#19E3D0]/10">
                          EQUIPPED
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleAddWeapon(wep.id)}
                          className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-[#FF2E93] text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          aria-label={`Equip ${wep.name}`}
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* SAVED LOCALSTORAGE PRESETS */}
            {savedPresets.length > 0 && (
              <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Bookmark className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                  <span>Saved Browser Presets ({savedPresets.length})</span>
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {savedPresets.map((p) => (
                    <div
                      key={p.id}
                      className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-white">{p.name}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/60 ml-2">
                          ({p.weaponIds.length} weapons • {p.createdAt})
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleLoadPreset(p)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#19E3D0]/20 text-[#19E3D0] hover:bg-[#19E3D0]/30 font-mono font-bold cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Load
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeletePreset(p.id)}
                          className="p-1 text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#FF2E93] cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

          </div>

          {/* RIGHT: RADAR STAT VISUALIZER & FINANCIAL TOTAL (5 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
            
            {/* TOTAL ARSENAL BUDGET */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 shadow-xl text-center">
              <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#B9A6D4]">
                Total Loadout Acquisition Cost
              </span>
              <div className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-mono font-bold text-white mt-1">
                ${totalCost.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2">
                Across {selectedWeapons.length} primary, secondary, and utility items.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* RADAR STATS POLYGON */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white">
                    Combat Synergy Radar
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Aggregate 5-axis combat capability index
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#FF2E93] bg-[#FF2E93]/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#FF2E93]/30 font-bold">
                  RADAR
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="w-full h-72 sm:h-80 -my-2">
                {mounted ? (
                  <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                    <RadarChart cx="50%" cy="50%" outerRadius="75%" data={radarData}>
                    <PolarGrid stroke="#2A134A" />
                    <PolarAngleAxis
                      dataKey="stat"
                      stroke="#B9A6D4"
                      tick={{ fill: '#FFF5FB', fontSize: 11, fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, monospace' }}
                    />
                    <PolarRadiusAxis
                      angle={30}
                      domain={[0, 100]}
                      stroke="#B9A6D4"
                      tick={{ fill: '#B9A6D4', fontSize: 9 }}
                    />
                    <Radar
                      name="Loadout Synergy"
                      dataKey="value"
                      stroke="#FF2E93"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      fill="#FF2E93"
                      fillOpacity={0.45}
                    />
                    </RadarChart>
                  </ResponsiveContainer>
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Radar chart loads in your browser
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Stat Breakdowns */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 text-center pt-2 border-t border-white/5 font-mono">
                {radarData.map((d) => (
                  <div key={d.stat} className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5">
                    <div className="text-[9px] text-[#B9A6D4] uppercase">{d.stat}</div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-white mt-0.5">{d.value}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Ad slot */}

        {/* 150+ WORDS SEO TEXT */}
        <section className="mb-12 p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 space-y-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
          <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white">
            Architecting the Optimal Combat Loadout in Grand Theft Auto VI
          </h2>
          <p>
            A good loadout covers every range: something for close quarters, something for
            mid-range, and something for distance. The radar chart in this builder averages damage,
            range, fire rate, accuracy, and mobility across your equipped slots, so you can see at
            a glance whether your setup is balanced or lopsided — and what to swap to fix it.
          </p>
          <p>
            No GTA 6 weapon has been officially confirmed with stats or a price yet, so this
            builder starts empty and goes live at launch with verified weapons. When the data
            arrives, every entry will carry its source and last-verified date, and the total cost
            will reflect verified prices.
          </p>
          <p>
            Use the built-in URL sharing to exchange loadouts with your crew: every change is
            encoded in the page URL, so a copied link opens the exact same slots. Presets are saved
            in your browser only — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
          </p>
        </section>

        {/* FAQ ACCORDION & SCHEMA.ORG JSON-LD */}
        <FAQSection
          items={seoFaqs}
          title="Frequently Asked Questions"
          subtitle="Technical guidance on loadouts, the radar chart, and squad URL sharing."
          badge="Armory FAQ"
          badgeColor="#FF2E93"
          className="mb-12"
          renderJsonLd={false}
        />

        {/* RELATED TOOL */}
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white">
              Need cash to fund this tactical weapon setup?
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
              Simulate hours and heist payouts with the Money Calculator.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Link
            to="/calculators/money"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:brightness-110 shrink-0"
          >
            <span>Open Money Tool</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Link>
        </div>

      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

## src/pages/calculators/MoneyCalculator.tsx

````tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { 
  Coins, 
  Clock, 
  Calendar, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Sparkles, 
  ArrowRight, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Info,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Target
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  ResponsiveContainer, 
  AreaChart, 
  Area, 
  XAxis, 
  YAxis, 
  Tooltip, 
  CartesianGrid 
} from 'recharts';

import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { FAQSection, FAQItem, buildFaqPageSchema } from '../../components/FAQSection';
import { useMounted } from '../../lib/useMounted';
import vehiclesData from '../../data/vehicles.json';
import propertiesData from '../../data/properties.json';
import weaponsData from '../../data/weapons.json';

interface GoalItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  targetPrice: number;
}

export function MoneyCalculator() {
  const mounted = useMounted();
  const [currentCash, setCurrentCash] = useState<number>(50000);
  const [incomePerHour, setIncomePerHour] = useState<number>(125000);
  const [hoursPerDay, setHoursPerDay] = useState<number>(2.5);

  // Multi-goals state. Default goals are GENERIC EXAMPLES with round
  // numbers — no in-game prices are officially confirmed yet, so no real
  // item or price is used as a default. Edit them to your own targets.
  const [goals, setGoals] = useState<GoalItem[]>([
    { id: 'g-1', name: 'Example supercar', targetPrice: 1000000 },
    { id: 'g-2', name: 'Example penthouse', targetPrice: 5000000 }
  ]);

  const [newGoalName, setNewGoalName] = useState('');
  const [newGoalPrice, setNewGoalPrice] = useState<number | ''>('');

  // Quick picker select
  const [selectedPreset, setSelectedPreset] = useState<string>('');

  // Combined preset options from datasets — VERIFIED entries only.
  // (Empty until launch: no prices are officially confirmed yet.)
  const presetOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const list: { name: string; price: number; type: string }[] = [];
    const real = <T extends { status: string }>(data: T[]) => data.filter((e) => e.status === 'confirmed');
    real(vehiclesData).forEach((v) => list.push({ name: `${v.name} (${v.manufacturer})`, price: v.price, type: 'Vehicle' }));
    real(propertiesData).forEach((p) => list.push({ name: `${p.name} (${p.location})`, price: p.price, type: 'Real Estate' }));
    real(weaponsData).forEach((w) => list.push({ name: `${w.name} (${w.category})`, price: w.price, type: 'Weapon' }));
    return list;
  }, []);

  const handleSelectPreset = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setSelectedPreset(val);
    const item = presetOptions.find((p) => p.name === val);
    if (item) {
      setNewGoalName(item.name);
      setNewGoalPrice(item.price);
    }
  };

  const handleAddGoal = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newGoalName.trim() || !newGoalPrice || Number(newGoalPrice) <= 0) return;

    setGoals([
      ...goals,
      {
        id: `g-${Date.now()}`,
        name: newGoalName.trim(),
        targetPrice: Number(newGoalPrice)
      }
    ]);
    setNewGoalName('');
    setNewGoalPrice('');
    setSelectedPreset('');
  };

  const handleRemoveGoal = (id: string) => {
    if (goals.length <= 1) return;
    setGoals(goals.filter((g) => g.id !== id));
  };

  // Calculations for active goal (first goal)
  const primaryGoal = goals[0] || { id: 'default', name: 'Primary Target', targetPrice: 1000000 };
  const netRequired = Math.max(0, primaryGoal.targetPrice - currentCash);
  const validIncome = Math.max(1, incomePerHour);
  const validHours = Math.max(0.1, hoursPerDay);

  const hoursNeeded = netRequired > 0 ? +(netRequired / validIncome).toFixed(1) : 0;
  const daysNeeded = netRequired > 0 ? +(hoursNeeded / validHours).toFixed(1) : 0;
  const progressPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((currentCash / primaryGoal.targetPrice) * 100));

  // Cumulative total for all goals
  const totalAllGoals = goals.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.targetPrice, 0);
  const netAllRequired = Math.max(0, totalAllGoals - currentCash);
  const totalDaysNeeded = +(netAllRequired / (validIncome * validHours)).toFixed(1);

  // Recharts Savings Curve Data (projecting over 14 days)
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    const daysToProject = Math.min(30, Math.max(7, Math.ceil(daysNeeded * 1.25) || 10));
    const dailyIncome = validIncome * validHours;
    const points = [];

    for (let day = 0; day <= daysToProject; day++) {
      const balance = currentCash + day * dailyIncome;
      points.push({
        day: `Day ${day}`,
        cash: balance,
        target: primaryGoal.targetPrice,
      });
    }
    return points;
  }, [currentCash, validIncome, validHours, daysNeeded, primaryGoal.targetPrice]);

  const seoFaqs: FAQItem[] = [
    {
      id: 'faq-money-1',
      question: 'How does the GTA 6 Money & Grind Calculator estimate completion times?',
      answer: 'The engine calculates net purchasing deficits by subtracting your current liquid bank balance from target item costs, then dividing by your realistic hourly gameplay yield. When daily play session caps are applied, it projects precise calendar days to ownership.',
      status: 'confirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-money-2',
      question: 'What is considered an average hourly income in GTA 6?',
      answer: 'Not officially confirmed. No in-game income figures have been published by Rockstar yet, so there is no verified average to quote. The calculator works with whatever hourly income you enter — use it to plan against your own targets, not as a promise of in-game earnings.',
      status: 'unconfirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-money-3',
      question: 'Can I track multi-tier targets simultaneously?',
      answer: 'Yes! You can add an unlimited number of simultaneous acquisition goals, such as pairing an offshore cigarette speedboat with a luxury beachfront apartment. The calculator tallies combined capital requirements and timeline trajectories.',
      status: 'confirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-money-4',
      question: 'Does this calculator factor in passive income from safehouses or businesses?',
      answer: 'Not yet. No passive-income mechanics have been officially confirmed for GTA 6, so the calculator models only the hourly income you enter. If Rockstar confirms passive income, it will be added here with its source.',
      status: 'unconfirmed'
    }
  ];

  const appSchema = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'SoftwareApplication',
    name: 'Vice Tools Money & Grind Calculator',
    applicationCategory: 'GameApplication',
    operatingSystem: 'All',
    offers: {
      '@type': 'Offer',
      price: '0',
      priceCurrency: 'USD'
    },
    description: 'Financial progression planner for GTA 6 players: project hours, days, and capital curves for goals you set, using the numbers you enter.'
  };

  const faqSchema = buildFaqPageSchema(seoFaqs);

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Money & Progression Calculator | Grind Time & Income Simulator"
        description="Calculate hours, daily play sessions, and earnings required to purchase supercars and luxury penthouses in GTA 6. Interactive timeline chart & goal tracking."
        canonical="/calculators/money"
        schema={[appSchema, faqSchema]}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        {/* Breadcrumb */}
        <nav className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mb-6">
          <Link to="/" className="hover:text-white">Home</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <Link to="/calculators" className="hover:text-white">Calculators</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <span className="text-[#FF7A18]">Money & Progression</span>
        </nav>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF7A18]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF7A18] mb-3">
            <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>VICE CITY FINANCIAL ENGINE</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Money & Progression <span className="text-[#FF7A18]">Calculator</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            Plan your path to empire status in Leonida. Set a savings goal — a supercar, a penthouse, or any target you choose — and this tool maps your grind schedule and daily milestones into clear, actionable timelines.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Top Ad Slot */}

        {/* MAIN CALCULATOR GRID */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 mb-12">
          
          {/* LEFT COLUMN: INPUTS & GOAL MANAGEMENT (5 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 shadow-xl space-y-5">
              <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FF7A18]" />
                <span>Financial Parameters</span>
              </h2>

              {/* Input: Current Cash */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] mb-1.5">
                  Current Liquid Cash ($)
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-sm font-mono text-[#19E3D0]">$</span>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    step="1000"
                    value={currentCash}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrentCash(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)))}
                    className="w-full pl-8 pr-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-white font-mono text-sm focus:border-[#FF7A18] focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Input: Hourly Income */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                  <label className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Estimated Earnings Per Hour ($)
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#19E3D0]">
                    ${incomePerHour.toLocaleString()}/hr
                  </span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="25000"
                  max="500000"
                  step="5000"
                  value={incomePerHour}
                  onChange={(e) => setIncomePerHour(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-[#FF7A18] cursor-pointer"
                />
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/50 mt-1">
                  <span>$25k (Street)</span>
                  <span>$250k (Heists)</span>
                  <span>$500k (Syndicate)</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Input: Hours Per Day */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                  <label className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Average Gameplay Hours / Day
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#FF2E93]">
                    {hoursPerDay} hrs/day
                  </span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="0.5"
                  max="12"
                  step="0.5"
                  value={hoursPerDay}
                  onChange={(e) => setHoursPerDay(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-[#FF2E93] cursor-pointer"
                />
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/50 mt-1">
                  <span>30 min (Casual)</span>
                  <span>4 hrs (Core)</span>
                  <span>12 hrs (Hardcore)</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* GOALS MANAGEMENT BOX */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FF2E93]" />
                  <span>Target Goals ({goals.length})</span>
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                  Total: ${totalAllGoals.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Active Goals List */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {goals.map((g, idx) => {
                  const itemProgress = Math.min(100, Math.round((currentCash / g.targetPrice) * 100));
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={g.id}
                      className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                        idx === 0
                          ? 'bg-[#1E1033] border-[#FF7A18]/50 shadow-md'
                          : 'bg-white/5 border-white/5'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            {idx === 0 && (
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#FF7A18] text-[#0B0614] font-bold">
                                Focus
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <h4 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                              {g.name}
                            </h4>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mt-0.5">
                            ${g.targetPrice.toLocaleString()}
                          </p>
                        </div>

                        {goals.length > 1 && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRemoveGoal(g.id)}
                            className="p-1 rounded text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#FF2E93] hover:bg-white/5"
                            aria-label={`Remove goal ${g.name}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Mini Goal Progress Bar */}
                      <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF7A18] to-[#19E3D0]"
                            style={{ width: `${itemProgress}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                          {itemProgress}%
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Add Another Goal Form */}
              <form onSubmit={handleAddGoal} className="pt-4 border-t border-white/10 space-y-3">
                <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-white block">
                  Add Another Goal:
                </span>

                {/* Database Quick Preset Selector — shown only once verified items exist */}
                {presetOptions.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <select
                      value={selectedPreset}
                      onChange={handleSelectPreset}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] focus:border-[#FF2E93] focus:outline-none"
                    >
                      <option value="">⚡ Quick Pick from Database...</option>
                      {presetOptions.map((opt) => (
                        <option key={opt.name} value={opt.name}>
                          [{opt.type}] {opt.name} - ${opt.price.toLocaleString()}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newGoalName}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewGoalName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Custom goal title..."
                    className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-xs text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:border-[#FF2E93] focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    value={newGoalPrice}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewGoalPrice(e.target.value === '' ? '' : Number(e.target.value))}
                    placeholder="Target price ($)..."
                    className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:border-[#FF2E93] focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#FF7A18]/50 bg-[#FF7A18]/15 hover:bg-[#FF7A18]/25 text-[#FF7A18] hover:text-white font-mono text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Add Goal to Schedule</span>
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* RIGHT COLUMN: OUTPUTS & RECHARTS TIMELINE (7 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
            
            {/* KPI STAT CARDS */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/30 shadow-lg text-center">
                <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-[#FF2E93] mx-auto mb-2" />
                <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-white">
                  {hoursNeeded} hrs
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#B9A6D4] mt-1">
                  Active Playtime Needed
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF7A18]/30 shadow-lg text-center">
                <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-[#FF7A18] mx-auto mb-2" />
                <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-white">
                  {daysNeeded} days
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#B9A6D4] mt-1">
                  Calendar Days ({hoursPerDay}h/day)
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/30 shadow-lg text-center">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19E3D0] mx-auto mb-2" />
                <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-white">
                  {progressPercent}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#B9A6D4] mt-1">
                  Primary Goal Funded
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* FOCUS GOAL PROGRESS PANEL */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Current Target Target Milestone
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white">
                    {primaryGoal.name}
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">Target Price</div>
                  <div className="text-base font-mono font-bold text-[#FFC857]">
                    ${primaryGoal.targetPrice.toLocaleString()}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Progress bar */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="w-full h-3 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] via-[#FF7A18] to-[#19E3D0] transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                  <span>${currentCash.toLocaleString()} in Bank</span>
                  <span>
                    {netRequired === 0
                      ? 'Goal fully funded! Purchase ready.'
                      : `$${netRequired.toLocaleString()} remaining`}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {goals.length > 1 && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/5 text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>All {goals.length} queued goals combined:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">
                    ~{totalDaysNeeded} calendar days
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* RECHARTS SAVINGS OVER TIME */}
            <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                    <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                    <span>Projected Capital Accumulation</span>
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mt-0.5">
                    Trajectory over upcoming gaming sessions based on ${incomePerHour.toLocaleString()}/hr
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="w-full h-64 sm:h-72">
                {mounted ? (
                  <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                    <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
                    <defs>
                      <linearGradient id="cashFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                        <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#19E3D0" stopOpacity={0.4} />
                        <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#19E3D0" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                      </linearGradient>
                      <linearGradient id="targetLine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
                        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#FF2E93" />
                        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#FF7A18" />
                      </linearGradient>
                    </defs>
                    <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#2A134A" />
                    <XAxis dataKey="day" stroke="#B9A6D4" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} />
                    <YAxis
                      stroke="#B9A6D4"
                      fontSize={10}
                      tickFormatter={(val) => `$${(val / 1000).toFixed(0)}k`}
                      tickLine={false}
                    />
                    <Tooltip
                      contentStyle={{
                        backgroundColor: '#1E1033',
                        borderColor: '#FF2E93',
                        borderRadius: '12px',
                        color: '#FFF5FB',
                        fontSize: '12px',
                        fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, monospace'
                      }}
                      formatter={(val: unknown) => [
                        typeof val === 'number' ? `$${val.toLocaleString()}` : String(val),
                        'Balance'
                      ]}
                    />
                    <Area
                      type="monotone"
                      dataKey="cash"
                      stroke="#19E3D0"
                      strokeWidth={2.5}
                      fillOpacity={1}
                      fill="url(#cashFill)"
                    />
                    </AreaChart>
                  </ResponsiveContainer>
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
                    Chart loads in your browser
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70 pt-2 border-t border-white/5">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#19E3D0]" />
                  <span>Your Projected Bank</span>
                </span>
                <span>Calculated locally in browser</span>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 150+ WORDS SEO ARTICLE */}
        <section className="mb-12 p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 space-y-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
          <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white">
            Optimizing Progression & Cash Efficiency in Vice City
          </h2>
          <p>
            Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
            Until then, no in-game prices, incomes, or economy mechanics have been officially
            confirmed — so this calculator works with the numbers you enter, not with assumed
            payouts. Set a goal price, enter your current cash and your hourly income, and it
            tells you exactly how many hours and days your plan takes.
          </p>
          <p>
            For example: if your goal is $5,000,000, you hold $50,000, and you earn $125,000 per
            hour, you need 39.6 hours of play. Across 2.5-hour evening sessions that is about 16
            days. Change any number and the plan updates instantly — the math is exact for the
            inputs you choose.
          </p>
          <p>
            The multi-goal engine helps you compare priorities: stack several targets together to
            see the combined total and timeline, then decide what to save for first. When Rockstar
            confirms real prices and income figures, verified values will replace the example
            goals here.
          </p>
        </section>

        {/* FAQ ACCORDION & JSON-LD SCHEMA */}
        <FAQSection
          items={seoFaqs}
          title="Frequently Asked Questions"
          subtitle="Key answers about how the calculator works — and what is (and isn't) confirmed yet."
          badge="Economy FAQ"
          badgeColor="#FF7A18"
          className="mb-12"
          renderJsonLd={false}
        />

        {/* RELATED TOOLS */}
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white">
              Looking to benchmark your dream vehicle before buying?
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
              Compare top speed, handling, and price against competitor models.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Link
            to="/calculators/compare"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF7A18] to-[#FFC857] text-[#0B0614] font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:brightness-110 shrink-0"
          >
            <span>Open Vehicle Showdown</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Link>
        </div>

      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

## src/pages/calculators/VehicleComparison.tsx

````tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { 
  Car, 
  Trophy, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Sparkles, 
  ArrowRight, 
  Gauge, 
  Zap, 
  Sliders, 
  Coins,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Flame
} from 'lucide-react';

import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { EmailCapture } from '../../components/EmailCapture';
import { QuickAnswer } from '../../components/Article';
import { BadgeStatus } from '../../components/BadgeStatus';
import { FAQSection, FAQItem, buildFaqPageSchema } from '../../components/FAQSection';
import vehiclesData from '../../data/vehicles.json';

interface Vehicle {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  manufacturer: string;
  price: number;
  stats: {
    topSpeed: number;
    acceleration: number;
    handling: number;
    braking: number;
  };
  description: string;
  status: string;
}

export function VehicleComparison() {
  // VERIFIED vehicles only — the data file holds a schema template, not real items.
  const realVehicles = useMemo(() => vehiclesData.filter((v) => v.status === 'confirmed'), []);

  // Select up to 4 vehicles for comparison (empty until launch: no vehicles verified yet).
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const selectedVehicles = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedIds
      .map((id) => realVehicles.find((v) => v.id === id))
      .filter((v) => v !== undefined);
  }, [selectedIds, realVehicles]);

  const handleAddVehicle = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedIds.includes(id)) return;
    if (selectedIds.length >= 4) return;
    setSelectedIds([...selectedIds, id]);
  };

  const handleRemoveVehicle = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedIds.length <= 2) return;
    setSelectedIds(selectedIds.filter((item) => item !== id));
  };

  // Compute category winners
  const winners = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedVehicles.length === 0) return {};

    const maxSpeed = Math.max(...selectedVehicles.map((v) => v.stats.topSpeed));
    const maxAccel = Math.max(...selectedVehicles.map((v) => v.stats.acceleration));
    const maxHandling = Math.max(...selectedVehicles.map((v) => v.stats.handling));
    const maxBraking = Math.max(...selectedVehicles.map((v) => v.stats.braking));
    const minPrice = Math.min(...selectedVehicles.map((v) => v.price));

    return {
      topSpeed: selectedVehicles.filter((v) => v.stats.topSpeed === maxSpeed).map((v) => v.id),
      acceleration: selectedVehicles.filter((v) => v.stats.acceleration === maxAccel).map((v) => v.id),
      handling: selectedVehicles.filter((v) => v.stats.handling === maxHandling).map((v) => v.id),
      braking: selectedVehicles.filter((v) => v.stats.braking === maxBraking).map((v) => v.id),
      bestValue: selectedVehicles.filter((v) => v.price === minPrice).map((v) => v.id),
    };
  }, [selectedVehicles]);

  const seoFaqs: FAQItem[] = [
    {
      id: 'faq-veh-1',
      question: 'Which GTA 6 vehicle has the highest top speed?',
      answer: 'Not officially confirmed. No GTA 6 vehicle has been given an official top-speed figure yet. This page will list verified stats once Rockstar publishes them, at or after launch on November 19, 2026.',
      status: 'unconfirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-veh-2',
      question: 'Does higher price guarantee better handling performance in GTA 6?',
      answer: 'No official data exists to say either way yet — no prices or handling figures are confirmed. The comparison tool will work with verified stats once they exist.',
      status: 'unconfirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-veh-3',
      question: 'How are the vehicle stat bars calculated?',
      answer: 'The tool shows official stats on a 0–100 scale once they are confirmed. No official stat figures exist yet, so there is nothing to score.',
      status: 'unconfirmed'
    },
    {
      id: 'faq-veh-4',
      question: 'Can I compare different classes of vehicles against each other?',
      answer: 'Yes! Once verified vehicles exist, the Showdown tool allows cross-category comparison, letting you benchmark different classes side by side.',
      status: 'confirmed'
    }
  ];

  const appSchema = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'SoftwareApplication',
    name: 'Vice Tools Vehicle Showdown Tool',
    applicationCategory: 'GameApplication',
    operatingSystem: 'All',
    offers: {
      '@type': 'Offer',
      price: '0',
      priceCurrency: 'USD'
    },
    description: 'Head-to-head performance comparator and telemetry analysis tool for Grand Theft Auto VI vehicles.'
  };

  const faqSchema = buildFaqPageSchema(seoFaqs);

  // Coming soon: no verified vehicles exist yet, so there is nothing to
  // compare. Show the honest state instead of an empty showdown.
  if (realVehicles.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        <SEO
          title="GTA 6 Vehicle Showdown & Comparison Tool | Coming at Launch"
          description="Compare GTA 6 vehicles side by side. Verified vehicle stats arrive at launch, November 19, 2026."
          canonical="/calculators/compare"
        />
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
          <Breadcrumbs pathname="/calculators/compare" />
          <div className="mt-6 text-center">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mb-3">
              <Car className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>COMING AT LAUNCH</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
              Vehicle <span className="text-[#19E3D0]">Showdown</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <QuickAnswer>
            No GTA 6 vehicle has been officially confirmed with stats, a price, or a name yet, so
            there is nothing to compare. The showdown goes live at launch with verified vehicles —
            top speed, acceleration, handling, braking, and price, side by side.
          </QuickAnswer>
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto mb-8">
            <EmailCapture title="Get notified when verified vehicles are added" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <Link to="/calculators" className="text-sm text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline">
              ← Back to all calculators
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Vehicle Showdown & Comparison Tool | Specs, Speed & Handling"
        description="Compare up to 4 GTA 6 supercars, classic muscle cars, and off-road trucks side by side. Benchmark top speed, acceleration, handling, and price."
        canonical="/calculators/compare"
        schema={[appSchema, faqSchema]}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        {/* Breadcrumb */}
        <nav className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mb-6">
          <Link to="/" className="hover:text-white">Home</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <Link to="/calculators" className="hover:text-white">Calculators</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <span className="text-[#19E3D0]">Vehicle Showdown</span>
        </nav>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mb-3">
            <Car className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>TELEMETRY HEAD-TO-HEAD</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Vehicle <span className="text-[#19E3D0]">Showdown</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            Vehicle comparison is coming at launch. No vehicle stats are officially confirmed yet
            — this tool will compare up to 4 verified vehicles side by side once they exist.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Ad slot */}

        {/* VEHICLE SELECTOR ROW */}
        <div className="mb-8 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]">
            Comparing <strong className="text-white">{selectedVehicles.length}</strong> of 4 slots:
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {realVehicles.map((veh) => {
              const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(veh.id);
              return (
                <button
                  key={veh.id}
                  disabled={isSelected || selectedIds.length >= 4}
                  onClick={() => handleAddVehicle(veh.id)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-[#19E3D0]/20 text-[#19E3D0] border border-[#19E3D0]/40'
                      : selectedIds.length >= 4
                      ? 'bg-white/5 text-[#B9A6D4]/30 border border-transparent cursor-not-allowed'
                      : 'bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white border border-white/5'
                  }`}
                >
                  {veh.name}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SIDE-BY-SIDE COMPARISON CARDS GRID */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-12">
          {selectedVehicles.map((veh) => {
            const isSpeedWinner = winners.topSpeed?.includes(veh.id);
            const isAccelWinner = winners.acceleration?.includes(veh.id);
            const isHandlingWinner = winners.handling?.includes(veh.id);
            const isValueWinner = winners.bestValue?.includes(veh.id);

            return (
              <div
                key={veh.id}
                className="relative rounded-3xl p-6 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 shadow-xl flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                {/* Top remove button if > 2 */}
                {selectedVehicles.length > 2 && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleRemoveVehicle(veh.id)}
                    className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#FF2E93] hover:bg-white/5"
                    aria-label={`Remove ${veh.name}`}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                )}

                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 text-white font-bold">
                      {veh.manufacturer}
                    </span>
                    <BadgeStatus status={veh.status} size="sm" />
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white mb-1">
                    {veh.name}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mb-4">
                    {veh.category}
                  </div>

                  {/* Price Banner */}
                  <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl mb-6 text-center border font-mono ${
                    isValueWinner 
                      ? 'bg-[#FFC857]/15 border-[#FFC857]/50 text-[#FFC857]' 
                      : 'bg-black/30 border-white/5 text-white'
                  }`}>
                    <div className="text-[10px] uppercase text-[#B9A6D4]">Acquisition Price</div>
                    <div className="text-xl font-bold mt-0.5">${veh.price.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    {isValueWinner && (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[#FFC857] flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mt-1 font-bold">
                        <Trophy className="w-3 h-3" />
                        <span>Best Value Pick</span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* TELEMETRY STATS BARS */}
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    
                    {/* Top Speed */}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono mb-1">
                        <span className="text-[#B9A6D4] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Gauge className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF2E93]" />
                          <span>Top Speed</span>
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-white">
                          <span>{veh.stats.topSpeed}</span>
                          {isSpeedWinner && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#FF2E93] uppercase font-mono px-1 rounded bg-[#FF2E93]/20">
                              FASTEST
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18]"
                          style={{ width: `${veh.stats.topSpeed}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Acceleration */}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono mb-1">
                        <span className="text-[#B9A6D4] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF7A18]" />
                          <span>Acceleration</span>
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-white">
                          <span>{veh.stats.acceleration}</span>
                          {isAccelWinner && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#FF7A18] uppercase font-mono px-1 rounded bg-[#FF7A18]/20">
                              QUICKEST
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF7A18] to-[#FFC857]"
                          style={{ width: `${veh.stats.acceleration}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Handling */}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono mb-1">
                        <span className="text-[#B9A6D4] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                          <span>Handling</span>
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-white">
                          <span>{veh.stats.handling}</span>
                          {isHandlingWinner && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#19E3D0] uppercase font-mono px-1 rounded bg-[#19E3D0]/20">
                              MOST AGILE
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#19E3D0] to-[#38BDF8]"
                          style={{ width: `${veh.stats.handling}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Braking */}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono mb-1">
                        <span className="text-[#B9A6D4]">Braking Distance</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-white">{veh.stats.braking}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full bg-white/40"
                          style={{ width: `${veh.stats.braking}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Detail Link */}
                <div className="mt-8 pt-4 border-t border-white/10">
                  <Link
                    to={`/database/vehicles/${veh.slug}`}
                    className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-[#19E3D0]/20 hover:border-[#19E3D0]/50 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono text-white transition-all"
                  >
                    <span>View Full Specs</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Ad slot */}

        {/* 150+ WORDS SEO TEXT */}
        <section className="mb-12 p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 space-y-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
          <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white">
            Vehicle Telemetry & Getaway Dynamics in Leonida
          </h2>
          <p>
            No GTA 6 vehicle has been officially confirmed with a top speed, acceleration, handling,
            or price yet. When the game launches on November 19, 2026, this tool will compare up to
            4 verified vehicles side by side — straight-line speed, acceleration, cornering, and
            braking — with the best in each category highlighted.
          </p>
          <p>
            Until then, the honest answer is that there is nothing to compare. Any site showing
            GTA 6 vehicle stat bars today is inventing them. We publish stats only with a source
            and a last-verified date, so what you see here at launch will be real.
          </p>
          <p>
            Our comparison highlights best-in-class category winners so you can judge value for
            money once verified prices exist — whether a high-priced flagship justifies itself
            against a cheaper alternative for your getaway needs.
          </p>
        </section>

        {/* FAQ ACCORDION & SCHEMA.ORG JSON-LD */}
        <FAQSection
          items={seoFaqs}
          title="Frequently Asked Questions"
          subtitle="How the showdown tool works — and what is confirmed so far."
          badge="Showdown FAQ"
          badgeColor="#19E3D0"
          className="mb-12"
          renderJsonLd={false}
        />

        {/* RELATED TOOL */}
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white">
              Ready to browse our complete automotive catalog?
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]">
              Browse the vehicle database — coming at launch with verified entries.

          >
            <span>Open Vehicle Database</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />

  );
}
````
