## src/pages/compare/ComparePage.tsx

````tsx
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Scale, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { QuickAnswer, FactsTable, SourcesBox, AuthorBox, RelatedPages } from '../../components/Article';
import { FAQSection } from '../../components/FAQSection';
import { articleSchema } from '../../lib/schema';
import { getAuthorName, SITE_CONFIG } from '../../config/site';
import comparisonsData from '../../data/comparisons.json';

/** A facts-table row in comparisons.json (source fields optional: the
 * "unconfirmed" rows record an absence, which has no source to link). */
interface ComparisonFact {
  fact: string;
  status: 'confirmed' | 'reported' | 'unconfirmed' | 'template';
  source_url?: string;
  source_name?: string;
}

/**
 * Data-driven comparison page (GTA 6 vs GTA 5, vs RDR2, PS5 vs Xbox).
 * Verified facts only. Content comes from src/data/comparisons.json:
 * seoTitle / h1 / description / aLabel / bLabel / intro / sections /
 * rows / facts / faq. The /calculators/compare tool page is a different
 * route and is untouched by this component.
 */
export function ComparePage() {
  const { slug } = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const comparison = comparisonsData.comparisons.find((c) => c.slug === slug);

  if (!comparison) {
    return (
      <>
        <SEO title="Comparison not found" description="This comparison does not exist." canonical="/compare/gta-6-vs-gta-5" noindex />
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-20 text-center">
          <Scale className="w-16 h-16 text-[#FF2E93]/40 mx-auto mb-4" />
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-2xl text-white">Comparison not found</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2 mb-6">
            This comparison does not exist yet.
          </p>
          <Link to="/compare/gta-6-vs-gta-5" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> GTA 6 vs GTA 5
          </Link>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  const canonical = `/compare/${comparison.slug}`;

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title={comparison.seoTitle}
        description={comparison.description}
        canonical={canonical}
        type="article"
        articlePublished={comparison.last_verified}
        articleModified={comparison.last_verified}
        ogImage="https://vicetools.app/og-banner.png"
        schema={articleSchema({
          headline: comparison.h1,
          description: comparison.description,
          datePublished: comparison.last_verified,
          dateModified: comparison.last_verified,
          authorName: getAuthorName(),
          url: `${SITE_CONFIG.url}${canonical}`,
        })}
      />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname={canonical} />

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF2E93] mb-3">
            <Scale className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>VERIFIED COMPARISON</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white leading-tight">
            {comparison.h1}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] font-mono mt-2">Last updated: November 5, 2026</p>
        </div>

        <QuickAnswer>{comparison.intro}</QuickAnswer>

        {/* Comparison table */}
        <div className="my-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-white/10">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-[#150A24] text-left text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#B9A6D4]">
                <th className="px-4 py-3">{comparison.aLabel}</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">{comparison.bLabel}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {comparison.rows.map((row, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="border-t border-white/5 align-top">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-[#B9A6D4]/60 mb-1">{row.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-white/90">{row.a}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-[#B9A6D4]/60 mb-1">{row.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-white/90">{row.b}</div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Depth sections */}
        {comparison.sections.map((section) => (
          <section key={section.heading}>
            <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl text-white mt-10 mb-3">
              {section.heading}
            </h2>
            <div className="space-y-4 my-6 text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
              {section.paragraphs.map((paragraph, i) => (
                <p key={i}>{paragraph}</p>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        ))}

        <FactsTable
          rows={(comparison.facts as ComparisonFact[]).map((f) => ({
            fact: f.fact,
            status: f.status,
            sourceUrl: f.source_url,
            sourceName: f.source_name,
          }))}
        />

        <FAQSection items={comparison.faq} title="Questions" subtitle="" badge="" badgeColor="#FFC857" />

        <SourcesBox
          sources={[{ name: comparison.source_name, url: comparison.source_url }]}
          lastVerified={comparison.last_verified}
        />

        <AuthorBox />

        <RelatedPages
          pages={[
            { name: 'GTA 6 vs GTA 5', path: '/compare/gta-6-vs-gta-5' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 vs Red Dead Redemption 2', path: '/compare/gta-6-vs-red-dead-redemption-2' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 on PS5 vs Xbox Series X', path: '/compare/gta-6-ps5-vs-xbox-series-x' },
            { name: 'Release time by region', path: '/gta-6-release-time' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

````

````tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Database, Car, Shield, Building, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { EmailCapture } from '../../components/EmailCapture';
import { QuickAnswer } from '../../components/Article';
import { itemListSchema } from '../../lib/schema';

import vehiclesData from '../../data/vehicles.json';
import weaponsData from '../../data/weapons.json';
import propertiesData from '../../data/properties.json';

const realCount = (data: { status: string }[]) => data.filter((e) => e.status === 'confirmed').length;

export function DatabaseHub() {
  const sections = [
    {
      title: 'Vehicle Database',
      description: 'The full GTA 6 vehicle roster with verified top speeds, prices, and classes — once Rockstar publishes them.',
      count: realCount(vehiclesData),
      path: '/database/vehicles',
      icon: Car,
      color: '#FF7A18',
    },
    {
      title: 'Weapons Database',
      description: 'Verified weapon stats — damage, fire rate, range, and magazine size — once they are officially confirmed.',
      count: realCount(weaponsData),
      path: '/database/weapons',
      icon: Shield,
      color: '#FF2E93',
    },
    {
      title: 'Properties Database',
      description: 'Verified properties, safehouses, and businesses with prices and locations — once they are officially confirmed.',
      count: realCount(propertiesData),
      path: '/database/properties',
      icon: Building,
      color: '#19E3D0',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Database | Vehicles, Weapons & Properties"
        description="The VICE TOOLS database for Grand Theft Auto VI. Verified vehicle, weapon, and property entries are added only after they are officially confirmed — coming at launch."
        canonical="/database"
        schema={itemListSchema('GTA 6 Database', [
          { name: 'Vehicle Database', path: '/database/vehicles' },
          { name: 'Weapon Database', path: '/database/weapons' },
          { name: 'Property Database', path: '/database/properties' },
        ])}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/database" />

        <div className="mt-6 mb-10 text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF2E93] mb-3">
            <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>WHAT WE KNOW / COMING AT LAUNCH</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            GTA 6 <span className="gradient-sunset-text">Database</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4]">
            Vehicles, weapons, and properties — listed only when they are verified. Nothing here is
            guessed, leaked, or invented.
          </p>
        </div>

        <QuickAnswer>
          No vehicle, weapon, or property in GTA 6 has been officially confirmed with stats yet.
          This database stays empty until launch, when entries are added with a source link and a
          last-verified date. The game launches November 19, 2026.
        </QuickAnswer>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-12">
          {sections.map((section) => (
            <Link
              key={section.title}
              to={section.path}
              className="group rounded-2xl p-6 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 hover:border-[#FF2E93] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <section.icon className="w-6 h-6" style={{ color: section.color }} />
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-current/30 text-[#FFC857]">
                  {section.count === 0 ? 'Coming at launch' : `${section.count} verified`}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-lg text-white group-hover:text-[#FF7A18] transition-colors mb-2">
                {section.title}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed mb-4">
                {section.description}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-medium text-[#19E3D0] group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform">
                <span>Open database</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto mb-12">
          <EmailCapture title="Get notified when verified entries go live" />
        </div>

        <div className="text-center text-xs text-[#B9A6D4]/70 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          <p>
            How we verify: an entry is added only with a Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, or Xbox
            source — a trailer, the official site, or a store listing — plus a last-verified date.
            Leaked lists and datamined files are never published here.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

````

````tsx
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';

/**

 * from the sitemap until a real entry exists (see src/lib/routes.ts).
 */
export function PropertyDetail() {
  const { slug } = useParams<{ slug: string }>();

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Property | Coming at Launch"
        description="This GTA 6 property has not been officially confirmed yet. The property database goes live at launch, November 19, 2026."
        canonical={`/database/properties/${slug ?? ''}`}
        noindex

            Rockstar publishes verified details, at or after launch on November 19, 2026.

            Back to the property database
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
      </div>

}
````

````tsx
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Shield, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { EmailCapture } from '../../components/EmailCapture';
import { QuickAnswer } from '../../components/Article';

/**
 * Weapon detail page. With no verified weapon data, every slug renders
 * this honest "coming at launch" state. The page is noindex and excluded
 * from the sitemap until a real entry exists (see src/lib/routes.ts).
 */
export function WeaponDetail() {
  const { slug } = useParams<{ slug: string }>();

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Weapon | Coming at Launch"
        description="This GTA 6 weapon has not been officially confirmed yet. The weapon database goes live at launch, November 19, 2026."
        canonical={`/database/weapons/${slug ?? ''}`}
        noindex
      />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/database/weapons" />

        <div className="mt-6 text-center">
          <Shield className="w-16 h-16 text-[#FF2E93]/40 mx-auto mb-4" />
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Weapon coming at launch
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-3 max-w-xl mx-auto">
            No weapon has been officially confirmed with stats, a price, or a name yet — so there
            is nothing to show for this entry. The weapon database goes live once Rockstar
            publishes verified details, at or after launch on November 19, 2026.
          </p>
        </div>

        <QuickAnswer>
          This page exists so the weapon database has a stable address for every entry. Until a
          weapon is confirmed with a source, it stays in this &ldquo;coming at launch&rdquo;
          state and out of search results.
        </QuickAnswer>

        <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto mb-8">
          <EmailCapture title="Get notified when verified weapons are added" />
        </div>

        <div className="text-center">
          <Link
            to="/database/weapons"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            Back to the weapon database
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
          articleSchema({

        </div>

        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-6 font-light">
          Every question people actually ask about Grand Theft Auto VI, answered in one or two
          sentences, with a link to the full page for the detail and the source. Confirmed
          facts come from Rockstar, PlayStation, and Xbox; reported claims are labelled as
          reported; and anything without a source is not answered here at all. Use the links
          below to jump to a question, or read straight through.
        </p>

        <nav aria-label="FAQ contents" className="my-6 p-5 rounded-xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10">
          <p className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white mb-3">Jump to a question</p>
          <ul className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-1.5 text-sm">
            {HUB_FAQS.map((f) => (
              <li key={f.id}>
                <a href={`#${f.id}`} className="text-[#19E3D0] hover:text-white underline">
                  {f.question}
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </nav>

        {GROUPS.map((group) => (
          <section key={group.title} className="mt-10">
            <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mb-4">
              {group.title}
            </h2>
            {group.ids.map((id) => {
              const f = byId.get(id);
              if (!f) return null;
              return (
                <article key={f.id} id={f.id} className="scroll-mt-24 border-b border-white/5 py-5">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg text-white">{f.question}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed mt-2 font-light">
                    {f.answer}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-2">
                    <Link to={f.link} className="text-sm text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">
                      {f.linkLabel} →
                    </Link>
                  </p>
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </section>
        ))}

        {/* FAQPage JSON-LD is emitted once, via the SEO schema prop above —
            not also via FaqJsonLd, which would duplicate the block. */}

        <SourcesBox
          sources={[
            { name: 'Rockstar Games — official GTA VI page', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/VI' },
            { name: 'Rockstar Games Newswire — launch date', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026' },
            { name: 'VICE TOOLS — Methodology', url: 'https://vicetools.app/about/methodology' },
          ]}
          lastVerified="2026-11-05"
        />

        <AuthorBox />

        <RelatedPages
          pages={[
            { name: 'GTA 6 release date', path: '/gta-6-release-date' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 map', path: '/gta-6-map' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 trailers', path: '/gta-6-trailers' },
            { name: 'Methodology & editorial policy', path: '/about/methodology' },
            { name: 'Leaks vs confirmed', path: '/gta-6-leaks-vs-confirmed' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 price', path: '/gta-6-price' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { BookOpen, Clock, Calendar, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Bookmark, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { BadgeStatus } from '../../components/BadgeStatus';
import { SourcesBox } from '../../components/Article';
import { getAuthorName } from '../../config/site';
import guidesData from '../../data/guides.json';

export function GuideDetail() {
  const { slug } = useParams<{ slug: string }>();

  const guide = guidesData.find((g) => g.slug === slug);

  if (!guide) {
    return (
      <>
        <SEO title="Guide not found" description="This guide does not exist." canonical="/guides" noindex />
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-20 text-center">
          <BookOpen className="w-16 h-16 text-[#FF7A18]/40 mx-auto mb-4" />
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-2xl text-white">Guide Not Found</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2 mb-6">
            The requested article could not be retrieved from the editorial archives.
          </p>
          <Link
            to="/guides"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#FF7A18] text-[#0B0614] font-mono font-bold text-xs"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Return to Guides Hub</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  const authorName = getAuthorName();

  const relatedGuides = guidesData.filter((g) => g.slug !== guide.slug).slice(0, 2);

  const articleSchema = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Article',
    headline: guide.title,
    description: guide.excerpt,
    datePublished: guide.lastUpdated,
    dateModified: guide.lastUpdated,
    author: {
      '@type': 'Person',
      name: authorName,
      jobTitle: 'VICE TOOLS team',
    },
    publisher: {
      '@type': 'Organization',
      name: 'Vice Tools',
      logo: {
        '@type': 'ImageObject',
        url: 'https://vicetools.app/favicon.svg',
      },
    },
  };

  // Render markdown content sections. A "### " block's first paragraph can
  // sit in the same \n\n block as the heading, so split the heading line
  // from the paragraph that follows it — otherwise the paragraph lands
  // inside the <h2> and the anchor id becomes a giant slug.
  const renderFormattedContent = (rawText: string) => {
    const paragraphs = rawText.split('\n\n');
    return paragraphs.map((block, idx) => {
      if (block.startsWith('### ')) {
        const lines = block.split('\n');
        const title = lines[0].replace('### ', '');
        const id = title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
        const rest = lines.slice(1).join('\n').trim();
        return (
          <div key={idx}>
            <h2
              id={id}
              className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4 pt-6 border-t border-white/5 scroll-mt-24 flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#FF7A18]" />
              <span>{title}</span>
            </h2>
            {rest && (
              <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
                {rest}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (block.startsWith('1. ') || block.startsWith('- ')) {
        const lines = block.split('\n');
        return (
          <ul key={idx} className="space-y-2 my-4 pl-4 font-normal text-[#B9A6D4] text-sm leading-relaxed">
            {lines.map((l, lIdx) => (
              <li key={lIdx} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span>{l.replace(/^[0-9]+\.\s+/, '').replace(/^-\s+/, '')}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        );
      }

      return (
        <p key={idx} className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          {block}
        </p>
      );
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title={`${guide.title} | Vice Tools`}
        description={guide.excerpt}
        canonical={`/guides/${guide.slug}`}
        type="article"
        articlePublished={guide.lastUpdated}
        articleModified={guide.lastUpdated}
        schema={articleSchema}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname={`/guides/${guide.slug}`} />

        {/* ARTICLE HEADER */}
        <header className="max-w-4xl mx-auto mb-10 mt-6 text-center sm:text-left">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-3 mb-4 text-xs font-mono">
            <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#FF7A18]/10 text-[#FF7A18] border border-[#FF7A18]/30 font-bold uppercase">
              {guide.category}
            </span>
            <BadgeStatus status={guide.status} size="md" />
            <span className="text-[#B9A6D4] flex items-center gap-1">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Updated {guide.lastUpdated}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[#19E3D0] flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{guide.readingTime}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-5xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight leading-tight">
            {guide.title}
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-4 text-base sm:text-lg text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            {guide.excerpt}
          </p>

          {/* Author Byline */}
          <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FF2E93] to-[#FF7A18] flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold font-mono">
              {authorName.charAt(0)}
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{authorName}</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70">VICE TOOLS team</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* TWO-COLUMN ARTICLE BODY & TABLE OF CONTENTS */}
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 mb-12">

          {/* MAIN ARTICLE TEXT (8 cols) */}
          <article className="lg:col-span-8">
            <div className="p-8 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 shadow-xl">
              {renderFormattedContent(guide.content)}
            </div>

            <SourcesBox
              sources={[{ name: guide.source_name, url: guide.source_url }]}
              lastVerified={guide.last_verified}
            />
          </article>

          {/* SIDEBAR: TABLE OF CONTENTS & RELATED (4 cols) */}
          <aside className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-6">

            {/* Table of Contents */}
            <div className="sticky top-24 p-6 rounded-3xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 shadow-xl space-y-4">
              <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-sm text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                <Bookmark className="w-4 h-4 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                <span>Table of Contents</span>
              </h3>

              <nav className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
                {guide.headings.map((h) => (
                  <a
                    key={h.id}
                    href={`#${h.id}`}
                    className="block p-2 rounded-lg text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-[#19E3D0] hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
                  >
                    {h.text}
                  </a>
                ))}
              </nav>
            </div>

          </aside>
        </div>

        {/* RELATED GUIDES */}
        <section className="max-w-4xl mx-auto pt-8 border-t border-white/10 mb-12">
          <h3 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl text-white mb-6 uppercase">
            Recommended Next Reads
          </h3>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {relatedGuides.map((rel) => (
              <Link
                key={rel.slug}
                to={`/guides/${rel.slug}`}
                className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 hover:border-[#FF7A18] transition-all group flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#FF7A18] uppercase">
                    {rel.category} • {rel.readingTime}
                  </span>
                  <h4 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-base text-white group-hover:text-[#FF7A18] transition-colors mt-1">
                    {rel.title}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2 line-clamp-2">
                    {rel.excerpt}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0]">
                  <span>Open Article</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>

      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { BookOpen, Search, Clock, ArrowRight, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { BadgeStatus } from '../../components/BadgeStatus';
import { getAuthorName } from '../../config/site';
import { itemListSchema } from '../../lib/schema';
import guidesData from '../../data/guides.json';

export function GuidesPage() {
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('All');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const categories = useMemo(
    () => ['All', ...Array.from(new Set(guidesData.map((g) => g.category)))],
    [],
  );

  const filteredGuides = useMemo(() => {
    return guidesData.filter((g) => {
      if (selectedCategory !== 'All' && g.category !== selectedCategory) return false;
      if (search.trim()) {
        const q = search.toLowerCase();
        const matchTitle = g.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchExcerpt = g.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matchTitle && !matchExcerpt) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [selectedCategory, search]);

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Guides | Release Date, Preload & PC"
        description="Guides for Grand Theft Auto VI: release date and platforms, install size and pre-load, and what is known about a PC release. Every fact sourced."
        canonical="/guides"
        schema={itemListSchema(
          'GTA 6 Guides',
          guidesData.map((g) => ({ name: g.title, path: `/guides/${g.slug}` })),
        )}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/guides" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl mb-8 mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF7A18]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF7A18] mb-3">
            <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>LEONIDA FIELD MANUALS</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
            Guides & <span className="text-[#FF7A18]">Walkthroughs</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            Sourced guides on the release date, platforms, install size and pre-load, and the PC
            question — every fact linked to its source, and clearly labelled where things are not
            confirmed yet.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* CATEGORY TABS & SEARCH */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            {categories.map((cat) => (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedCategory === cat
                    ? 'bg-[#FF7A18] text-[#0B0614] font-bold shadow-md shadow-[#FF7A18]/20'
                    : 'bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#B9A6D4] hover:text-white border border-white/5'
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#B9A6D4] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search guides..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#150A24] border border-white/10 text-xs text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:border-[#FF7A18] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* GUIDES BLOG LIST */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 mb-12">
          {filteredGuides.map((guide) => (
            <article
              key={guide.slug}
              className="rounded-3xl p-7 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1033] to-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/20 hover:border-[#FF7A18] transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-[#FF7A18]/20 flex flex-col justify-between group"
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 text-xs font-mono">
                  <span className="text-[#FF7A18] font-semibold uppercase">
                    {guide.category}
                  </span>
                  <BadgeStatus status={guide.status} size="sm" />
                </div>

                <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl text-white group-hover:text-[#FF7A18] transition-colors mb-3 leading-snug">
                  {guide.title}
                </h2>

                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed mb-6">
                  {guide.excerpt}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                {/* Meta details */}
                <div className="pt-4 border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#B9A6D4]/70 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FF2E93]" />
                    <span>{getAuthorName()}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#19E3D0]" />
                    <span>{guide.readingTime}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Link
                  to={`/guides/${guide.slug}`}
                  className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-[#FF7A18] text-white hover:text-[#0B0614] font-mono text-xs font-bold transition-all min-h-[44px]"
                >
                  <span>Read Full Guide</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>
    </>
  );
}

````

## src/pages/news/NewsPostPage.tsx

````tsx
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Newspaper, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { QuickAnswer, SourcesBox, AuthorBox, RelatedPages } from '../../components/Article';
import { articleSchema } from '../../lib/schema';
import { SITE_CONFIG } from '../../config/site';
import newsData from '../../data/news.json';

/** One news post. Article JSON-LD with dateModified; body is short factual prose. */
export function NewsPostPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams<{ slug: string }>();
  const post = newsData.posts.find((p) => p.slug === slug);

  if (!post) {
    return (
      <>
        <SEO title="News post not found" description="This news post does not exist." canonical="/news" noindex />
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-20 text-center">
          <Newspaper className="w-16 h-16 text-[#FF2E93]/40 mx-auto mb-4" />
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-2xl text-white">News post not found</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#B9A6D4] mt-2 mb-6">
            This news post does not exist or has been removed.
          </p>
          <Link to="/news" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back to all news
          </Link>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  const schema = articleSchema({
    headline: post.title,
    description: post.excerpt,
    url: `${SITE_CONFIG.url}/news/${post.slug}`,
    datePublished: post.date,
    dateModified: post.dateModified,
    authorName: 'VICE TOOLS team',
  });

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title={post.title}
        description={post.excerpt}
        canonical={`/news/${post.slug}`}
        type="article"
        articlePublished={post.date}
        articleModified={post.dateModified}
        schema={schema}
      />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/news" />

        <article className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#FF2E93]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#FF2E93] mb-3">
            <Newspaper className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{post.date}</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white leading-tight">
            {post.title}
          </h1>

          <QuickAnswer>{post.excerpt}</QuickAnswer>

          <div className="space-y-4 text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed">
            {post.body.split('\n\n').map((para, i) => (
              <p key={i}>{para}</p>
            ))}
          </div>

          <SourcesBox
            sources={[{ name: post.source_name, url: post.source_url }]}
            lastVerified={post.last_verified}
          />

          <AuthorBox />

          <RelatedPages
            pages={[
              { name: 'All GTA 6 news', path: '/news' },
              { name: 'Release time by region', path: '/gta-6-release-time' },
              { name: 'Guides', path: '/guides' },
            ]}
          />

          <div className="text-center mt-8">
            <Link to="/news" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#19E3D0] hover:underline">
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back to all news
            </Link>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

/**
 * GTA 6 countdown page. The live timer counts down to local midnight on
 * November 19, 2026 — the unlock time in the visitor's own time zone.
 * The static fallback text is identical on server and first client render.
 */
export function CountdownPage() {
  const description =
    'How many days left until GTA 6? Live countdown to the November 19, 2026 launch at midnight local time, plus pre-load date and unlock times.';
  const url = `${SITE_CONFIG.url}/gta-6-countdown`;

    },
    {
      question: 'What time does the countdown end?',
      answer: 'The countdown ends at midnight local time on November 19, 2026 — the moment GTA 6 unlocks in your time zone, on both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no single global unlock instant.',
    },
    {
      question: 'When does GTA 6 pre-load start?',
      answer: 'Pre-loading begins November 10, 2026 — on PlayStation 5 at midnight local time, and on Xbox Series X|S at 12:00 AM GMT. The pre-load file is up to 212 GB. The game itself still unlocks at midnight local time on November 19.',
    },
    {
      question: 'Does the countdown count to the pre-load or the launch?',
      answer: 'To the launch. Pre-loading starts nine days earlier, on November 10, 2026, but you cannot play until the game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19. See our pre-load guide for the exact start times.',
    },
    {
      question: 'Can I play GTA 6 early when the countdown hits zero in another country?',
      answer: 'No. The unlock is tied to midnight in your own time zone, not to the earliest time zone in the world. A countdown hitting zero in New Zealand does not unlock the game for players in the Americas.',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="GTA 6 Countdown — Days Left Until Nov 19"
        description={description}
        canonical="/gta-6-countdown"
        type="article"
        articlePublished="2026-11-05"
        articleModified="2026-11-05"
        ogImage="https://vicetools.app/og-release.png"
        schema={articleSchema({
          headline: 'GTA 6 Countdown — Days Left Until November 19, 2026',
          description,
          datePublished: '2026-11-05',
          dateModified: '2026-11-05',
          authorName: getAuthorName(),
          url,
        })}
      />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/gta-6-countdown" />

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mb-3">
            <Timer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>LIVE COUNTDOWN</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white leading-tight">
            GTA 6 Countdown
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] mt-3">Last updated: November 5, 2026</p>
        </div>

        <QuickAnswer>
          Grand Theft Auto VI launches on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and this countdown
          runs to midnight local time on launch day in your time zone. As of November 5,
          2026, there are 14 days left. Pre-loading starts nine days earlier, on November 10.
        </QuickAnswer>

        <CountdownTimer />

        <FactsTable
          rows={[
            {
              fact: 'GTA 6 launches Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire',
            },
            {
              fact: 'The game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://support.rockstargames.com/',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Support',
            },
            {
              fact: 'Pre-load begins November 10, 2026 — PS5 at midnight local time, Xbox at 12:00 AM GMT',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire (Nov 3, 2026)',
            },
            {
              fact: 'A single global unlock hour for all regions',
              status: 'unconfirmed',
            },
          ]}
        />

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What this countdown is counting to
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          The timer above counts down to <strong className="text-white">midnight local time on
          Thursday, November 19, 2026</strong> — the moment Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks in your
          time zone. Rockstar has said the game unlocks at local midnight in all regions, on both
          PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, so there is no single worldwide instant to count
          down to. Your countdown is yours: it ends when November 19 begins where you live.
          That is why the same page shows a different number of hours left for a player in
          Pakistan than for a player in California — both are correct, because both unlock at
          their own local midnight.
        </p>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          As of November 5, 2026, there are 14 days left. The countdown keeps ticking in days,
          hours, minutes, and seconds, and once it reaches zero it switches to a launch message.
          If you are reading this page after November 19, the game is out — the timer will say
          so, and the <Link to="/status" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">server status page</Link> will
          have taken over from the countdown as the place to check.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          The pre-load comes first
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          You do not have to wait for the countdown to end before downloading the game.
          Pre-loading begins on <strong className="text-white">November 10, 2026</strong> — nine
          days before launch. On PlayStation 5 it starts at midnight local time; on Xbox Series
          X|S it starts at 12:00 AM GMT, a single global instant. The pre-load file is up to
          212 GB depending on the device, so the practical countdown is really the one to
          November 10: free up at least 212 GB before then, and the launch-day wait disappears.
          Boxed Standard Edition copies, which contain a download code rather than a disc,
          reach shops from November 12 and can be pre-loaded from then. Our{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-preload" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">pre-load guide</Link> has
          the start times and the checklist.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What happens when the countdown hits zero
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          At midnight local time on November 19, the pre-loaded game unlocks and you can play.
          Nothing else is needed at that moment — no extra download is announced, and no
          separate launch patch has been confirmed. If you did not pre-load, the download starts
          at midnight instead, and the 212 GB file will take as long as your connection needs.
          Pre-ordering does not move the unlock earlier: there is no early access period, and
          no edition of the game unlocks before midnight local time. The US PlayStation Store
          lists the release as 12:00 AM ET on November 19; Xbox has not published its own
          unlock time, so Xbox players should watch for the midnight unlock in their own time
          zone rather than assuming PlayStation&rsquo;s time applies.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Why countdowns disagree with each other
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          If you have seen a different countdown showing a different number, it is almost
          certainly counting to a different instant — usually midnight in one fixed time zone,
          such as US Eastern or GMT, applied to everyone. That is not how this launch works.
          Rockstar has not published a single global unlock hour, and the official rule is local
          midnight everywhere. A countdown fixed to Eastern time will look &lsquo;early&rsquo; to a
          player in London and &lsquo;late&rsquo; to a player in Los Angeles. The honest countdown is
          the one that ends at your own midnight — which is what the timer on this page does.
          For the exact local times in 40 regions, see the{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-release-time" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">release-time hub</Link>.
        </p>

        <FAQSection items={faq} title="GTA 6 countdown — Questions" subtitle="" badge="" badgeColor="#FFC857" />

        <SourcesBox
          sources={[
            { name: 'Rockstar Newswire — GTA VI is now set to launch November 19, 2026 (Nov 6, 2025)', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026' },
            { name: 'Rockstar Support — pre-load guidance', url: 'https://support.rockstargames.com/' },
            { name: 'Rockstar Newswire — Pre-load begins November 10, 2026 (Nov 3, 2026)', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire' },
          ]}
          lastVerified="2026-11-05"
        />

        <AuthorBox />

        <RelatedPages
          pages={[
            { name: 'GTA 6 release date', path: '/gta-6-release-date' },
            { name: 'Release time by region', path: '/gta-6-release-time' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 pre-load guide', path: '/gta-6-preload' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 file size — how many GB?', path: '/gta-6-file-size' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 pre-order', path: '/gta-6-pre-order' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

## src/pages/release/DelayHistoryPage.tsx

````tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { History } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { QuickAnswer, FactsTable, SourcesBox, AuthorBox, RelatedPages } from '../../components/Article';
import { FAQSection } from '../../components/FAQSection';
import { articleSchema } from '../../lib/schema';
import { getAuthorName, SITE_CONFIG } from '../../config/site';

/**
 * GTA 6 delay history. Two moves, both announced by Rockstar, both quoted
 * from the studio's own words. No invented reasons, no speculation about
 * production problems Rockstar never named.
 */
export function DelayHistoryPage() {
  const description =
    'Why was GTA 6 delayed? The full timeline: fall 2025 to May 26, 2026, then to November 19, 2026 — with Rockstar’s own words on why.';
  const url = `${SITE_CONFIG.url}/gta-6-delay-history`;

  const faq = [
    {
      question: 'Why was GTA 6 delayed?',
      answer: 'Rockstar has given one reason for both delays: the team needed more time to finish the game to the standard players expect. In May 2025 it said it needed extra time to deliver the game at the level of quality players expect and deserve; in November 2025 it said the extra months would let it finish the game with the level of polish players have come to expect and deserve.',
    },
    {
      question: 'How many times has GTA 6 been delayed?',
      answer: 'Twice. The game was first scheduled for fall 2025, then moved to May 26, 2026 (announced May 2, 2025), and then to November 19, 2026 (announced November 6, 2025).',
    },
    {
      question: 'When was GTA 6 first supposed to come out?',
      answer: 'Fall 2025. That was the window Rockstar gave when it first dated the game. It never gave a specific day inside fall 2025 before moving the game to May 26, 2026.',
    },
    {
      question: 'Will GTA 6 be delayed again?',
      answer: 'Rockstar has not announced any further delay, and November 19, 2026 remains the official date. The game has already moved twice, so nothing is guaranteed — but there is no third delay announced, and pre-orders, pre-load, and the boxed edition are all scheduled around November 19.',
    },
    {
      question: 'Did Take-Two say anything about the delays?',
      answer: 'Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick backed both moves, telling investors the studio was seeking to release the most extraordinary title in the history of entertainment and that a limited amount of additional time was required for polish. Take-Two shares fell in after-hours trading after the November 2025 announcement.',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <SEO
        title="Why Was GTA 6 Delayed? Full Delay History"
        description={description}
        canonical="/gta-6-delay-history"
        type="article"
        articlePublished="2026-11-05"
        articleModified="2026-11-05"
        ogImage="https://vicetools.app/og-release.png"
        schema={articleSchema({
          headline: 'Why Was GTA 6 Delayed? Full Delay History',
          description,
          datePublished: '2026-11-05',
          dateModified: '2026-11-05',
          authorName: getAuthorName(),
          url,
        })}
      />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10">
        <Breadcrumbs pathname="/gta-6-delay-history" />

        <div className="mt-6">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#150A24] border border-[#19E3D0]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#19E3D0] mb-3">
            <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>TWO DELAYS</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white leading-tight">
            Why Was GTA 6 Delayed?
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[#B9A6D4] mt-3">Last updated: November 5, 2026</p>
        </div>

        <QuickAnswer>
          GTA 6 has been delayed twice: from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026 (announced May 2, 2025),
          and then to November 19, 2026 (announced November 6, 2025). Rockstar gave one reason
          for both moves — the team needed more time to finish the game to the standard players
          expect. The studio has not named any specific production problem.
        </QuickAnswer>

        <FactsTable
          rows={[
            {
              fact: 'First window: fall 2025, then moved to May 26, 2026 (announced May 2, 2025)',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire (May 2, 2025)',
            },
            {
              fact: 'Second move: May 26, 2026 to November 19, 2026 (announced Nov 6, 2025)',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire (Nov 6, 2025)',
            },
            {
              fact: 'Rockstar’s stated reason: more time to finish the game to the expected standard of quality and polish',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire',
            },
            {
              fact: 'Current official date: Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S',
              status: 'confirmed',
              sourceUrl: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026',
              sourceName: 'Rockstar Newswire',
            },
            {
              fact: 'A specific production problem named by Rockstar as the cause',
              status: 'unconfirmed',
            },
            {
              fact: 'A further delay past November 19, 2026',
              status: 'unconfirmed',
            },
          ]}
        />

        {/* Timeline table */}
        <div className="my-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-white/10">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-[#150A24] text-left text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#B9A6D4]">
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Announced</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Previous date</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">New date</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr className="border-t border-white/5">
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-white/90">May 2, 2025</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-[#B9A6D4]">Fall 2025</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-white font-mono">May 26, 2026</td>
              </tr>
              <tr className="border-t border-white/5">
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-white/90">November 6, 2025</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-[#B9A6D4]">May 26, 2026</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-white font-mono">November 19, 2026</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          First delay: fall 2025 to May 26, 2026
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          When Rockstar first dated GTA 6, the window was fall 2025 — no specific day. On May 2,
          2025, the studio announced the game would instead release on May 26, 2026. Its message
          was an apology and a promise in the same breath: &lsquo;We are very sorry that this is
          later than you expected,&rsquo; Rockstar wrote, &lsquo;We hope you understand that we need this
          extra time to deliver at the level of quality you expect and deserve.&rsquo; The studio
          thanked players for their support and patience as it worked to finish the game, and
          said the goal, as with every game it has released, was to try and exceed expectations.
          No specific problem was named — no system, no feature, no team — and none has been
          named since.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Second delay: May 26, 2026 to November 19, 2026
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Six months later, on November 6, 2025, Rockstar moved the game again — by six months,
          to Thursday, November 19, 2026. The announcement came alongside Take-Two
          Interactive&rsquo;s quarterly earnings, and it was short: &lsquo;We are sorry for adding
          additional time to what we realize has been a long wait, but these extra months will
          allow us to finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and
          deserve.&rsquo; The studio thanked players again for their patience and support, and said
          it was incredibly excited for players to experience the state of Leonida and a return
          to modern-day Vice City. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told investors the same day that
          Rockstar believed a limited amount of additional time was required for polish, in
          pursuit of the most extraordinary title in the history of entertainment. Take-Two
          shares fell in after-hours trading after the announcement.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What Rockstar actually said — and did not say
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Across both announcements, Rockstar&rsquo;s stated reason is the same word in different
          forms: quality in May 2025, polish in November 2025. That is the full official
          explanation. The studio has not blamed a technology problem, a staffing problem, a
          content cut, or any other specific cause, and this site does not fill that gap with
          speculation. Reports and rumours about the reasons have circulated since the first
          delay — about the scale of the game, about the pressure on the team, about everything
          from performance to scope — but none of them comes from Rockstar, and none of them is
          presented here as a fact. The difference matters: &lsquo;Rockstar said it needs more time
          for polish&rsquo; is confirmed; &lsquo;the delay happened because of X&rsquo; is not, unless
          Rockstar says so.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Could it slip again?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Rockstar has not announced any further delay, and November 19, 2026 remains the
          official date — it has now stood for a full year. Everything around the launch is
          scheduled to it: pre-orders opened in June 2026, pre-loading begins November 10, and
          boxed copies reach shops from November 12. A third delay is not impossible — two
          delays prove the date can move — but there is no announcement, no report from a named
          source, and no signal from Rockstar or Take-Two pointing to one. The honest position
          is to plan for November 19 and to watch the Rockstar Newswire, which is where both
          previous delays were announced first. If a third delay comes, the{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-release-date" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">release date page</Link> will
          carry the new date with its source.
        </p>

        <FAQSection items={faq} title="GTA 6 delay history — Questions" subtitle="" badge="" badgeColor="#FFC857" />

        <SourcesBox
          sources={[
            { name: 'Rockstar Newswire — GTA VI is now set to launch November 19, 2026 (Nov 6, 2025)', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026' },
            { name: 'Rockstar Newswire — May 2, 2025 announcement', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire' },
          ]}
          lastVerified="2026-11-05"
        />

        <AuthorBox />

        <RelatedPages
          pages={[
            { name: 'GTA 6 release date', path: '/gta-6-release-date' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 countdown', path: '/gta-6-countdown' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 pre-order', path: '/gta-6-pre-order' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 pre-load guide', path: '/gta-6-preload' },
            { name: 'GTA 6 pre-orders sold', path: '/gta-6-pre-orders-sold' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
````

## src/pages/release/FileSizePage.tsx

````tsx
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HardDrive } from 'lucide-react';
import { SEO } from '../../components/SEO';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '../../components/Breadcrumbs';
import { QuickAnswer, FactsTable, SourcesBox, AuthorBox, RelatedPages } from '../../components/Article';
import { FAQSection } from '../../components/FAQSection';
import { articleSchema } from '../../lib/schema';
import { getAuthorName, SITE_CONFIG } from '../../config/site';

/**
 * GTA 6 file size. One number is confirmed (pre-load up to 212 GB).
 * Everything else — full install size, day-one patch — is explicitly
 * unconfirmed. No old estimates are repeated here, even to debunk them.
 */

            {
````

````tsx
              fact: 'A reason given by Rockstar for not pressing a disc',
              status: 'unconfirmed',
            },
          ]}

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          There is no disc
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Let&rsquo;s settle the question first, because it is the one this page exists to answer:
          there is no disc version of Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Support&rsquo;s page on platforms,
          editions, and versions, and the official editions page, both make the position clear —
          the boxed Standard Edition contains a download code, not a disc. You buy the box, you
          take it home, you redeem the code on your console, and the game downloads. The box is
          real; the disc inside it is not. If a listing anywhere promises you a GTA 6 disc,
          that listing is wrong, or it is selling you something that does not exist.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What is in the box?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          The boxed Standard Edition is a code-in-box release: the box holds a download code for
          the full Standard Edition game, plus whatever printed inserts the retailer includes.
          The code gives you the same game as the digital Standard Edition — the single-player
          campaign of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in Vice City and Leonida — and the same
          pre-order bonuses if you buy before November 20, 2026, including the Vintage Vice
          City Pack. What the box does not give you is a disc to put in the console, a disc to
          lend to a friend, or a disc to resell later. A download code is tied to the account
          that redeems it, and it cannot be passed on the way a disc can.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          When can you buy the box?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Boxed Standard Edition copies reach shops from <strong className="text-white">November
          12, 2026</strong> — a week before launch. Once you have redeemed the code, you can
          pre-load the game exactly like a digital buyer, even though you started two days
          later than the November 10 digital pre-load. The game itself unlocks at the same
          moment for everyone: midnight local time on November 19, 2026. Buying the box does
          not delay your play time, as long as you redeem the code and start the download on
          November 12 — the 212 GB pre-load has a full week to finish before launch. The
          Ultimate Edition, by contrast, is digital-only: there is no boxed version of it at
          all, and Standard Edition owners who want its extras buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade
          separately later.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          Why no disc? Rockstar has not said
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          Rockstar has not given a reason for skipping the disc, and this page will not invent
          one. One practical fact is worth noting, clearly labelled as our observation and not
          Rockstar&rsquo;s explanation: the pre-load file is up to 212 GB, far more than a single
          Blu-ray disc holds. A game of this size on disc would need several discs, or a disc
          plus a large download anyway. The industry has also been moving this way for years —
          digital sales now dominate, and code-in-box lets a boxed copy exist on a shelf without
          pressing discs at all. But none of that is Rockstar&rsquo;s stated reason, because no
          stated reason exists. If the studio ever gives one, this page will carry it with the
          source.
        </p>

        <h2 className="font-['Orbitron'] font-bold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white mt-10 mb-4">
          What about a collector&rsquo;s edition?
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">

          are the Standard Edition, in digital or code-in-box form, and the digital-only
          Ultimate Edition. That is the complete line-up as of November 5, 2026. If you see a
          &lsquo;collector&rsquo;s edition&rsquo; or a &lsquo;steelbook edition&rsquo; for sale anywhere, it is not an
          official Rockstar product: no such edition exists, and no disc, steelbook, or printed
          map bundle has been announced. The full comparison of the two real editions — prices,
          formats, and bonuses — is on our <Link to="/gta-6-editions" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">editions
          page</Link>, and where to buy them is on the{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-pre-order" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">pre-order page</Link>.
        </p>

        <FAQSection items={faq} title="GTA 6 physical disc — Questions" subtitle="" badge="" badgeColor="#FFC857" />

          sources={[

            { name: 'Rockstar Newswire — Pre-load begins November 10, 2026 (Nov 3, 2026)', url: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire' },

}
````

````tsx
          The pre-load file is <strong className="text-white">up to 212 GB</strong>, depending on

          further and tells PS5 owners to clear a minimum of 212 GB of storage space before they
          start. That is the only size Rockstar has confirmed. A separate full install size has
          not been announced, and older estimates that circulated before Rockstar&rsquo;s announcement
          are out of date — do not plan around them. Our{' '}
          <Link to="/gta-6-file-size" className="text-[#19E3D0] underline hover:text-white">file-size page</Link> explains

        </p>
        <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#B9A6D4] leading-relaxed my-4 font-light">
          212 GB is a large download on any connection, and it is the reason pre-loading exists:
          nine days is enough time for even a slow connection to finish before launch. If your
          connection is slow, start the download the moment it opens on November 10 and leave
          the console in rest mode with downloads enabled. Do not wait until November 18 — you
          would be downloading on launch eve instead of playing at midnight.
````

````tsx
            at <strong className="text-white">12:00 AM GMT</strong> — one global instant. In
````
